title: Business Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> <li><strong>San Francisco, CA</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>The Business Operations team sits within the CFO organization and is responsible for core company KPI reporting, incubating new analytics capabilities, and leading or facilitating cross-functional initiatives to design and operationalize high-impact programs. We are looking for an individual with strong analytical horsepower to join the team to provide decision-making support to Cloudflare’s strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate is passionate about problem solving and insight discovery, as well as is excited about rolling the sleeves to prototype MVPs and building high quality processes and tooling that scale with our rapid growth.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do </strong></p> <ul> <li>Work on complex problems: identify root causes of the challenge and/or underlying business drivers, execute in-depth analyses to translate data into meaningful insights and/or repeatable gadgets or processes </li> <li>Lead projects through the full cycle: from initial scoping, solution design, code execution, QA and to operationalization and enablement  </li> <li>Leverage latest AI technologies incl. Cloudflare OS, Developer Platform, emerging best practices to illustrate what can be possible in how we work</li> <li>Synthesize audience relevant findings from the data to achieve alignments and support strategic decision making </li> <li>Assess financial impact of new initiatives, identify approaches to risk mitigation, create forecast model on new metrics as needed </li> <li>Work closely with Data Engineer and Data Science Team to track core KPIs, create visibility on new initiatives and its impact, and to streamline reporting processes as the projects mature </li> <li>Provide ad-hoc analytical support to Finance & Executive Leadership</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of Business Operations, Consulting, Investment Banking or  Strategic Finance experience</li> <li>Bachelor's degree, Data Science master or MBA a plus  </li> <li><strong>Strategic thinker with strong business acumen</strong>: ability to zoom in with good attention to detail while still keeping the big picture in mind; excel at translating data into actionable insights or programs </li> <li><strong>Clear, concise and proactive communicator</strong>: ability to synthesize complex data or business problems into actionable information to drive results</li> <li><strong>Have a strong modeling foundation: </strong>high proficiency in building thoughtful, complex and auditable business model and present the outcome in an easy-to-understand format</li> <li><strong>Versatility</strong>: Results-oriented, self-starter, thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment; high proficiency in SQL or AI assisted coding required</li> <li>Advanced/ working proficiency with English mandatory both written and verbal</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $130,000 - $179,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (m/w/d)
description: Dein Impact Du gestaltest, wie Menschen eine agentische KI erleben, die sie durch ihr Arbeitsleben begleitet und dabei unterstützt, souverän über ihre Karriere zu entscheiden. Dazu gehört, dass sich ein System, das in ihrem Auftrag handelt, nachvollziehbar, vertrauenswürdig und leicht bedienbar anfühlt. Du entscheidest mit, was wir bauen, nicht nur, wie es aussieht. Neue Fähigkeiten entwickelst du gemeinsam mit Product von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Konzept. Du verantwortest den Bereich Design & UX und legst das Fundament für ein wachsendes Produkt: Prinzipien, Design System, Informationsarchitektur und eine Arbeitsweise, die mitwächst. So arbeiten wir Wir bauen agentische KI nicht nur als Produkt, wir arbeiten auch selbst damit. In unserem agentengestützten Entwicklungsprozess wird aus Konzepten in kurzer Zeit lauffähiger Code, mit automatisierten Reviews und Tests in jeder Phase. Für dich heißt das: Zwischen deinem Entwurf und dem fertigen Feature liegen Tage, nicht Monate. Du arbeitest direkt mit Entwicklung und KI-Agenten zusammen, testest Ideen am echten Produkt statt am Klickdummy und entwickelst die Art, wie Design und Engineering bei uns zusammenarbeiten, aktiv weiter. Deine Aufgaben Produkt & Konzeption: Du übersetzt Nutzerbedürfnisse und Geschäftsziele in Produktkonzepte. Du entwickelst User Journeys, Story Maps und Feature-Konzepte und bringst sie mit Product, AI-Team und Engineering zur Entscheidungsreife. Discovery & Research: Du planst und führst Nutzerinterviews, Usability-Tests und Konzeptvalidierungen durch. Du machst aus den Ergebnissen klare Empfehlungen für die Roadmap. Interaction & Conversational Design: Du entwirfst Flows, in denen Chat, Formulare und strukturierte Ansichten zusammenspielen. Du übersetzt KI-Verhalten in Oberflächen, die zeigen, warum etwas vorgeschlagen wird, und nicht nur, was. Mensch & KI im Zusammenspiel: Du gestaltest die Momente, in denen die KI an menschliche Expert:innen übergibt, so, dass für Nutzer:innen ein durchgängiges Erlebnis entsteht. Design System & Informationsarchitektur: Du baust unser Design System in Figma auf und pflegst es, im Einklang mit der PAIDAI-Marke. Außerdem legst du fest, wie die App aufgebaut ist und wie sich Nutzer:innen darin bewegen. Design im agentischen Workflow: Du sorgst dafür, dass Designentscheidungen sauber in unseren Entwicklungsprozess einfließen, etwa über klare Specs, Komponenten und Regeln, an denen sich Entwickler:innen und Agenten orientieren. Du reviewst, was gebaut wird. Vertrauen & Compliance by Design: Du gestaltest Einwilligungs-, Datenfreigabe- und Transparenzmomente so, dass sie DSGVO und AI Act erfüllen, ohne Nutzer:innen auszubremsen. Dein Profil Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als UX/UI- oder Product Designer:in, davon einen relevanten Teil mit Verantwortung für Konzepte oder einen ganzen Produktbereich Ein Portfolio, das deinen Weg vom Problem über das Konzept bis zum ausgelieferten Produkt zeigt, inklusive der Entscheidungen, die du unterwegs getroffen hast Erfahrung in der Konzeptarbeit an der Schnittstelle zu Produktmanagement, z. B. mit Story Mapping, Priorisierung oder Hypothesen-Validierung Sicherer Umgang mit Figma, Design Systems und komponentenbasiertem Arbeiten Neugier auf KI-getriebene Produkte und darauf, selbst mit KI-Agenten zu arbeiten Du arbeitest eigenständig, vertrittst deine Konzepte überzeugend und arbeitest gern eng mit Engineering zusammen Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1) Was wir bieten Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du baust ein Produkt, das Menschen im Arbeitsleben stärkt, vom Vertragscheck bis zur nächsten Karriereentscheidung. Was du gestaltest, macht für echte Menschen einen Unterschied. Innovation: Agentische KI im Produkt und im eigenen Entwicklungsprozess. Bei uns arbeitest du mit Methoden, die anderswo noch Zukunftsmusik sind. Federführend gestalten: Du prägst Produkt und Design eines jungen KI-Startups von Anfang an und baust den Bereich Design & UX selbst auf. Eigenverantwortung: Du triffst wegweisende Entscheidungen, eigenständig und im Team. Flexibilität: Hybrides Arbeiten, unser Büro liegt mitten in Hamburg Teamgeist: Ein interdisziplinäres, motiviertes Team Weiterlernen: Regelmäßiges Mentoring und fachliche Unterstützung Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns ist wichtiger, wie du denkst und arbeitest, als jedes Häkchen auf einer Liste. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter, Hintergründe und Lebenswege. title: Engineering Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity?</h2> <p>Become an Engineering Manager for one of our teams in Berlin. You’ll lead a team of engineers working on products and systems that create meaningful impact for our customers and our business.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to lead an existing team, partner closely with product and design, and help raise the bar for high performance in how we work. You’ll bring clarity to complex problems, support your team to deliver great outcomes, and contribute to a healthy, inclusive engineering culture.</p> <h2>What will I be doing?</h2> <ul> <li>Partnering with engineering, product and design leaders to shape team direction and strategy.</li> <li>Translating strategy into clear goals, priorities and measurable impact with the help of your team.</li> <li>Enabling your team to achieve high levels of productivity, performance, reliability and quality.</li> <li>Teaching, mentoring, coaching and acting as a role model for engineers and other engineering managers.</li> <li>Creating a collaborative, inclusive and supportive team culture focused on fast, focused, high-impact execution.</li> <li>Supporting effective planning, decision-making and communication across your team and wider engineering.</li> <li>Helping to shape and evolve our engineering culture by contributing to engineering organisation programmes.</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need?</h2> <p>We recognise that lists like this can sometimes appear to be strict requirements, but that’s not the case. title: Founding Account Executive
description: About Zelara Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way. Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome. With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift , measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. Our founders still run the commercial side themselves. We are hiring the person who takes that over and turns it into a motion that does not depend on them. The Role This is not a role where you inherit a mature sales organisation and work a territory. Leads do not arrive from marketing, opportunities do not arrive from SDRs, and there is no playbook written by someone else for you to run. This is a hands-on senior AE role: you carry a number and close your own deals. You own the commercial motion end-to-end at the moment it stops being founder-led: the pitch lands, the workshops work, paying customers are signing, and none of it is yet a system that someone other than a founder can repeat. You own the full funnel, from identifying who is worth talking to through discovery, workshop, offer, negotiation, and signature, and on into the annual contract, expansion, and renewal. Annual contracts run €75–250k . Cycles run two to four months. Buying committees are a CRM champion, a technical stakeholder, and an economic buyer, and you need to know why each of them says no. You and the Solutions Architect run each account as a pair, in a weekly rhythm and in the room together for the conversations that decide something. You are the account owner: pricing, proposals, contracts, conversion to an annual contract, expansion, renewal. They own the technical plan and the evidence behind those decisions. Before signature they lead technical discovery alongside you; after signature they become the customer's named technical lead. You close; they make the value real and defensible. You will sell to CRM, lifecycle, and marketing leaders at mid-market and enterprise B2C companies across Europe: fintech, e-commerce, travel, and employee benefits. What You Will Do Own the full funnel from ICP identification to signed contract: source, qualify, run discovery, facilitate workshops, write offers, negotiate, and close Close the next wave of customers alongside a founder, then without one, and turn closing from a personal skill into a system someone else can run Win the build-versus-buy conversation: prepare it with the Solutions Architect, bring the evidence, and make the case to an engineering lead who would rather build it Turn a working pitch into a documented playbook: write down what wins, retire what does not, and make the next hire productive from it Run outbound as an experiment rather than a spray: test channels, messaging, and segments with a stated hypothesis and a result you are willing to act on Shape ICP and positioning with real market signal, and feed what you hear in deals back to Product and Science rather than storing it in your head Build the commercial foundation: pricing logic, contract mechanics, pipeline hygiene, and a forecast that holds up Own the commercial side of expansion and renewal with the Solutions Architect: identify the opportunity, quantify the value, and de-risk the plan Lead sales as the team grows: once the motion is repeatable, hire and coach the next account executives You will not only work a pipeline. You will reason about every deal in terms of what it teaches us about the market, the product, and the motion, as part of a small, senior team, with real deals as your starting point. Your First 90 Days 30 Days (Immersion): Learn the ICP, the pipeline, the case study, and our AI-assisted sales tooling in your first two weeks. From week three, run discovery calls yourself, with a founder as backup, and take over your first live deals. 60 Days (Ownership): Close your first customer on your own and run the weekly pipeline review instead of the founders. Document where the motion works and where it breaks. 90 Days (Engine): Own the pipeline end-to-end, with a measurable improvement at the stage you decided was the bottleneck, a repeatable outbound motion under way, and a written playbook that someone other than you could run. Who You Are You are a senior AE who still closes your own deals: several years carrying a quota for complex B2B deals. You have domain experience: you have sold to CRM, lifecycle, or marketing teams at B2C companies, or you have sold martech (Braze, Bird, Iterable, Klaviyo, Customer. io, Emarsys, HubSpot). You have start-up experience: you have built at least one commercial motion from scratch as a founder, a first sales hire, or the owner of a blank page, and you have closed complex B2B deals without a playbook or marketing-generated pipeline. You have carried enterprise deals through a buying committee, and you can name the specific moment each of the three buyers almost said no. You think in funnel metrics: conversion by stage, cycle length, where deals actually die, and what you changed about it. You have sold a technical product and can hold your own in the room where a customer's engineers argue they could build it. You do not dismiss what they have already built. You are credible with a CMO and with a Head of CRM and their data engineer, and you switch between them without losing either. You judge a customer's business before you pitch into it: which metric their leadership is measured on, which one is decoration, and what matters that nobody has said out loud. You take full ownership from first touch to signed contract, and you say the uncomfortable thing early. A commitment with a date on it is a commitment. Ideally, you have led a small sales team while still carrying a number yourself. You are AI-native in how you work. Research, outreach, prep, and follow-up in our motion are instrumented and AI-assisted, and you will extend that rather than work around it. You are fluent in English. German is a strong advantage given our current market focus. Bonus You have been the operator on the other side, responsible for a CRM or lifecycle programme in-house. You have converted pilots or design partnerships into multi-year contracts and can say what actually moved the decision. You can point to multiple deals that only closed because of you. How We Work We are an AI-first team. We use spec-driven workflows and AI-assisted execution across engineering and go-to-market, adopting what makes us faster and discarding what does not. We value evidence, speed, and clear ownership over process theater, pipeline hygiene for its own sake, or mistaking activity for progress. If you want to push the boundaries of how companies are built and sold, not just what gets sold, you will fit right in. What We Offer Work alongside founders who have built and sold an AI-driven SaaS business and led large-scale B2C operations from the customer's side of the table. A founding commercial role, hands-on from day one, with room to lead as the team grows. Ownership of the commercial motion and autonomy over pricing, positioning, process, and deal strategy. A technical counterpart in every account, so you are not alone in the room when the conversation turns to data and integration. Direct access to real customers, real pipeline, and a short path to Product, Science, and Engineering. Based in Berlin with regular travel to European customers. A competitive salary and a meaningful equity stake, early enough to shape the company's direction, de-risked by paying customers. Your choice of a Deutschlandticket or bike subscription, plus a gym/fitness club membership. Our Compass We are guided by four core values: Seek Truth: We ground decisions in evidence. When the facts change, we change our mind. Act with Integrity: We build trust through transparency, reliability, and ownership. Put Customers First: We succeed only when they succeed. Accelerate Impact: We prefer speed, simplicity, and real learning over ceremony. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Project Manager
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region. Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp. Your Mission You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast. As a Project Manager , most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live. You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them: Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up. Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings. Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it. Your Career Path in Project Management This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires. Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management. Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs. Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts. Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them. Key Responsibilities Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live. Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date. Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold. Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists. Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately. Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting. Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization. In addition, as a Senior Project Manager Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date. Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries. Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it. Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track. Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs. What We're Really Looking For The following key attributes ensure success in this role: Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it. Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased. Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem. Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it. Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits. Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder. What You Bring For the Project Manager level Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management. The ability to run several projects at once without losing control of any of them. Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on. Fluent in German and English, spoken and written. Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS. Benefits High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path. Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises. Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily. Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression. Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program. Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators. Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities. Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites. Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact. Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers . Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Create net-new pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner motion, events, and customer referrals. Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and forecasting, and report proactively on progress, risks, and what you need from the organization. Insight-led selling and deal shaping Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing and introduce a sharper point of view on where value is trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls). Run executive discovery to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate it into a crisp target-state narrative, urgency, and mutual action plan. Build internal alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees, including champions, economic buyers, IT/security, and process owners. Commercial ownership: value case, negotiation, and close Own the business case, pricing strategy, proposals, negotiation, and contracting. Quantify and communicate value (capacity release, cycle time reduction, control/compliance improvements, stack simplification) and tie it to executive priorities and budget. Drive the deal to closure with clear next steps, strong deal governance, and accurate forecasting. Orchestration across presales and delivery Partner with Solutions Engineers to run workshops/demos and de-risk technical concerns (security, integration, rollout). Align with Customer Success on implementation readiness, success criteria, and expansion paths. Ensure clean handoffs from close to kickoff, maintaining continuity of value narrative and outcomes. Competitive positioning Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative. Anticipate and neutralize competitive plays with crisp differentiation and proof. What we're looking for Must-haves 5–10+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS selling experience (or equivalent complex solution sales), with a consistent track record of hitting/exceeding targets. Proven ability to run insight-led enterprise sales cycles: you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and mobilize buying committees. Strong executive presence with CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services and comfort navigating enterprise procurement. Ability to manage complex, multi-threaded deals: mutual action plans, MEDDICC-style qualification, forecasting discipline. Strong collaboration with presales/SE and post-sales teams; you sell what can be delivered. Strong plus ERP/SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or selling into finance/procurement/shared services transformations. Experience selling automation platforms (workflow/RPA/process mining/IDP) and winning against incumbents. Experience with global enterprise rollouts and multi-country stakeholders. Language Fluent in English and German (or another major European language depending on territory). What you'll get A product that wins. Strong differentiation and real enterprise proof points. Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission. Real ownership: employee-owned company; choose annually to take variable compensation in cash or shares. Growth and autonomy: build your path in a rapidly scaling, international company. Continuous learning: structured onboarding plus ongoing coaching. Exceptional team: ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to excellence. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Werksstudenten ISMS & Compliance (m/w/d) - Berlin
description: Die Solarize Energy Solutions GmbH mit Büros in Berlin und Stuttgart revolutioniert die Energiewirtschaft mit innovativer Meter-to-Cash-Software . Wir ermöglichen es Energieunternehmen, innovative Produkte anzubieten, von denen sowohl die Kunden als auch die Energiewende profitieren. Ursprünglich für Mieterstrom in Gewerbeimmobilien entwickelt, unterstützt Solarize heute über 200 Unternehmen als Abrechnungslösung für PPAs, Mieterstrom, Wärme bis hin zu komplexen zeitreihenbasierten Energieprodukten im Geschäftskundenbereich. Das Solarize-Team besteht aus erfahrenen Gründern, Pionieren der Energiewende, Softwareexperten und hungrigen Macher:innen, die in einer offenen Kultur und im ständigen Austausch miteinander an den wichtigen Fragen der Energiewende arbeiten. Wir sind ausdauernd, wissbegierig, veränderungswillig und unbequem. So verändern wir den Energiesektor hin zu einer kundenorientierten und innovativen Branche und leisten dadurch unseren Beitrag für die zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Energieversorger vertrauen uns ihre Abrechnungsdaten an. Deshalb ist Informationssicherheit bei uns Teil des Produkts. Für unser Büro in Berlin suchen wir eine:n Werkstudent:in ISMS & Compliance (m/w/d) , der:die unser nach ISO/IEC 27001:2022 zertifiziertes ISMS mitgestaltet und weiterentwickelt. Aufgaben Deine Mission bei uns Du sorgst mit dafür, dass die Plattform für die Energiewende sicher bleibt. Dabei lernst du Informationssicherheit so kennen, wie sie in einem wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmen tatsächlich gelebt wird. Halte unser ISMS auditfest: Du unterstützt dabei, die Anforderungen der ISO/IEC 27001:2022 im Alltag umzusetzen und zu überprüfen. Du pflegst Richtlinien, Nachweise und Risikobewertungen und begleitest interne und externe Audits aus erster Reihe. Mach Sicherheit messbar: Du definierst aussagekräftige KPIs für unser ISMS, erhebst sie möglichst automatisiert und machst sie in Dashboards sichtbar. Aus den Zahlen leitest du konkrete Verbesserungen ab. Entwickle das ISMS weiter: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie Prozesse schlanker, Kontrollen wirksamer und Dokumentation hilfreicher werden. Dein Ziel ist ein ISMS, das im Arbeitsalltag unterstützt und auch gelebt wird. Sichere unsere Geräteflotte: Du gestaltest das Mobile Device Management unserer Firmengeräte aktiv mit, von Sicherheitsrichtlinien und Konfigurationsprofilen bis zum Rollout für mobile Geräte. title: Senior Industrial Designer | Robotics
description: Your tasks Shape the hardware identity: Define how our humanoids look and feel: proportions, surfaces, overall silhouette. You take the design direction we already have and carry it through to physical systems that actually ship. Design for passive safety first: Safety sits in the geometry from the first sketch. You work through clearances, pinch points, contact surfaces and fall behavior so the robot is safe around people before software gets involved. Integrate complex systems: Package the internals (sensors, cameras, cooling, connectors, cable routing) so the technical parts look intended. Physical human machine interaction: Design status signals, touchpoints and small physical cues that tell the people working next to the robot what it is doing and what comes next. Build the ecosystem around the robot: Extend the design language to charging docks, transport cases, maintenance gear and packaging. From model to CAD: You build physical models fast, see what holds up, and change them until they do. Then you do the surfacing and hand over CAD that engineering can build from directly. Materials and processes: Select finishes, review physical samples, and work suppliers on feasibility, cost and lead times. You are willing to try materials that are not standard and to bring in specialized external labs. Your profile Background: A degree in industrial or product design, or an engineering degree where the design side is clearly the stronger half. Experience: Around five years or more designing physical products, in house or at a studio. Robotics, medical devices, lab and industrial equipment, mobility, or another field where the hardware has to hold up in front of people. Small series: You have worked on products built in the hundreds rather than the millions, and know how much that changes what a shape can be. Safety and regulation: You have designed under mechanical safety requirements before, so guarding, clearances and contact safety are familiar territory rather than a new topic. Tools: Surface modeling in Rhino, Onshape, SolidWorks or Fusion, plus 3D printing and enough workshop practice to build your own models. Working with engineers: You read mechanical drawings, keep up in technical discussions, and can explain why a design decision matters. Languages: Fluent English. German is nice to have, not a requirement. Why us? Ownership from day one: The physical design and hardware identity of our humanoids is yours. Short decisions, no approval chains, and you work directly with the founders and lead engineers. Everything under one roof: Labs, workshop and test rigs are in the same Kreuzberg building. The engineer you need is a walk away, not a ticket. Room to get better: Paid learning time and a personal budget for it, projects where something is allowed to not work the first time, and support for portfolio work and conference talks as the company becomes known. Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, home setup, health or food. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about. How to Apply Send us your portfolio and a few lines about one product you took from sketch to production : what changed along the way, and why. No cover letter needed. Process : Intro call -> Portfolio deep-dive with the founders -> Half-day on-site visit with a small design exercise -> Offer. We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in hardware design. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway. Die Consultia Unternehmensgruppe betreut seit knapp 20 Jahren komplexe Mandate ganzheitlich in allen wirtschaftlichen und steuerlichen Belangen auf nationaler und internationaler Ebene. An den vier Standorten Berlin, Hamburg, Leipzig und Kleinmachnow arbeiten über 40 hoch engagierte Mitarbeiter gemeinsam an vollumfänglichen Lösungen für unsere Mandanten. Consultia ist keine klassische Steuerberatungskanzlei. Wir sind vielmehr eine Beratungskanzlei für den gehobenen Mittelstand – mit einem klaren Fokus auf hochwertige steuerliche und betriebswirtschaftliche Beratung. Dabei setzen wir bewusst auf digitale Prozesse und papierloses Arbeiten , um Effizienz, Nachhaltigkeit und zeitgemäßen Mandantenservice zu vereinen. Der Schwerpunkt unserer Tätigkeiten im Bereich Steuern liegt in der Beratung: sei es in den Bereichen Immobilienberatung, der Beratung bei Transaktionen oder Restrukturierungen. Darüber hinaus betreuen wir ausländische Unternehmen und Personen mit Aktivitäten in Deutschland (Inbound-Beratung). Unserem Anspruch „Beratung macht den Unterschied” werden wir durch persönliche und umfassende Beratung auf Augenhöhe und mit hoher Fachexpertise gerecht. Aufgaben Steuerberatung kann mehr. Ganzheitliche Beratung bedeutet für unsere Mitarbeiter, dass sich ein Großteil der monotonen Aufgabengebiete unserer Branche erübrigt. Der Arbeitsalltag unserer Spezialisten besteht aus abwechslungsreichen und anspruchsvollen Projekten sowie spannenden Sachverhalten. Der Schwerpunkt Ihrer Tätigkeiten liegt in der Beratung – beispielsweise in den Bereichen Immobilien, Transaktionen oder Restrukturierung. Zudem hält unser Team konstant Ausschau nach neuen Effizienzpotentialen durch die Digitalisierung und Automatisierung. Abwechslung und Vielschichtigkeit statt Trott und Monotonie – diese Aufgaben könnten Sie schon bald durch Ihren Arbeitsalltag begleiten: Intensive und individuelle Mandantenberatung: Sie sind verstärkt in persönliche Gespräche und strategische Beratung involviert, um maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für komplexe steuerliche Fragestellungen zu erarbeiten Gestaltung von Steuerstrategien: Arbeiten Sie aktiv an der Entwicklung von steuerlichen Optimierungsmöglichkeiten für Ihre Mandanten Umgang mit komplexen Steuerfällen dank unserer teils internationalen Mandantschaft Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen und Steuererklärungen Mitwirken bei der Prozessoptimierung und Digitalisierung Optional: Erstellung von vielschichtigen, digitalen Finanzbuchhaltungen Weitere Tätigkeiten , die Ihnen Freude bereiten Qualifikation So passen Sie zu uns. Wir arbeiten in einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld mit einem hohen Digitalisierungsgrad und anspruchsvollen Mandaten. Daraus resultiert ein spannendes und attraktives Arbeitsumfeld, allerdings auch eine gewisse Erwartungshaltung an neue Teammitglieder. Wir legen großen Wert auf kontinuierliche persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung. Auf diesem Weg unterstützen wir jeden Mitarbeiter individuell, jedoch setzen wir auch ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative voraus. Bei Consultia sind alle richtig, die vorankommen und am Puls der Zeit sein wollen. Darüber hinaus sollten Sie sich in den folgenden Punkten wiederfinden: Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum Steuerfachangestellten, Steuerfachwirt oder Bilanzbuchhalter (alle m/w/d), idealerweise mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit DATEV und den gängigen MS Office-Programmen Eine zukunftsorientierte Denkweise und der Wunsch, digital und modern zu arbeiten Eine lösungsorientierte, zuverlässige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeiten – Sie bevorzugen es, Hand in Hand zu arbeiten, statt Ihre Ellbogen auszufahren Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift Optional: gute Englischkenntnisse – if you’re able to understand this sentence, the odds are already in your favor! Benefits Arbeitsbedingungen, die keine Wünsche übriglassen. Unser Anspruch ist es, für unser Team das bestmögliche Arbeitsumfeld mit individuellen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zu schaffen. Dabei gehen wir neue Wege: sei es mit der geplanten Einführung einer 4-Tage-Woche, einer eigenen Auswahl von Mandanten oder kanzleiweiten Umsatzzielen statt personenbezogenen Zielen. Freuen Sie sich auf die folgenden Annehmlichkeiten: Spürbar überdurchschnittliche Vergütung & Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Gehälter über dem Branchenschnitt und weitere Zusatzleistungen wie ein 13. Gehalt oder unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge Kanzleiweite Umsatzziele statt personenbezogener Ziele: Alle ziehen an einem Strang Die Option auf eine 4-Tage-Woche: Wir lassen gerne mit uns reden Möglichkeit zur Spezialisierung : Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Vertiefung und Spezialisierung (z.B. in den Bereichen Immobilien, Transaktionen oder Restrukturierungen) Interdisziplinäre Projekte : Betreuung von Projekten, welche die Expertise aus verschiedenen Fach- und Kompetenzbereichen erfordern Transparente Aufstiegschancen: Klar definierte Karrierepfade Moderne und stilvoll eingerichtete Räumlichkeiten: Die Umgebung ist die halbe Miete Teamzusammenhalt: Förderung des Miteinanders durch hohe Priorisierung des „Personal Fits“ neuer Teammitglieder und regelmäßigen Events Zahlreiche Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote: Weil Stillstand für Sie keine Option ist Eigenverantwortung & Vertrauen: Viel Freiraum für eigene Entscheidungen und Arbeitsweisen statt starrer Prozesse und Einschränkungen Flexible Arbeitszeiten- und Modelle: Egal ob Familie oder intensives Hobby, mit unserer Arbeitszeitgestaltung findet jeder die „Work-Life-Balance“ Home-Office: Variable Mischung aus Präsenz- und Mobilarbeit, soweit es mit den Aufgaben vereinbar ist Hoher Digitalisierungsstandard: Die Zukunft ist jetzt Ihr Weg zu uns. Wenn Ihnen gefällt, was Sie lesen, sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Bitte senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf sowie Ihre relevanten Zeugnisse. Ein Anschreiben ist willkommen, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich. Auch beantworten wir gerne Ihre offenen Fragen – melden Sie sich einfach. Wir freuen uns auf Sie! title: Werkstudent*in (m/w/d) Krankenhausberatung / Controlling
description: Du möchtest neben deinem Studium praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und dabei Einblicke in die Beratung von Krankenhäusern gewinnen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir, die KHZV PLUS GmbH, sind ein junges und wachsendes Beratungsunternehmen. Als engagierter und verlässlicher Partner unterstützen wir Krankenhäuser insbesondere in den Bereichen Controlling sowie Budget- und Entgeltverhandlungen. Dabei verbinden wir fachliche Expertise mit praxisnahen Lösungen, fundierten Analysen und individueller Beratung. Aufgaben Du unterstützt unser Team vor allem bei koordinierenden und administrativen Aufgaben. Dazu gehören insbesondere: Unterstützung des Beratungsteams im Tagesgeschäft Organisation und Koordination von Terminen, Unterlagen und internen Abstimmungen Vorbereitung und Nachbereitung von Besprechungen sowie Pflege von Aufgaben- und Terminübersichten Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Überarbeitung von Präsentationen, Dokumenten und Auswertungen Pflege und Aktualisierung von Daten, Ablagen und Übersichten Bearbeitung allgemeiner Anfragen und Unterstützung bei der internen Kommunikation Recherchen zu aktuellen Themen im Gesundheitswesen und in der Krankenhauswirtschaft Du wirst sorgfältig eingearbeitet und kannst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung übernehmen. Qualifikation Was du mitbringen solltest Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Gesundheitsökonomie, Gesundheitsmanagement oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und organisiert, selbst bei mehreren Aufgaben behältst du den Überblick. Du gehst sicher mit MS Office, insbesondere Outlook, Word, Excel und PowerPoint, um. Du arbeitest gerne im Team, kommunizierst offen und gehst verantwortungsvoll mit vertraulichen Informationen um. Du hast Interesse an neuen Themen und möchtest dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Benefits Was wir dir bieten Ein professionelles, engagiertes und kollegiales Team sowie praxisnahe Einblicke in die Krankenhausberatung und die Gesundheitswirtschaft Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit der Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Zusammenarbeit Kostenfreie Parkplätze, einen S-Bahn-Anschluss in fünf Gehminuten und weitere Benefits Du möchtest Teil unseres Teams werden oder hast noch Fragen zur Stelle? Dann melde dich gerne bei uns. Deine Anfrage und Bewerbung behandeln wir selbstverständlich vertraulich. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Owner (m/f/d) - Team Search
description: At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership. Flix is building the global platform for affordable and sustainable ground travel, from next-generation train offerings in Europe to rapid expansion in high-growth markets such as India. As our network becomes broader and more complex, Search plays a critical role in helping millions of customers find the right journey quickly, confidently, and intuitively. As a Senior Product Owner/Manager in Demand Division you will be able to turn Search into a true growth engine for Flix: a product experience that understands customer intent, reduces complexity, improves conversion, and creates valuable demand signals for the business across web, app, and emerging AI-native channels. In this role, you will define the north star for Flix Search and own the roadmap through a major product and technical transformation. You will work closely with engineering, UX, data, commercial, and operational stakeholders to evolve Search from a functional step in the booking funnel into a personalised, intelligent, and scalable discovery experience. About the Role Set and communicate a compelling product vision and strategy for Search, grounded in customer needs, business impact, and market opportunity Identify and prioritise opportunities across ranking, relevance, comparison, query understanding, personalisation, and zero-result recovery Use data such as conversion impact, query behaviour, and customer feedback to diagnose problems and guide product decisions Lead discovery and delivery with cross-functional teams, balancing quick customer-facing improvements with long-term platform and architectural needs Align stakeholders around trade-offs, success metrics, and roadmap priorities in an ambiguous and strategically important product area Explore how Search can support new surfaces and behaviours, including AI-native discovery and conversational travel planning About You You have 8+ years of product management experience, ideally including ownership of a search, discovery, marketplace, recommendation, or other high-intent digital product You have led meaningful product changes in complex environments and can connect product strategy with hands-on execution You are highly data-informed and know how to turn behavioural, funnel, and query-level insights into clear product direction You are comfortable partnering with engineering on technical topics such as APIs, ranking, machine learning, performance, and architectural trade-offs You are a strong communicator who can build trust across engineering, UX, data, and business teams and create alignment when priorities compete You are energised by unsolved problems and motivated to understand why a customer experience is not working, not only how to close the next ticket You are fluent in English Nice to have: Experience with travel, mobility, marketplaces, e-commerce, or other high-scale consumer platforms Experience building or improving AI-assisted, personalised, or conversational discovery experiences German or another European language skills We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! What We Offer Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career Why Join Flix? At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Channel Partners Director
description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We are seeking a highly strategic and adaptable Channel Partner Director to lead and scale our partner ecosystem in Germany. In this role, you will act as the linchpin between our organization and our most valued channel partners. This position leans heavily on advanced project management, strategic problem-solving, and expert-level relationship building. You will be responsible for designing bespoke partner strategies, managing complex integrations, and driving joint marketing initiatives to ensure mutual growth and success. Are you ready to take on this challenge and make a difference? 🚀 YOUR IMPACT Strategic Planning: Design, execute, and continuously refine a comprehensive channel partner strategy tailored to the German market and individual partner needs. Project Leadership: Lead end-to-end project management for new and existing partner integrations, ensuring seamless technical, operational, and business alignment. Partner Analysis: Continuously analyze partner performance and operational workflows to determine the best, most profitable way to engage with each specific channel partner. Complex Problem Solving: Navigate ambiguous, multifaceted situations and proactively resolve high-level strategic issues before they impact business goals. Expert Relationship Building: Serve as the primary point of contact, maintaining exceptional relationships both externally with partner stakeholders and internally with our product, sales, and engineering teams. Joint Marketing: Collaborate with partners to generate and execute joint marketing strategies, co-branded campaigns, and go-to-market initiatives that drive revenue and market penetration. Cross-functional Alignment: Champion partner needs internally, working across departments to ensure our company is delivering on integration milestones and support SLAs. WHO YOU ARE Experience: 7+ years of experience in channel management, strategic partnerships, or complex B2B project management. Project Management Skills: Proven track record of managing technical or operational integrations with third-party partners. Strategic Acumen: Exceptional ability to analyze market data, evaluate partner potential, and build actionable, long-term business strategies. Relationship Expertise: Demonstrated mastery in internal and external stakeholder management, with the emotional intelligence to navigate complex corporate dynamics. Marketing Collaboration: Previous experience building and executing joint Go-To-Market (GTM) and marketing strategies with B2B partners. Language Skills: Native or highly fluent in German and professional proficiency in English (written and spoken). Location: Residing in Germany with the ability to travel to partner sites and company events as needed. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in channel management and indirect sales within Brokers and Insurance are mandatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube ! Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025! This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that's making a real difference? Read more about the award here. Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self. Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here. Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Job Applicant Privacy Notice. #LI-HYBRID Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Marketing Working Student (m/f/d)
description: Working hours: 20h/week Location: Hybrid / Hamburg (Germany) Industry: Sports Tech Start: As agreed/ flexible Important info: We currently cannot hire dual students 🚀Are you curious, creative, and eager to learn? Do you enjoy turning ideas into action and finding solutions where others see challenges? At CUJU, we're building the future of football scouting through AI, data, and technology. As one of Germany's leading sports tech startups, we work with top football clubs, global partners, and talented athletes around the world to create new opportunities for the next generation of players. We're looking for a Marketing Working Student (m/f/d) who is excited to gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing international startup. More important than your experience is your attitude: we value people who are proactive, open-minded, fast thinkers, and hungry to learn. title: Digital Presales Customer Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Available Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia</strong></span></p> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Language: Mandarin is <strong>required</strong> to deal with customers in the Greater China region, Cantonese is a plus</li> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Able to independently deliver AI-powered solutions without custom development. Demonstrated ability to work across diverse business domains (e.g., manufacturing, engineering services, finance, HR, supply chain) and quickly understand domain-specific processes, terminology, and pain points. Strong understanding of how enterprise systems connect — APIs, integrations, data flows, and SaaS architectures. Able to assess how AI tools fit into existing system landscapes and identify integration requirements. Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to present complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences, facilitate workshops, run demos, and build trusted relationships with business stakeholders at all levels. Proven ability to elicit, document, analyse, and validate business and technical requirements (e.g., user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows) through stakeholder interviews and hands-on observation. Natural ability to sit with end-users, understand their real-world challenges, and translate messy problems into structured use cases and actionable solutions. Ability to evaluate AI use cases for feasibility, business value, and priority — and identify when a use case requires custom development versus no-code implementation. Experience driving enterprise tool rollouts, user adoption programs, and change management — including onboarding, training, feedback loops, and continuous improvement. Ability to produce clear requirement documents, process maps, user guides, and portfolio overviews.
