title: Data Analyst (m/f/d)
description: ABOUT US METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production. And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production. And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals. READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes. This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business. Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future. YOUR MISSION Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions. Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured. title: Senior SAP SD Consultant
description: Über uns teamative bietet Beratung, Entwicklung und die Umsetzung von IT‑Projekten in Europa und den USA. Mit SAP und ServiceNow als Kernkompetenzen sowie maßgeschneiderter Softwareentwicklung und DevOps helfen wir dabei, Prozesse zu vereinfachen, digitale Lösungen zu implementieren und komplexe Transformationsinitiativen erfolgreich zu steuern. Darüber hinaus ermöglichen wir flexibles Staffing, damit Teams je nach Anforderung schnell angepasst werden können. Rund 400 interne Mitarbeitende und insgesamt mehr als 750 Expert:innen verbinden bei teamative tiefe Inhouse‑Expertise mit bedarfsorientierter Staff Augmentation – sichtbar in langfristigen, vertrauensvollen Partnerschaften mit renommierten Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen. So stehen wir seit über 20 Jahren für Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Kosteneffizienz – in Stuttgart, Bratislava, Miami und über zehn europäischen Tech Hubs. Stellenintro Als Senior SAP SD Consultant begleitest du unsere Kunden bei der Optimierung ihrer Vertriebsprozesse und der Transformation auf SAP S/4HANA. Du analysierst komplexe Anforderungen, entwickelst passende SAP-Lösungen und sorgst dafür, dass Prozesse vom Auftrag bis zur Fakturierung effizient und durchgängig funktionieren. Deine Aufgaben Optimiere Vertriebsprozesse: Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse im SAP SD und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden effiziente und zukunftsfähige Lösungen für ihre Vertriebsorganisation. Gestalte S/4HANA-Transformationen: Du begleitest Kunden fachlich und technisch bei der Einführung, Migration und Weiterentwicklung von SAP S/4HANA Sales. Verbessere End-to-End-Prozesse: Du gestaltest und optimierst den gesamten Order-to-Cash-Prozess – von Auftrag und Lieferung bis hin zu Fakturierung und Übergabe an Finance. Verbinde SAP-Prozesse: Du stellst eine reibungslose Integration von SAP SD mit FI, CO, MM und weiteren angrenzenden Bereichen sicher. Mache Anforderungen zu Lösungen: Du analysierst fachliche Anforderungen, führst Kundenworkshops durch und übersetzt Geschäftsprozesse in passende SAP-Lösungen. Übernimm Verantwortung: Du steuerst Arbeitspakete oder Teilprojekte eigenständig und unterstützt unsere Bestandskunden bei SAP-SD-Support, Prozessoptimierung und Weiterentwicklung. Dein Profil Mehrjährige Erfahrung als SAP SD Consultant, SAP Sales Consultant oder SAP Key User mit fundiertem Verständnis von Vertriebsprozessen. Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP SD sowie idealerweise praktische Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA Sales. Gutes Verständnis des Order-to-Cash-Prozesses und idealerweise Erfahrung mit Themen wie Auftragserfassung, Lieferabwicklung, Versand, Fakturierung und Preisfindung. Verständnis für die Integration von SAP SD mit FI, CO und MM sowie angrenzenden End-to-End-Prozessen. Erfahrung in Kundenberatung, Anforderungsanalyse, Workshop-Moderation und Präsentation sowie die Fähigkeit, fachliche Anforderungen in umsetzbare SAP-Lösungen zu übersetzen. Eigenständige und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse; projektabhängige Reisebereitschaft. Warum wir? title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Business Banking
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£80,000 - £105,000 +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |</p> <p><strong>About Business Banking at Monzo</strong></p> <p>Since its launch five years ago, Monzo Business Banking has been dedicated to delivering the very best of Monzo to small businesses. Today, it's an award-winning service, empowering over 1 million businesses across the UK. </p> <p>As Monzo expands across Europe, Business Banking is entering its next phase: adapting our products and proposition for small businesses in new markets, while continuing our mission to make money work for businesses.</p> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for <em>several</em><strong> Senior PMMs </strong>to own Product Marketing for entire products and experiences. </p> <p>A useful distinction - at Monzo, Product Marketing starts upstream in product-market fit. We're embedded in squads with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Designers, User Researchers, and Sales, bringing the voice of the customer and market into what we build, how we position it, and how we take it to market. We own customer and market understanding, positioning, proposition, launch strategy, and sales enablement. We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign strategy, creative direction, channel execution, and growth. Together, we build the right products and help them succeed in market.</p> <p><strong>This is a senior individual contributor role.</strong> You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market.</p> <p><strong>Where you could join</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Business Banking EU. </strong>Business Banking is entering its next phase of growth as we expand beyond the UK. In this role, you'll define how Monzo Business Banking succeeds in new European markets - understanding local customer needs, building the proposition that translates our core product into local relevance, and working across Product, Growth, Marketing, and local teams to bring those products to market. This is a senior role for someone with high autonomy who loves turning dense customer and market insight into practical decisions about what should launch.</li> <li><strong>Business Banking</strong><strong>. </strong>Business Banking is growing quickly, serving more than one million businesses across the UK while expanding into increasingly sophisticated customer needs. In this role, you'll shape how our products are positioned, sold, and adopted—from defining compelling product narratives to enabling Sales and partnering with Growth and Marketing on launches. This is a role for someone who enjoys sitting at the intersection of Product and commercial teams, translating customer insight into positioning, propositions, and go-to-market strategies that help more businesses choose Monzo.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Set Product Marketing Strategy for a set of products. </strong>You'll define a one-year Product Marketing strategy for a major area of Business Banking, connecting customer insight, market opportunity, and commercial priorities into a clear direction for the product area, rather than one individual product, with measurable business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Develop differentiated positioning & messaging: </strong>You'll create compelling positioning, messaging, and value propositions that differentiate Monzo in the market and resonate with different customer segments. You'll build messaging frameworks that Product, Sales, Integrated Marketing, and broader marketing teams use consistently across launches and customer journeys.</li> <li><strong>Drive competitive intelligence and market insights</strong>: You’ll build and maintain the market view for your product area. You'll become the recognised authority on your customer segment and competitive landscape, building a coherent view of the market from customer research, commercial data, competitor intelligence, and Sales insight. Your recommendations will shape product strategy, positioning, go-to-market, and commercial priorities across the Business Banking collective.</li> <li><strong>Shape product strategy across markets.</strong> You'll partner closely with Product, Research, Design, and Data to identify customer problems, market opportunities, and competitive gaps that influence roadmap priorities. Your customer and market insight will shape what we build, not just how we bring it to market.</li> <li><strong>Set the go-to-market strategy for priority products and markets</strong>. You'll define what audiences we prioritise, why they would choose Monzo, what needs to be true for them to switch and stay, and what success looks like - giving Product, Sales, Marketing, and local market teams a shared strategic direction for how the product enters or scales in market.</li> <li><strong>Own product representation across the customer journey.</strong> You'll define the core proposition and value messages that should carry through key customer and sales touchpoints, so customers consistently understand why the product matters. You'll partner with teams across Product, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and local markets to make sure the customer experience reflects the agreed positioning.</li> <li><strong>Enable localisation:</strong> You'll work with local market teams to determine what should remain globally consistent and what should adapt locally, ensuring positioning, customer journeys, and launches resonate in each market while strengthening the overall Monzo Business Banking proposition.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This is for you if: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You're recognised for your Product Marketing expertise.</strong> You're comfortable owning Product Marketing across a product area or market, and people seek your perspective on customers, competitors, positioning, and product strategy.</li> <li><strong>You bring senior stakeholders with you & thrive in cross-functional environments. </strong>You work effectively across Product, Sales, Growth, Marketing, and Research, building alignment around difficult decisions and helping teams make confident product and commercial choices.</li> <li><strong>You raise the quality of the work around you.</strong> You enjoy mentoring less experienced PMMs, sharing your expertise, and improving how the team works through better frameworks, feedback, and knowledge sharing.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Initial Call (45mins) </li> <li>Case Study Presentation (1hour)</li> <li>x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to ----- You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you: </strong></p> <ul> <li>£80,000 - £105,000 as a base salary</li> <li>This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK </li> <li>We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</li> <li>Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences </li> <li>And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"><strong>here</strong><strong> </strong></a></li> </ul> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><h3>Role</h3> <p>At Oxford Ionics, now part of IonQ, we are building the first practical quantum computer. Our systems are based on ion traps, which hold individual atomic ions tens of microns above the surface of a chip, and we design and build them in house, bringing together optomechanics, vacuum and cryogenic technology, electronics and system infrastructure.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our Systems team and take ownership of mechanical design from first requirements through to manufacture and integration. You will work on the hardware that surrounds the quantum processor, including cryostat requirements, cooling equipment, vacuum chambers and supporting structures, often in areas where the requirements are not yet fully defined.</p> <h3>Responsibilities:</h3> <p>You will work alongside scientists, technicians and the wider hardware design teams to bring new systems through to manufacture. That means producing CAD designs, bills of materials and assembly drawings, managing documentation in our PLM system and working with suppliers and our manufacturing team.</p> <p>Our manufacturing team handles most assembly, but you will support technicians in the lab, investigate problems when they arise and make sure your designs can be built in practice. The work ranges from complex system layout to simple brackets and documentation, and you will see each piece through to completion.</p> <p>Key responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Mechanically integrate multiple sub systems into one complete system, driving the overall mechanical layout.</li> <li>Produce 3D designs of system assemblies and infrastructure, with detailed 2D drawings and bills of materials.</li> <li>Design systems for vacuum pump down, gas handling and coolant management lines.</li> <li>Plan the routing of cables, optical fibre and other physical services throughout the system.</li> <li>Gather and scope requirements with scientists and engineers, then roll out upgrades and variations to system builds.</li> </ul> <h3>Requirements:</h3> <p>You will be a mechanical engineer with a strong design background and a practical understanding of how things are assembled and manufactured. A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience, and around five years of relevant industry experience will give you the grounding the role needs.</p> <p>We want someone proactive who asks questions, gathers requirements, spots the missing details and sees a job through. You will be comfortable working independently with a high degree of autonomy, while collaborating closely with scientists and engineers across disciplines. Quantum experience is not required.</p> <p>You’d be a great fit with:</p> <ul> <li>Established CAD ability, ideally in SolidWorks, with a focus on assembly structure.</li> <li>Experience of complex multidisciplinary systems and good assembly practice.</li> <li>Experience with cryogenic or vacuum systems.</li> <li>Familiarity with GD&T and preparing drawings for manufacture and inspection.</li> <li>Experience of PLM systems or thermal analysis.</li> </ul> <p>The total compensation package includes base salary, bonus, equity, and a range of benefits available on our career site.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs. </strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.</p> <p> </p> <p>If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply! </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Customer Engineer, Strategic Pursuits, APAC (Based in Singapore)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. title: Technischer Anlagenbetreuer (m/w/d)
description: Gebäude sind der Schlüssel für die Energiewende und genau da setzen wir an. Bei LAVA ENERGY treiben wir deutschlandweit die Transformation von Gebäuden voran: wirtschaftlich, technologieoffen und immer mit Lösungen, die zu den Projekten passen. Kein Gebäude ist wie das andere und genau das macht unsere Arbeit spannend, individuell und wirkungsvoll. Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes, mittelständisches Unternehmen – modern, innovativ und voller Energie. Gerade gehen wir den nächsten großen Wachstumsschritt, unsere Reichweite wächst und dafür suchen wir Sie: einen Kollegen mit Energie und Empathie – einen Kollegen welcher Lust hat, sich einzubringen, nicht nur Teil eines Unternehmens sein möchte, sondern einen wertvollen Beitrag zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg beisteuern möchte. Sie stellen den reibungslosen Betrieb unserer Energieanlagen sicher und koordinieren Wartung, Instandhaltung und Störungsbeseitigung. Dabei übernehmen Sie Planung, Dokumentation, Kostenkontrolle und Kundenkommunikation. Zudem wirken Sie am Ausbau von Projekten im Bereich erneuerbare Energien (Pellets, Wärmepumpen, Hybridanlagen, Solarthermie, Photovoltaik) mit, betreuen Serviceverträge und überwachen die Anlagenfunktionen über Energiemonitoringplattformen. Objektbegehungen und Nachkontrollen runden Ihr Aufgabengebiet ab. Strukturiertes Onboarding & Coaching : Umfassende Einarbeitung, professionelle Schulungen in Recruiting, Beratung und Vertrieb sowie regelmäßige Feedback-Sessions Premium - Arbeitsplatz : Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman Miller-Stühle, Apple-Technik (MacBook Air/Pro, iMac) – mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt. Du analysierst die Recruiting-Herausforderungen der Unternehmen, identifizierst konkreten Handlungsbedarf und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Strategien. Dein Fundament: Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten sauber im CRM, behältst deine Pipeline im Blick und arbeitest zielorientiert auf deine KPIs hin. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung zusammen und bringst Ideen zur Optimierung unserer Prozesse ein. Das bringst du idealerweise mit Vertriebsaffinität: Du hast Freude an Akquise und willst aktiv neue Kunden gewinnen – am Telefon, per Video-Call oder persönlich. Beratungsverständnis: Du erkennst Potenziale, stellst die richtigen Fragen und präsentierst Lösungen strukturiert. Menschenkenntnis: Du verstehst sowohl die Unternehmens- als auch die Bewerberperspektive. Eigeninitiative & Leistungswille : Du arbeitest selbstständig, bleibst auch nach einem "Nein" am Ball und willst überdurchschnittliche Ergebnisse erzielen. Wichtig : Ob Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg mit Vertriebserfahrung – uns interessiert nicht dein Lebenslauf, sondern dein Hunger. title: Full Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
description: TL;DR Join GlassDollar and help build the system some of Europe's largest companies use to find, test, and adopt startup technology. We're looking for an engineer who wants considerably more responsibility than "implement what's in the ticket". You'll take an ambiguous problem, shape it together with product, make the important technical decisions, ship it, and stay close enough to see whether it worked. We expect you to have opinions. We also expect you to be good enough to change them. The problem we're solving Large organisations are remarkably good at accumulating problems. A company with 100,000 employees can have thousands of operational challenges across its business units. Somewhere outside that organisation, a startup has probably already built part of the solution. Getting those two things to meet still happens through spreadsheets, long email threads, and meetings whose primary output is another meeting. GlassDollar OS is the operating system for venture clienting: problem → startup discovery → evaluation → PoC → adoption, in one repeatable workflow. Our customers are some of Europe's largest organisations, so the software has to move quickly and behave like something an enterprise can depend on. That tension creates the interesting engineering problems. What we're looking for You can take a problem further than the ticket. Work often starts with something incomplete, like "customers need a better way to manage X". You'll shape the problem with product, challenge assumptions, and decide what belongs in this iteration. Strong opinions about what we build, not only how, are expected here. You care about product. You want to know who you're building for, why the problem matters, and what success looks like. That context should shape your technical decisions. You have technical judgement. There is rarely one correct architecture. You know when the boring solution beats the ambitious one, when an abstraction helps and when it hides the problem, and when a small feature is about to create six months of technical debt. We expect you to reason about API boundaries, data models, permissions, performance, failure modes, testing, observability, and rollout, and to raise concerns with a clear argument attached. You make the system better, not just the feature. You fix the spreading pattern rather than the single instance, make an API easier for the next person, and improve tests because the current setup makes everyone afraid to deploy. Your impact should show beyond the pull requests with your name on them. You can work across the stack. A feature might run from a React interaction through GraphQL into a Node service, a schema redesign, a permissions update, and a safe migration for existing customers. Curiosity to follow the problem matters more than equal depth everywhere. You own quality. We have QA. That's not where quality begins. What breaks if this request happens twice? What happens with old data, or when the API fails halfway through? We use Playwright and Jest alongside reviews and monitoring. The goal isn't coverage, it's confidence. You communicate like your decisions will matter later. Six months from now, somebody should understand an important decision without digging through seventeen Slack messages and a deleted Notion comment. That means writing things down when they matter, explaining trade-offs clearly, giving useful code reviews, and surfacing risks before they become incidents. You raise the engineering bar around you. You do not need a management title to have influence. Find the hole in an architecture, unblock someone without taking the keyboard away, disagree without turning every decision into a referendum. As you earn trust, you’ll naturally become the person people bring harder problems to. What you'll do Over your first year: Enterprise integrations: into our customers' systems, data, identity providers, and workflows. This is what turns GlassDollar from software somebody logs into, into infrastructure their organisation operates on. APIs and MCP: public REST APIs and MCP servers for our customers, their engineers, and increasingly their AI agents. The interesting part isn't exposing endpoints, it's designing an external platform we'll still be happy supporting years from now. AI inside real workflows: embeddings, vector search, and LLMs across a large database of startups and corporate innovation data. We're less interested in adding a ✨ button to everything than in finding places where AI removes real work. Workflow automation: triggers, notifications, and automation that replace humans moving information between systems. Core product engineering: React interfaces, APIs, PostgreSQL queries, permissions, migrations, performance work, and the occasional bug whose root cause makes everybody stare silently at their screen. Our stack Frontend: TypeScript, React, Material UI, Apollo Client, Playwright Backend: Node.js, GraphQL, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Jest Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Sentry Increasingly: LLM APIs, embeddings, vector search, MCP, AI-assisted engineering workflows You don't need experience with every item. Reasoning about systems matters more to us than having memorised our exact stack. title: Associate Product Owner
description: TL;DR Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM. Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature. Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself. The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder. GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter. What we're looking for You have personally written the tickets. 3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off. You are technical enough to argue with engineers. AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better. You can write. A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second. You write specs worth acting on. The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter. You know what looks good. You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually. You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide. No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec. You want to be coached hard. Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast. You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day. We want to see the workflow, not hear it described. You want the scope to grow. The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available. What you'll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday. Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients What you'll be scoping over your first year: Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on. Public REST APIs and MCP servers , so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us. AI embedded across the product , inside the surfaces people already work in. Workflow automation inside the platform , so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself. You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room. This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor. Requirements 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc Nice to have: B2B enterprise SaaS background Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows Notion fluency Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on. How we hire Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps. Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample : a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed Interview Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager, Global Procurement
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p>We are looking for multiple exceptional <strong>Senior Manager, Global Procurement</strong> for different categories including</p> <ul> <li><strong>Senior Manager, Global Procurement - Apparel</strong></li> <li><strong>Senior Manager, Global Procurement - Women's Knits & Tops</strong> </li> <li><strong>Senior Manager, Global Procurement - Men's and Women's Sweaters</strong></li> <li><strong>Senior Manager, Global Procurement - Men's and Women's Activewear</strong></li> <li><strong>Senior Manager, Global Procurement -</strong> <strong>Loungewear, Swimwear, KBM</strong></li> <li><strong>Senior Manager, Global Procurement - Footwear</strong></li> </ul> <p>You will own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption,C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.</p> <p>Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business, contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Procurement Category Strategy: </strong>Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth.</li> <ul> <li>Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement.</li> <li>Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools.</li> <li>Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months.</li> </ul> <li><strong>RFP Ownership & Execution: </strong>Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award.</li> <ul> <li>Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage.</li> <li>Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: </strong>Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories.</li> <ul> <li>Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished Goods Manufacturers / Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) new categories & new products</li> <li>Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing)</li> <li>Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows</li> <li>Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale)</li> </ul> <li><strong>Upstream Sourcing: </strong>Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing.</li> <ul> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Value Creation: </strong>Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays. </li> <ul> <li>e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)?</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in retail apparel environment</li> <li>Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners</li> <li>Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams</li> <li>Technical aptitude for leveraging AI-powered platforms (e.g., LLMs) to conduct scenario analysis and automate complex procurement tasks</li> <li>Excellent negotiation skills and commercial acumen</li> <li>Experience in apparel, soft goods, or home goods strongly preferred</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3319"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">WHY QUINCE?</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3352">Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3604"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3662">Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. </p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4074">Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4428">Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. description: 16–20 Stunden pro Woche | Nürnberg | Hybrid Du studierst und möchtest Projektmanagement nicht nur aus Vorlesungen kennen, sondern erleben, wie Projekte im Arbeitsalltag tatsächlich geplant, koordiniert und umgesetzt werden? title: Software Engineer - Platforms & Productivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Bengaluru, India</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare’s Engineering Team builds and runs the software that handles large amounts of requests on the Internet today. We also build and run the internal tools and platforms that run that software. Individual engineering teams are typically responsible for large areas with considerable impact, and able to execute autonomously within that space to deliver value to their customers - be they internal or external.</p> <p>The Engineering Platform and Productivity team has a charter to build a self-service, resilient, and scalable platform using a combination of Open Source projects, intellectual property, and internal infrastructure. The charter includes to build tools and services that help easily integrate a base set of capabilities into Cloudflare’s products. These services have cross cutting concerns that 100s of fellow engineers use as the building blocks at Cloudflare. The team also writes services that are redundant for each product development team to build and that serve high volumes of requests every day.</p> <p>As an engineer in the Engineering Productivity and Platforms organization, you'll be building and managing tools to help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. Our mission is to provide a reliable, yet flexible, platform to help product teams release new software efficiently and safely. The role includes both software engineering and DevOps operational responsibilities. The ideal candidate will care deeply about providing other engineers with an excellent development experience.</p> <p>Additionally, this role has a focus on Agentic Engineering, and building tools for engineers internally to leverage modern AI agents, models, and agentic practices - including MCP servers, agentic IDEs, autonomous agents, evals, and make AI-native improvements to our internal SDLC and solving context engineering at scale.</p> <p><strong>Exp</strong>: 3- 12 yrs</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Design and build developer productivity tooling including MCP servers and agents.</li> <li>Drive initiatives that make our engineers happier and more productive.</li> <li>Help respond and prevent incidents impacting core platforms.</li> <li>Harden the platform against security threats and resource contention issues.</li> <li>Improve our GitOps systems and practices.</li> <li>Work with app teams to understand their potential challenges and help them choose the best way to architect their systems.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Desirable skills, knowledge and experience.</strong></li> <li>Ability to work with codebases in Bash, TypeScript and Go.</li> <li>Excellent debugging skills.</li> <li>Source control experience including branching, merging and rebasing.</li> <li>The ability to break down complex problems into smaller pieces, provide options, talk through trade-offs and drive the effort to solve the problem.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Providing guidance and building platforms across multiple zones and regions as foundation for other teams to build distributed highly-available applications.</li> <li>Worked in a platform engineering team/ engineering productivity team in the past.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Conversion Design Analyst (f/m/d)
description: Your mission We're looking for a Senior Conversion Design Analyst who is genuinely both things: a designer who digs into data, and an analyst who designs. You decide with evidence. You will frame real user problems based on qualitative and quantitative data, design a part of our product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and analyze the results yourself. You will sit inside the product delivery team that focuses on user growth, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it. And you will not be doing it alone: You join a group of Conversion Design Analysts across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards. English is our working language. German matters here too: You will be designing flows that German-speaking users read. Concretely, you will: Design experiences grounded in real user needs and real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that are highly usable and intuitive and that earn their place by adding measurable value, not just because we can build them. Frame the real problem before solving it. Dig into quantitative and qualitative data until you find the actual question underneath the ask. Then make it explainable and actionable. A well-framed problem is half the battle Design, run the experiment, read it honestly and decide what comes next. Define a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome. Then use what you learned to frame the next question. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, and designing the next step. Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody. Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less. Your profile You practice product design and analytics. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa. You have run experiments end to end and know how to move from one to the next. Setting up the hypothesis, designing strong variants using our design system, choosing the right metrics to track, analyzing the results and then making a clear call on how to continue: ship it, kill it, or iterate. You have technical know-how and experience in setting up and evaluating experiments in an A/B testing tool, constructing the needed dashboards for the problem space you are working on. With sufficient data literacy, you get your own numbers through SQL query. You work with raw data to dig up insights and spot opportunities, without waiting for someone else to pull it for you. You have statistical literacy. You don’t need to be able to run R, but you understand what Bayesian vs. frequentist is about and why you do a power analysis before launching an experiment. You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about. You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd. You are fluent with AI tools. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack Excellent English skills for working in our international team. To apply, include a cover letter explaining why this role and why now and if your background doesn't tick every box, tell us how you'd bridge the gap. Alongside it, share a portfolio that shows your work through its impact, at least one project walked through end to end: the hypothesis, what you designed, the result, and what you took from it. Show us how you used data to move your thinking forward, and where experimentation shaped what you built. If you can't share a portfolio due to an NDA or the nature of your work, a detailed cover letter walking through a project in the same way is fine. Nice to have Experience with a marketplace, community, classifieds, or other network product. Strong German, or the confidence to design in it with support. Experience building or maintaining parts of a design system. Comfortable writing SQL without AI assistance. You have basic dbt knowledge. What we offer Hybrid work model combining office and remote days A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation Responsibility and great opportunities to actively contribute Your nebenan.de SpenditCard – you'll receive an additional income of 35 Euros per month, which you can use for things of your choice 30 days of vacation per year – we also offer the possibility of workation models and a sabbatical A workplace in Berlin-Kreuzberg and regular events like yoga or Lunch & Learn sessions. If we’ve captured your interest, apply now and let us know why you’re the perfect fit for the job! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
description: What we do At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth. Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions. Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts. After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future. If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started. What you'll be doing You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money. You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived. We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI. We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team. Own the wealth product area end to end Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it Turn the data into something users act on Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway Own the numbers Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you What we are looking for You might be a fit if: You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it You're fluent in English; German is a plus You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. Strong plus if you have: PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale Subscription and paywall experimentation Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers Your own portfolio, and opinions about it If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess. Work authorisation This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations. What the first six months look like Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy. Why join getquin? Why join getquin? We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process. Three things that are specifically true of this role: Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand and optimize your wealth The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone. How we hire Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Campaign Analyst
description: Who we are JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business. We are committed to helping you achieve your personal and professional goals, and we offer a collaborative and supportive environment to do so. Truly a hybrid work environment. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)

Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg. Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen. Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen. Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. NOCH FRAGEN? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
