title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
description: Aufgaben Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus! Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. Deine Aufgaben Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps. Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic -basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter. Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich. Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents – zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures. Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign . Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment -Prozesse mit. Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen. Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden. Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen. Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: PHP und Laravel Statamic PostgreSQL Livewire HTML, CSS und JavaScript RESTful APIs Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment -Prozessen Large Language Models und Coding Agents Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt. Qualifikation Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken. Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich in Laravel , Statamic , PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln. Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und Coding Agents sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen. Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern, Deployment und grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten. Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen. Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten. Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich. Was uns wichtig ist Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst. Benefits Wir bieten dir: Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen Die Möglichkeit, unseren Tech-Stack aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln Viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege Einen vielseitigen Job mit direktem Einfluss auf unser Business und unsere Produkte Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit 28 Tage Urlaub Flexibilität bei Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort > Drei Tage pro Woche in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte, zwei Tage im MobileOffice Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten Wachstumskultur Eine offene, freundliche Atmosphäre mit Partnerinnen, Partnern und Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt Deine Bewerbung Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, persönliches Motivationsschreiben mit maximal 1.000 Zeichen: Warum möchtest du als Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d) bei Table.Briefings arbeiten? Uns interessiert besonders, welche Probleme du gerne löst, wie du mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungen umgehst und was dich daran reizt, Technologie mit konkretem unternehmerischem und redaktionellem Nutzen zu entwickeln. title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Our Opportunity Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate. Your Mission As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver. You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath. You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo. Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties. Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome What you'll own Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver. Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact. Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am. Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access. Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable. Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure. Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job. What success looks like You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use. Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why. You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it. You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you. You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how. What it takes You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement. You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast. You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows. You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy. You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration. You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem. You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers. You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them. Bonus: AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC. LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows. Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning. Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it. Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard. Why Predium? Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit. Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product. Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both. Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create. Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week. 30 vacation days (including company vacation) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · team events Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)

Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche. Deine Mission Als Head of Engineering übernimmst du die Führung unseres aktuell rund 10-köpfigen Engineering-Teams und baust es weiter aus. Du hilfst deinem Team, ambitioniert zu liefern: kontinuierliche Verbesserungen für unsere bestehenden Kunden, aber auch neue Prototypen und Innovationen, die unser Geschäftsmodell erweitern. Gleichzeitig sorgst du für Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit im Team, damit alle jeden Tag ein Stück besser werden. Was du mitbringst Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Software-Engineering-Führung und -Architektur, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz beim Skalieren von Engineering-Teams bei gleichzeitig hoher Shipping-Geschwindigkeit - idealerweise in einem Nicht-Konzernumfeld. Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit den genannten Frontend- und Backend-Technologien sowie modernen Tech-Stacks - nicht, indem du alles selbst codest, sondern indem du dein Team befähigst. Du denkst in Systemen und löst Probleme konsequent aus einer First-Principles-Perspektive. Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau bzw. C1 und fließend Englisch. Warum Predium? title: Associate Data Scientist (f/m/d)
description: Our Opportunity Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate. Your Mission As a Data Scientist at Predium, you will help develop and improve the data-driven models behind our platform. You will use statistics, machine learning, and numerical methods to solve well-defined problems related to buildings, energy performance, and real-estate decarbonization. Working closely with our engineering and product team, you will turn real-world data into reliable analytical, simulation, and machine-learning models that identify optimization opportunities for more sustainable buildings and help customers make informed investment decisions. What you'll own Develop and improve analytical, machine-learning, and simulation models to address business problems in the real-estate and energy domain. Build and improve data extraction pipelines for structured and unstructured sources, evaluating extraction accuracy and reliability Continuously explore and evaluate new data sources to improve model accuracy. Assess data quality, identify gaps and evaluate model performance by validating assumptions and results against real-world data and feedback of domain experts. Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into data-driven solutions. What success looks like You take ownership of well-defined analytical and modeling problems and independently deliver robust solutions. Your models and analyses are reproducible, well-documented, and supported by appropriate validation. You translate technical results into clear implications for the product, our customers, and the business. You collaborate effectively across Data, Engineering and Product teams. You actively seek feedback and use it to improve both your technical work and your way of working. What it takes A degree in data science, computer science, mathematics or a related field. 1–2 years of relevant hands-on experience, with programming, ideally in Python, through projects in areas such as physics-based modeling, machine learning, or data pipelines. TypeScript experience for product prototyping is a plus. A structured, independent approach to problem-solving. title: Senior Customer Success Manager - Germany
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. <br><br>Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake. <br><br>Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.</p></div><table> <tbody> <tr> <td> <div><strong>The role, in a nutshell:</strong><br>As a Customer Success Manager at Chainguard, you will be the post-sales primary point of contact for our customers. You will be responsible for taking lead on customer engagements across onboarding, implementation, and adoption. In this role, you will work closely with Solutions Architects, Technical Support, Product Management, Engineering and Sales to ensure the successful onboarding and support of your customers. You are their day-to-day contact, building relationships with customers and driving outcomes, adoption, and delivering time-to-value.<br><br><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Success Planning & Value: Drive business success planning by partnering with customers, pre-sales, and post-sales teams to align on requirements, goals, and challenges. Provide thought leadership on change management for large, scaled rollouts. Support the full Business Value Realization cycle to ensure customers can demonstrate and prove value internally.</li> <li>Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer within the organization, advocating for customer needs and requirements to internal teams.  This means being a team player and having strong collaboration skills - this role must align with many different internal teams, influence them to act toward customer needs.</li> <li>Issue Management: Collaborate with Technical Support and Customer Engineering teams to ensure timely resolution to customer issues.</li> <li>Product Expertise: Develop hands-on technical knowledge of Chainguard and stay up-to-date with industry trends, new features, and best practices so you can help customers optimize their use of Chainguard.</li> <li>Training & Education: Collaborate with customers and our Edu team to ensure customers are educated on product features, best practices, and security principles.</li> <li>Account Management: Develop relationships with multiple levels of customer stakeholders from technicians to CISOs. Work closely with sales teams to identify the best path to renew and expand customers while minimizing churn risks.</li> </ul> <div><br><br><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></div> <ul> <li>5+ years experience in enterprise, customer facing roles collaborating with both technical and business teams - Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management or a combination of those plus Sales, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Support.</li> <li>Relevant domain knowledge of one or more of the following: Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, AppSec, security infrastructure, containers, regulatory compliance requirements, vulnerability management, software development lifecycle.</li> <li>This is a strategic and proactive role, our expectation is that this person will take full ownership of their customer portfolio and act with a high level of autonomy.  This includes making key decisions to drive effective customer outcomes; deciding when to include our executive team or c-suite in customer escalations, how to de-risk or de-escalate customer issues and conflict, and advocating to internal teams including sales, product, engineering, etc.</li> <li>An entrepreneurial mindset - you will be often build entirely new process or practices to ensure we best serve customers.</li> <li>Demonstrates a strong commitment to continuous personal and professional development, actively seeking opportunities to enhance skills, expand knowledge, and advance within their career and field.</li> <li>Driven, high emotional intelligence, and strong priority management skills</li> </ul> <div><br><br><strong>Strongly Preferred:</strong></div> <ul> <li>Previous early-stage startup experience</li> <li>Passion for technology & cybersecurity</li> <li>Relevant hands-on technical experience, in one or more of the following domains: cloud computing environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), containers, Linux, Supply Chain Security, DevSecOps, AppSec, security, security infrastructure, regulatory compliance requirements, vulnerability management, software development lifecycle</li> </ul> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>We live and breathe our company values:</p> <ul> <li>We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.</li> <li>We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.</li> <li>We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.</li> <li>We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.</li> </ul> <p>A few of the benefits we offer:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible & Remote-First Culture:</strong> Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.</li> <li><strong>Our Approach to Equity:</strong> Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).</li> <li><strong>100% Covered Health Insurance:</strong> We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.</li> <li><strong>∞ Flexible Time Off:</strong> Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.</li> <li><strong>18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave:</strong> We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.</li> </ul> <p>If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description: The product you will work on The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform. The ideal candidate is We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production. This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field. Your role and responsibilities You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams. Build the platform Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters. Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions. Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment. Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations. Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services. Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior . Run what you build Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code. Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations. Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code. Be part of a compensated on-call rotation Set the technical direction Advise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind. Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate. Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes. What you need to succeed in this role Several years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems. Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on. Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy. title: Optimization and Forecast Engineer - Energy Systems (f/m/d)
description: About FION European industry is losing competitiveness because electricity here is more expensive and more volatile than in the US or China. The reason: renewables fluctuate strongly, factories consume constantly. We close that gap. FION plans and installs the right battery system for an industrial site and runs it with AI in real time against tariffs and markets. The software that dimensions, controls and monitors those systems is our own, and it runs end to end: ML and optimization in the cloud, data streaming and control, and the edge device at the customer site. The result for the customer: significantly lower energy costs and measurable CO2 savings. We earn trust by delivering systems and operating them transparently. We already work with more than 20 factories across industries such as plastics, automotive and food processing, and we are backed by early-stage investors. We're looking for an engineer with deep experience in time-series forecasting and mathematical optimization to join us as an early hire. You'll work on the forecasting and optimization core of our platform: the models that forecast industrial electricity consumption and PV generation, and the optimization that decides how each battery operates and trades against tariffs and markets within physical and grid constraints. This is a startup role: you should be comfortable switching between strategic thinking and hands-on work. You'll work directly with the CTO, one of the co-founders. Tasks Forecasting models Develop and improve time-series forecasting models for industrial electricity consumption, PV generation, and other energy-relevant signals, and extend them with probabilistic outputs. Evaluate forecast quality on noisy, incomplete, and non-stationary industrial data, including its actual operational and economic impact. Battery dispatch optimization Develop and improve the optimization models that schedule battery dispatch across peak shaving, self-consumption, spot market trading and flexibility marketing, while adhering to physical and grid constraints. Design how forecasts, uncertainty measures, physical constraints, and system states are used in downstream optimization workflows. Validation, simulation and monitoring Build and improve simulation, replay, benchmarking, and validation workflows to test model behavior before and alongside deployment in live systems. Build and use tools and processes to monitor and assess the quality of operational forecasting and optimization models. Production integration Design, write, test, and deploy production-grade code for mission-critical forecasting and optimization products. Improve robustness through plausibility checks, fallback behavior, re-forecasting, and handling of low-confidence or missing data. Collaborate closely with software engineers to integrate models into our core platform and edge devices. Requirements You bring: - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience - Strong applied experience in time-series and probabilistic forecasting: forecast calibration, uncertainty evaluation, backtesting, and model validation - Strong understanding of mathematical optimization, especially LP/MILP, and the ability to model real-world systems through objectives, constraints, and operational rules - Strong Python skills with the scientific and machine learning tool stack (pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch) - Experience developing, releasing, and tracking the performance of forecasting or optimization models in a commercial software setting - An ownership mindset - you want to shape the platform, not just implement tickets Even better if you have: - Energy domain knowledge - you understand power, energy, phases, and how the grid works - Understanding of European electricity markets, flexibility services, and grid operation - BESS-specific experience: familiarity with BESS architectures, components, and operation, and direct experience with energy management algorithms for battery systems - Experience with open-source and commercial MILP solvers (e.g. Pyomo, OR-Tools) - Experience with optimization techniques such as stochastic or robust optimization - Experience building forecasting and machine learning products in the cloud (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure) - Experience using Large Language Models to accelerate software development and reliably add new capabilities to real products - German language skills (our customers and partners are German) Benefits Ownership, not tickets This isn't a role where the models are decided and you fill in the blanks. The forecasting and dispatch optimization stack is greenfield - nothing exists yet, and you'll design and build it from the ground up. At larger energy companies, this scope is split across multiple teams. Here, you own it all. Real impact, fast Your code runs physical batteries that save real factories real money. You'll see results on a Grafana dashboard the same week you deploy. Founding trajectory As FION grows, you grow with it - from hands-on builder to platform lead to head of forecasting and optimization. What takes 5 years at a large company, you'll have from day one. Compensation - VSOP (virtual shares) - you participate in the company's success - Berlin hybrid (remote from within Germany possible for the right person) Send us: - Your CV or LinkedIn profile - A few sentences on why this role interests you - Optionally: a link to a project, repo, or writeup that shows how you think about technical problems We review every application personally and get back to you within a week. No automated screening, no ATS black hole - you're writing to a person, not a system. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Lisbon </p> <hr> <h4><strong>About the Deal Desk Team:</strong></h4> <p>The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, acting as a strategic partner to the global Sales organization. Perform analysis on pricing and deal terms, leveraging AI insights to recommend "next best action" for deal structuring and margin optimization.</li> <li>Curate and Tune AI Agents: Manage the enterprise deal approval ecosystem by tuning automated agents and models to ensure compliance and accuracy at scale.</li> <li>Drive Process Iteration: Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Product) to build, streamline, and automate deal desk processes, architecting autonomous approval workflows and focusing on reducing field friction through relentless automation.</li> <li>Champion AI & Automation Integration: Champion the integration of LLMs and generative AI tools to automate deal desk workflows, significantly reducing deal cycle times. Experience with revenue recognition principles (e.g., ASC 606) is highly desirable. Experience selling software is a bonus.</li> <li>Contract & Pricing Knowledge: Experience drafting and interpreting commercial contracts, with a focus on terms that impact revenue recognition and financial risk. We’ll teach you how to sell properly: how to prospect, qualify, handle objections, manage a pipeline, and close, all while speaking to senior decision-makers at some of the world’s biggest tech companies. Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling. Collaboration & feedbac k: You’ll work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support. This Role Is For You If You’re early in your career and hungry to learn, not entitled to results You’re comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new You actively seek feedback and apply it quickly You take ownership for outcomes, not just effort You’re resilient, organised, and able to manage pace and pressure You communicate clearly with customers and with teammates You enjoy working as part of a team where success is shared Our Hiring Process Our hiring process is designed to reflect how we actually work: collaborative, practical, and focused on potential rather than polish. Compensation: Base Salary £26,500 - 28,000 *range depending on experience Commissions: Year 1 OTE £35,000 uncapped Year 2 OTE £55,000 uncapped _________________________________ Benefits Time off & flexibility 34 days’ paid holiday including UK Bank holidays and a day off on your birthday Flexible working hours : our core hours are 10am–4:30pm, with the flexibility to structure your working day between 8am and 8pm around when you work best Work from where works for you : choose to work remotely within the UK or hybrid from our London office. Our office is always open to the wider team whenever you fancy coming in WFH Kit: a comprehensive tech setup, plus a dedicated WFH equipment budget A well-stocked office : snacks, drinks and fresh fruit available in our London office Health & wellbeing Private Medical and Dental Insurance with Bupa Life Insurance: cover worth 4x your annual salary On-demand therapy & coaching : company sponsored access to therapy and career coaching through Spill Wellness perks : discounts on gym memberships, fitness and wellness classes Cycle to Work & Workplace Nursery schemes Perks at Work : access to a wide range of corporate discounts Monthly flexible benefits allowance through ThanksBen (£50/month in year one, £100/month in year two and £165/month from year three), giving you extra flexibility to spend on the benefits that matter most to you Learning & development A growing personal L&D budget (starting at £500 per year and increasing with tenure to £3,000 per year) Dedicated L&D or volunteering time : one paid day every quarter to invest in your development or support a cause you care about. Unlimited access to our internal Academy : including courses, learning resources and professional certifications Community and Inclusion We are committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, and where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute. title: Operations Intern for AVD (Altersvorsorgedepot) (f/m/d)
description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. About the role: Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers. Join us as an AVD Operations Intern and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works. What you’ll do: Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface. Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on. Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time. Support our client teams: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on. Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so. What you bring: You are fluent in German (C1 or above) and comfortable working in English. This one is a hard requirement rather than a nice-to-have: the regulation, the correspondence with the ZfA, and most of the documentation you'll work with day to day are all in German. You're a student in Business, Economics, Finance, Law, or a related field — or on a gap year between degrees. You're structured and genuinely precise. In this role, small details carry real consequences for someone's pension, and you're the kind of person who notices when a number doesn't add up. You're curious about rules rather than put off by them. You're willing to read the actual regulation to understand why a process works the way it does. You're comfortable with ambiguity. The product is brand new, so some answers don't exist yet; you'll ask good questions instead of waiting for perfect instructions. You're confident with spreadsheets. Any prior exposure to financial services, operations or a regulated environment is a bonus, but not required. You're available for a minimum of 4 months (6 preferred) and based in Berlin. How we Upvest in you: Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits. Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements. Inclusion : We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies. Our Values: Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions. Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection. Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together. Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others. Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

financial services, manufacturing) Develop segment-specific value propositions written in buyer language: the situation they face, the consequence of inaction, how SoSafe solves it, and why SoSafe over alternatives without jargon, no feature lists Use AI tools to accelerate research, messaging iteration, persona development, and competitive synthesis as a standard part of your workflow Maintain implementation guides — leveraging AI to produce, iterate, and personalise at speed Validate messaging and demo content before market release through structured rep feedback sessions, customer interviews, and early cohort exposure Input into coordinated multi-touch plays across Marketing, Sales, and CS that drive upsell and cross-sell into the install base — with clear pipeline and NRR impact metrics tied to each play Track asset utilisation, field feedback, and segment performance data (win rates, pipeline velocity, NRR contribution) to continuously improve GTM effectiveness and demonstrate commercial impact What you will bring 5+ years in B2B SaaS in product marketing, solutions marketing or segment marketing with a proven track record of producing segment-specific or Commercial stakeholders around a segment strategy and drive execution Preferred Experience in cybersecurity, HR tech or a similarly technical B2B environment Experience defining or contributing to Background in structured pre-launch validation: rep councils, messaging test sessions, early cohort feedback What we offer* Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ *Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
description: Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO We are looking for a Senior Product Manager ( ISR ) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship. LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests. Tech stack & tools: Linear (backlog, sprints) Confluence Google Workspace LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications Figma QGIS and comparable viewers STAC -based imagery catalogs Data: very high resolution optical imagery synthetic aperture radar 3D surface models cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments agentic tools for a variety of work. Your challenge As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them. Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user. Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters. Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts. Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards. Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim. Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance. Your profile Professional ISR , GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry. Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff. Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control. German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English. German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users. You take ownership and proactively push work forward. You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams. Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped. You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure. Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus. Project management experience in defence or publicly funded programmes (national, EU, NATO) is a plus. Experience writing CONOPS , operational requirements or capability documents is a plus. Familiarity with satellite imagery, remote sensing, or AI and machine learning products is a plus. Experience delivering software into secure on-premise or air-gapped environments is a plus. An existing valid German security clearance (SÜ2 / SÜ3) is a plus. Working knowledge of NATO standards and interoperability for imagery and geospatial data is a plus. Your Benefits The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe. Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold. Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest. A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons. Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks. Potential to participate in the employee stock option program. title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (f/m/x)
description: Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO You will work on applications that use deep learning and satellite data and other data sources to help companies and governments fight deforestation, monitor critical infrastructure, and respond faster and more precisely to natural disasters. Our aim is to empower any user in the world to harness the power of earth observation satellites to simplify and improve their daily work. As one of the most senior engineers on our product team, you will architect, design and implement new features and refactorings from initial idea to production release and then monitoring and maintenance, often in temporary cross-functional squads. Concrete topics you would work on are, for example, the rendering and querying of large volumes of geospatial data efficiently in mobile app, browser and backend, writing the database queries that make that fast, implementing smart logic on this data and building integrations for the growing number of third-party consumers of our services. Your challenge Key responsibilities Build and extend features end-to-end that handle large volumes of geospatial data, with attention to UX and design Architect and build services that integrate large amounts of heterogenous data to enable users to prioritize a vast number of competing tasks Own the next major evolution of our public API Drive the continuous development of our agentic solutions Lead cross-functional teams, driving new feature developments from very early in a topic, through discovery, design, architecture to release and maintenance. Take real ownership How we work Our development lifecycle is a pragmatic scrumban: structured enough to coordinate, loose enough to move fast. Engineers here have real autonomy - you will make plenty of decisions yourself, and you will have senior engineers to think out loud with on the ones that carry more weight. Tickets with solid acceptance criteria become agentic specs that agents implement in test-driven setups. Code review is a mix of agent and human - whichever is most effective for the change at hand. description: Description Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on. 3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not. 4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough. Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster. A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. We know that person is rare, and we are not going to pretend otherwise by writing a wish list and hoping. So for this role we weight the technical evidence most heavily, because it is the hardest of the three to teach on the job. If you believe you genuinely combine all three, we want to talk to you regardless of how neatly your CV matches the bullets below. No bar admission required, no second Staatsexamen required. What we need: you have worked hands-on with German commercial contracts, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating them, and you can hold a conversation with a General Counsel as a peer. 3. Commercial and entrepreneurial track record. You have carried commercial responsibility for something of your own: a freelance client base, a legal tech product, or a company you started. You know what it takes to win a client from a standing start and why "they did not understand the value" is never the customer's fault. If instead you have supported enterprise sales teams in demos, pilots, and expert calls, tell us what you changed about the outcome. You prioritise by impact, you are comfortable deciding without permission, and you would rather ship something imperfect this week than something elegant next quarter. 4. Language. Excellent German and English. German is non-negotiable: our customers are DACH legal teams and the nuance lives in their language. You can run a room of legal buyers, ask the sharp question, and write a specification precise enough to build from. Other EU languages are a plus. Why us? Impact over hype. You define a new discipline at the intersection of law, product, and AI. Your work directly shapes how thousands of legal professionals will operate. No silos. You sit between Product, Engineering, and the customer, with a direct line to all three. The better argument wins, not the higher title. We invest in you. The enterprise motion (multi-stakeholder pilots, procurement cycles, security reviews) is teachable, and we teach it: side by side in real customer calls from week one. Real ownership. Competitive salary and employee stock options (ESOP). Build in public. We want you to keep publishing what you build, because it makes you better and it makes us visible. Offices in Berlin, Leipzig, and Zurich with a flexible hybrid setup. Regular apéros, lunches, and hiking trips as we enjoy the journey together. Process Expectations. A conversation with the People Manager about the role and who you are. Depth. A conversation with our General Counsel & Head of Legal AI on Legal Engineering at Legartis and where the legal market is going. Build session. A live case at the intersection of legal reasoning, prompting, and product work: a real customer scenario, a legal AI workflow, or a playbook that misbehaves. Meet the team in Leipzig or Berlin. Bei besonders guter Passung sind wir auch offen für qualifizierte Kandidaten aus anderen Teilen der EU. Die Einarbeitung findet vor Ort im Büro statt. Eine steile Lernkurve an der Schnittstelle von LLM-Engineering, GRC im Unternehmensumfeld und dem operativen Aufbau eines Start-ups. title: AI Engineer
description: Who we are Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce. Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants. For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible. Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel. We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label. Today, Lemrock is already: 100M+ conversations per month 150+ brand clients a $100B market structuring at high speed Context You'll join a tight-knit team with high product standards and direct access to production deployment : our models are tested in real-world conditions, with several million users each month, with very short cycles between prototyping, integration and deployment. Concretely, you will: Analyze large-scale conversational interaction datasets (100M+ events/month) to uncover behavioral patterns, intent signals, and performance drivers. Design and deploy agentic pipelines end-to-end , from data ingestion and enrichment to model orchestration, monitoring, and continuous improvement, integrated into systems exposed to millions of requests daily. Build autonomous agents that keep our knowledge infrastructure accurate and current. Translate insights into iteration loops in production , by updating, fine-tuning, and improving our existing recommendation and ranking algorithms with tight constraints on latency, robustness, and business outcomes. title: Research Scientist, Computational Enzymology
description: About us We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient. If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it. We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK. The role You'll simulate enzyme-catalysed reactions from the physics up. Using reactive and free-energy methods you'll map how reactions proceed in the active site, compute transition states and barriers, and work out where the catalysis actually comes from: why a step has the barrier it does, which residues do the work, and how mutations move it. You'll work with the wider simulation and ML teams, but also directly with our bench scientists — seeing your predictions tested in vitro and getting experimental feedback on fast, tight loops. What you'll do Characterise mechanisms, transition states, and activation barriers in the active site, and compare computed barriers against measured kinetics Pin down the origins of catalysis — the residues, interactions, and dynamics that set rate and selectivity — and use MD to understand how active-site motion shapes the reaction Turn results into concrete, testable proposals for the wet lab, and fold the resulting data back into your models Help physics-based and learned methods strengthen each other as we build them out Essential experience . Expertise in enzymatic reaction modelling using QM/MM and a variety of free energy methods A solid grasp of enzyme catalysis: mechanism, kinetics, cofactors, and how active-site chemistry and conformational dynamics sets rate and selectivity Sound judgement about method selection, good understanding o methodological limitations and computational cost Highly preferred Experience in protein design for enzymatic optimization You've run design–test–refine cycles with a wet lab before Experience with reactive machine-learned potentials, or coupling physics-based modelling with ML Logistics Compensation is highly competitive. We're also able to sponsor visas for the right candidate. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent Office Management (all genders)
description: Aufgaben Unser Office Management ist das Herzstück unseres Unternehmens – mit einem offenen Ohr, einem freundlichen Lächeln und einer guten Portion Organisationstalent sorgt ihr gemeinsam dafür, dass der Arbeitsalltag rundläuft, kleine und große Anliegen schnell gelöst werden und sich alle Kolleg:innen bei uns nicht nur unterstützt, sondern auch willkommen und wohlfühlen. Als Werkstudent:in im Office Management sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Teams nicht nur produktiv, sondern auch mit einem Lächeln durch den Tag gehen. Büroabläufe gestalten : Du unterstützt bei der effizienten Organisation unserer täglichen Büroabläufe (z. B. Catering, liebevolle Ausstattung der Konferenzräume oder die Pflege unserer Kaffeemaschinen). Erste Ansprechperson sein : Du bearbeitest selbstständig den Post- sowie E-Mail-Eingang und stehst unseren Kolleg:innen sowie externen Besucher:innen persönlich und telefonisch stets hilfsbereit zur Seite. Events mitgestalten : Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Umsetzung unserer internen Company Days – ob bei der Vorbereitung oder am Tag selbst: Gemeinsam sorgen wir dafür, dass aus einem normalen Arbeitstag etwas ganz Besonderes wird. Anforderungen Laufendes Studium: Du befindest Dich mitten im Studium, hast noch mindestens zwei Semester vor Dir und kannst uns mit ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche tatkräftig unterstützen. Positive Ausstrahlung: Deine gute Auffassungsgabe hilft Dir dabei, neue Herausforderungen mit einem Lächeln zu meistern, und durch Deine positive Einstellung trägst Du zu einem tollen Miteinander bei. Service im Blut: Deine Arbeitsweise zeichnet sich insbesondere durch eine hohe Serviceorientierung und ein ausgeprägtes Auge fürs Detail aus. Selbstständigkeit: Du bist strukturiert, zuverlässig und packst Aufgaben gerne eigeninitiativ an. Kommunikationsstärke: Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- sowie solide Englischkenntnisse mit und hast Spaß daran, Neues dazuzulernen. Was wir bieten Raum zu wachsen // Bleib neugierig: In regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen gestaltest Du gemeinsam mit Deiner Führungskraft Deinen ganz persönlichen Entwicklungspfad. Hinzu kommen informative Workshops, die Dir neuen Input geben und Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung fördern. Mentale und körperliche Gesundheit // Bleib gesund & aktiv : Wir möchten, dass es Dir gut geht und unterstützen Deine Gesundheit durch eine vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club. Zusätzlich steht unser Kooperationspartner “Fürstenberg Institut” Dir und Deinen Familienangehörigen mit Rat und Tat zur Seite, wenn es um mentale Gesundheit & Coaching geht. Verantwortungsbewusstsein // We #care: Um unsere Welt ein kleines bisschen besser zu machen, fördert unser ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) unser Bewusstsein für umweltschonendes Verhalten. Zusätzlich arbeiten wir mit JobRad, bieten ein vergünstigtes BVG Ticket an und unterstützen bei unserem jährlichen Social Day tatkräftig soziale Projekte in Berlin. Wir packen mit an, um unserem Planeten und unseren Mitmenschen etwas zurückzugeben. Teamspirit // Bleib vernetzt: Was uns antreibt, ist unser Gemeinschaftsgefühl. Deshalb veranstalten wir regelmäßig unseren Company-Office-Day, an dem alle zusammenkommen. Neben einem umfassenden Update unseres C-Boards steht hier vor allem das Miteinander und der Austausch im Fokus. title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
description: Responsibilities We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth. Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network. At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain. As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business. As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem. You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities. You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems. You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability. You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly. You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption. You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes. Skills Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus). Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics. Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools. Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels. Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation. Business fluency in both English and German is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff. What we offer Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries. Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development. Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching. Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back. Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together. Transparency // We want to be transparent, also when it comes to salary: If you have any questions about a possible salary range for this position, feel free to send us an email at ----- We will get back to you as soon as possible. title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description: What we are building ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others. Why This Role Matters You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows. You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters. What you will work on Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
