description: <div class="content-intro"><p data-start="734" data-end="1060">At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.</p> <p data-start="1065" data-end="1360">That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0">That's</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0"> why </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0">we're</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0"> looking for people who are</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0"> bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0">what's</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0"> possible, and committed to delivering results.</span></p> <p data-start="1065" data-end="1360">Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our <a href="https://www.onestream.com/careers/" target="_blank">Careers site</a> to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.</p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>Account Director, France</strong></p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>The Account Director is responsible for the sale of OneStream SaaS solutions within a specified territory.<br>OneStream is looking for an experienced, proactive sales professional to manage and grow existing customer relationships through subscription renewals and expansion, uplifts and cross-selling of additional solutions. The role will be responsible for strategic planning and account management across a designated sales territory and will be expected to take full ownership within this territory. Account Directors are to successfully retain and grow the existing solution footprint and meet and ideally exceed assigned quota. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of SaaS sales and a proven track record in sales within an existing account base.</p> <p><strong>Primary Duties & Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Opportunity Identification:</strong> Proactively identify new sales opportunities within the existing customer base by understanding their evolving needs and challenges and OneStream’s value proposition.</li> <li><strong>Upselling and Cross-Selling:</strong> Introduce additional products or services that meet the evolving needs of our customers, driving upsell and cross-sell opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Internal Reporting:</strong> CRM knowledge transfer, sales pipeline management, and proposal preparation.</li> <li><strong>Self-Sourced Pipeline:</strong> Grow pipeline via direct efforts / prospecting, as well as via business partners such as Customer Success, Business Development, Marketing, and Alliances.</li> <li><strong>Be Business Partner to your Customers:</strong> Provide proactive and consultative guidance that will add value to their business objectives, ensuring high retention and net revenue growth for OneStream. This is executed by developing a thorough understanding of your customers' position in the market, their product/service, points of difference and competitive landscape.</li> <li><strong>Position OneStream:</strong> Articulately and effectively convey the OneStream value proposition via written, virtual and in-person presentations, by leveraging custom business cases, marketing assets and customer success stories.</li> <li><strong>Enable your Customer Champions:</strong> Prepare joint business cases that align prospects and customers’ business objectives with OneStream’s solutions and value proposition and leverage them in sales cycles to establish and build alignment to support revenue generation.</li> <li><strong>Achieve sales targets:</strong> Develop and execute business plans to achieve sales targets.</li> <li>Accurately track and forecast sales opportunities.</li> <li>Grow pipeline via direct efforts / prospecting, as well as via business partners such as Customer Success, Business Development, Marketing, and Alliances.</li> <li>Ensure timely and accurate knowledge transfer across internal teams, such as Business Development, Pre-Sales, Alliances, and Customer Success, as well as to external collaborators such as Customers, Prospects, and Alliance Partners.</li> <li>Assess prospects and customers’ needs for OneStream offerings via research, discovery sessions and solution demonstrations.</li> <li>Prepare joint business cases that align prospects and customers’ business objectives with OneStream’s solutions and value proposition and leverage them in sales cycles to establish and build alignment to support revenue generation.</li> <li>Prepare proposals and SaaS agreements to prospects and customers to drive sales.</li> <li>Identify opportunities for OneStream use case expansion within customer accounts to drive additional revenue.</li> <li>Develop comprehensive proposals in response to client and prospect requests.</li> <li>Actively role model sales professionalism, may engage as a coach and mentor across the Sales teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Education & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum 5-10 years’ experience as a sales manager, sales representative or a related occupation specifically in B2B selling across the Enterprise accounts.</li> <li>Proven track record in hitting quota and retention targets.</li> <li>Organized, detail-oriented with the ability to prioritize and respond quickly.</li> <li>Negotiation skills as it relates to renewals, upsell, cross-selling and additional solution add-ons.</li> <li>Highly proficient in MS Office Suite, and CRM systems.</li> <li>Experience working in a consultative capacity with C-level customers on complex SaaS solutions.</li> <li>Extensive customer service experience in assessing and evaluating customer needs and satisfaction and meeting specified standards with respect to products and services.</li> <li>Exceptional oral and written comprehension, communication and presentation skills.</li> <li>Experience demonstrating, promoting, and selling products/services.</li> <li>Knowledge and experience with marketing/sales strategy and tactics.</li> <li>Knowledge of administration, business, and management principles.</li> <li>Experience with MS Office and SFDC, and other analytical or project management tools.</li> <li>Extensive experience working in a team environment.</li> <li>Track record of exceeding revenue goals.</li> <li>Fluent in French and English is a must.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Education & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>University Degree or College Diploma in Sales, Business Administration, Marketing or a related field.</li> <li>Prior sales experience in the software industry, especially within the CPM/EPM industry.</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce is preferred.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Accounting, Finance and Corporate Performance Management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Knowledge, Skills & Abilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Professional.</li> <li>Strategic.</li> <li>Capable of building rapport with C-level executives and customers.</li> <li>Highly organized.</li> <li>Tech-savvy.</li> <li>Ability to understand and react to customer needs.</li> <li>Willingness to travel.</li> <li>Flexible and adaptable.</li> <li>Goal driven.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-MS1 For nearly a century, we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on, trusted, proven, essential. description: <h4>Why Cast AI?</h4> <p>Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.<br><br><strong>Unicorn momentum</strong></p> <p>In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.</p> <p><strong>Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.</strong></p> <h4>About the role</h4> <p>Throughput. Latency. KV cache utilization.</p> <p>Move those three numbers in the right direction, and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every kernel you tune, every quantization scheme you ship, every scheduler tweak you land shows up directly in a customer's p99 and on our P&L.<br>This is a high-impact seat. It is also a high-autonomy seat as you'll be given the room to lead the technical direction of inference optimization at Kimchi, not execute someone else's roadmap.</p> <p><strong>The problem: </strong>running LLMs in production is a moving target. The "right" model and serving configuration for a workload depend on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, quantization tolerance, and a dozen other variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a model once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. Kimchi is the system that makes that decision automatically - continuously matching workloads to the most cost-efficient, best-performing LLM and serving configuration on a customer's infrastructure. We're building the optimization layer between the model and the hardware, and we need engineers who understand both sides deeply.</p> <p><strong>Stack</strong></p> <p>Python; vLLM; SGLang; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; gRP; ClickHouse; PostgreSQL; GCP Pub/Sub; AWS / GCP / Azure; GitLab CI; ArgoCD; Prometheus; Grafana; Loki; Tempo.</p> <h4>Requirements:</h4> <ul> <li>5+ years building real ML systems, with a portfolio that shows depth in inference or training infrastructure (not just model training notebooks).</li> <li>Strong Python - production services, not scripts.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with at least one of vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM, and a working mental model of why an inference engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.</li> <li>Fluency with quantization tradeoffs - you've measured quality regressions, not just compression ratios.</li> <li>Comfort with distributed systems: collective communication, sharding strategies, and the practical failure modes of multi-GPU and multi-node setups.</li> <li>A bias toward measurement. You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell the difference between a real win and a benchmark artifact.</li> <li>Self-direction. This role comes with a wide mandate; you should be excited by that, not unsettled by it.</li> </ul> <h4>Responsibilities:</h4> <ul> <li>Push throughput. Continuous batching, speculative decoding, chunked prefill, kernel-level tuning across vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.</li> <li>Cut latency. Attack TTFT and TPOT separately. Profile, identify the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, networking), and fix it - not the bottleneck you assumed.</li> <li>Get more out of the KV cache. Paged attention, prefix caching, eviction policies, cache reuse across requests, quantized KV. This is where a lot of the unrealized throughput lives, and it's an area you'll own.</li> <li>Quantize without regressing quality. INT8, INT4, FP8 across weights, activations, and KV. Empirical work: measure quality on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.</li> <li>Shrink cold starts and memory footprint. Faster init, smarter weight loading, tighter memory accounting - the difference between a model that scales and one that doesn't.</li> <li>Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck on storage or interconnect.</li> <li>Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible experiments.</li> </ul> <h4>What’s in it for you?</h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).</li> <li>Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.</li> <li>Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology</li> <li>Equity options.</li> <li>Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.</li> <li>Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement. </li> <li>Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.</li> <li>Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.</li> <li>Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.</li> <li>Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.</li> <li>Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.</li> </ul> <h4>Hiring process</h4> <ul> <li>Screening call with Recruiter</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Technical interview (system design)</li> <li>Live coding</li> <li>Culture Check interview with an executive</li> </ul> <p><em>As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.</em><br><em>Please note that Cast AI </em><u><em>does not</em></u><em> provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.</em></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote</span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Recruitment Fraud Alert</strong></p> <p>We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.</li> </ul> <p>If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at <u><a ---------- <p> </p> <p><strong>About Commvault</strong> </p> <p>Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data. </p></div><p>The Cloud Resilience Account Executive (CRAE) is responsible for achieving quota by selling Commvault Cloud SaaS solutions in cloud-centric environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) into a defined territory that includes current Commvault customers and prospects. The position is an overlay field sales role where the CRAE is responsible for supporting Enterprise and Commercial Segment Account Executives face to face or virtually on sales meetings. This role will align to multiple Sales Leaders, supporting opportunities from their territories and leading specific stages during the sales process (e.g. demos, POCs, TCO discussions, etc).  </p> <p>The CRAE must have the ability to articulate an in-depth discussion, starting from understanding the end user’s cloud environment, current challenges/goals, and align Commvault SaaS solutions to those challenges/goals including a financial and strategic value proposition.  </p> <p>The ideal candidate will demonstrate a strong hunter mentality and expertise in managing complex sales cycles from prospecting to purchase order closure. description: <p><strong>OVERVIEW:<br></strong></p> <div>We're looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to help build the technology that support Gymshark's global growth. Working with industry best tools including Golang, Event-Driven Architecture, and AWS Serverless technologies such as Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, and DynamoDB, you'll design and deliver scalable solutions that support key business priorities. As part of a Tech function you will work with Product Engineering, Data Engineering, Operations, Platform Engineering and Delivery, playing a key role in building both customer-facing and internal products that drive the business forward.</div> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:</strong></p> <div> <ul> <li>Leading technical implementations of projects to help your team deliver high-quality work on time</li> <li>Using Golang to design, build and maintain APIs, services and integrations</li> <li>Implementing event driven solutions to support critical business processes</li> <li>Creating, maintaining and developing CI/CD pipelines</li> <li>Building scalable and valuable software leveraging AWS Serverless technologies such as; Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB</li> <li>Focus on creating testable, maintainable and scalable code, following Engineering standards</li> <li>Following an Agile development approach</li> <li>Maintaining existing services, ensuring a high standard of observability and proactive monitoring, in addition to responding to incidents. We’re an equal opportunities employer, and for us that means we always strive to be as inclusive as possible in all aspects of employment, right from your application. We believe that putting the sweat in today, prepares us for tomorrow. So, we give people the tools they need to reach further, go faster, be stronger. We celebrate those who show up – for themselves – to be their physical or mental best, whatever that means for them. It’s what we want for our community, and our team. A team that’s growing rapidly around the world. A collective of talented individuals working together to invent Gymshark’s future. Our plans are ambitious, and we’re looking for people who want to join us for the ride – our growth will be your growth.</p> <p><strong>THE PERKS.</strong></p> <p>Standard benefits include:</p> <ul> <li>Performance-based Bonus opportunity</li> <li>Funded Healthcare benefit</li> <li>25 days holiday, additional day for your birthday & Bank Holidays</li> <li>Contributory Employer pension scheme</li> <li>Flexible benefits programme – including salary sacrifice EV scheme, dental insurance, cycle to work, tech scheme, holiday trading</li> <li>Gymshark Employee Discount & long service awards</li> <li>Access to High Street cashback and discounts</li> <li>Financial, Physical and Mental Wellbeing Support</li> <li>Enhanced Family Leave package</li> <li>Life Assurance</li> </ul> <p>Office location specific benefits include (IQ):</p> <ul> <li>Gym Membership to The Lifting Club (LC)</li> <li>Onsite lunch provision & coffee bars</li> <li>EV charge points available</li> </ul> <p><strong>Note:</strong> The bonus program and benefits have certain eligibility requirements. Gymshark reserves the right to amend these programs in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Quality Assurance Coordinator - Product Integrity - 12 Month FCT
description: <div> <p class="x_xmsonormal"><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">THE ROLE.</span></strong></p> </div> <div> <div> <p>At Gymshark, we're committed to creating products that perform, fit flawlessly and exceed expectations. As a <strong>Product Integrity Quality Coordinator</strong>, you'll play a vital role in ensuring every product is ready for launch by driving quality excellence throughout the product development journey.</p> <p>Working within either our Men's, Women's or Seamless category, you'll partner with Product Development, Materials, Regional Quality teams and global suppliers to ensure products are safe, compliant and manufactured to the highest standards. From identifying potential risks during development to validating bulk fabrics and approving pre-production samples, you'll help make sure every detail is right before production begins.</p> </div> </div> <div> <h4 class="x_xmsonormal">WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING.</h4> <div> <h4>Drive Product Quality from Development to Production</h4> <ul> <li>Support the Quality Assurance Manager in delivering description: <div class="content-intro"><p data-start="734" data-end="1060">At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.</p> <p data-start="1065" data-end="1360">That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0">That's</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0"> why </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0">we're</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0"> looking for people who are</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0"> bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0">what's</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW130164568 BCX0"> possible, and committed to delivering results.</span></p> <p data-start="1065" data-end="1360">Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our <a href="https://www.onestream.com/careers/" target="_blank">Careers site</a> to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.</p></div><p><strong>Senior Account Director, UK</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>A Senior Account Director is responsible for driving new business growth within a defined territory. The role is focused on identifying, developing, and closing net-new customer opportunities, with a strategic emphasis on expanding OneStream’s footprint into untapped markets and organizations. The Senior Account Director will take full ownership of pipeline generation and progression, leveraging a consultative, value-based sales approach to demonstrate how OneStream’s SaaS platform addresses complex business needs. This role will be responsible for engaging C-level stakeholders, navigating enterprise sales cycles, and building strong, trust-based relationships with prospective clients.</p> <p>Success in this role requires a self-starter with exceptional prospecting capabilities, a deep understanding of the financial and operational challenges facing modern enterprises, and a passion for winning new business. The Senior Account Director will collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Pre-Sales, Business Development, and Strategic Alliances to maximize market reach and accelerate deal velocity. While some collaboration with existing accounts may occur, the primary focus of this role is new logo acquisition and revenue growth.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Primary Duties and Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>New Business Development</strong>: Drive new logo acquisition through strategic prospecting, outbound outreach, marketing leads, and partner referrals.</li> <li><strong>Account Expansion</strong>: Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities by understanding evolving customer needs and aligning them with OneStream’s solutions.</li> <li><strong>Pipeline Generation</strong>: Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through self-sourced efforts and collaboration with Customer Success, Business Development, Marketing, and Alliances.</li> <li><strong>Salesforce Hygiene: </strong>Maintain clean, accurate, and up-to-date Salesforce records to support data-driven decision making, forecast accuracy, and cross-functional alignment.</li> <li><strong>Sales Execution</strong>: Prepare and present tailored business cases, proposals, and SaaS agreements that align customer objectives with OneStream’s value proposition.</li> <li><strong>Quota Achievement</strong>: Balance new business and existing account growth to meet or exceed sales targets.</li> <li><strong>Customer Partnership</strong>: Serve as a consultative partner, delivering insights and value that support long-term customer success and retention.</li> <li><strong>Value Communication</strong>: Clearly articulate OneStream’s differentiators through compelling written, virtual, and in-person presentations.</li> <li><strong>Opportunity Management</strong>: Accurately track and forecast sales opportunities while ensuring timely knowledge transfer across internal teams and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Needs Assessment</strong>: Conduct discovery sessions, research, and demos to assess and align OneStream offerings with client challenges.</li> <li><strong>Proposal Development</strong>: Create high-impact proposals and responses to client requests, supporting revenue growth, and strategic alignment.</li> <li><strong>Cross Functional Leadership</strong>: Contribute to key internal initiatives (e.g. sales enablement, process improvement and may deputise for the Sales Director as needed.</li> <li><strong>Mentorship & Sales Excellence</strong>: Lead by example through professional and collaborative selling, mentor team members on sales best practices, and support employee engagement initiatives.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Required Education and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of B2B sales experience, with a strong focus on new business; high-potential candidates with less experience will also be considered.</li> <li>Demonstrated success in consultative software sales focused within banking or financial services sector, navigating complex and regulated environments, engaging senior‑level stakeholders, and aligning solutions to banking operational, regulatory, and financial priorities.</li> <li>Proven track record of consistently exceeding quotas through net-new customer acquisition.</li> <li>Demonstrated success in prospecting, pipeline generation, and closing complex deals.</li> <li>Hunter mindset with ability to drive outbound efforts and convert leads from multiple channels.</li> <li>Skilled at articulating solution value to senior stakeholders and navigating multi-threaded sales cycles.</li> <li>Strong command of sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or Challenger to manage complex sales cycles.</li> <li>Strategic thinker with business acumen to align solutions with customer pain points and goals.</li> <li>Comfortable operating independently in fast-paced, high-growth environments.</li> <li>Experienced in collaborating with Marketing, Product, Business Development, and Pre-Sales to accelerate deal velocity.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Preferred Education and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>University Degree or College Diploma in Sales, Business Administration, Marketing or a related field.</li> <li>Prior sales experience in the SaaS industry, especially within the CPM / EPM industry or financial software space.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrates a strategic mindset with a focus on long-term value creation.</li> <li>Team first mindset.</li> <li>High degree of ownership and autonomy.</li> <li>Consistently driven by goals and measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Maintains a strong customer-centric approach across all initiatives.</li> <li>Possesses strong commercial acumen and sound business acumen to drive sustainable growth.</li> <li>Proven ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with C-level executives and key stakeholders.</li> <li>Adept at identifying, understanding, and proactively responding to evolving customer needs.</li> <li>Highly flexible and adaptable, with the ability to navigate complex and changing environments.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-MS1</p> <p>#LI-REMOTE</p> title: Senior IT Technician
description: The Opportunity Lumai's engineers, scientists and office team all run on the same basic kit: a working machine, the accounts they sign in with, the software they need, and a room they can take a call from. It gets set up by hand today, around someone else's day job, and the team is growing quickly. That is the job. You would take the manual work out of setting people up and keeping them running - the machine build, the accounts, the software, the meeting rooms - and make it repeatable enough that a new joiner's first morning is kit and access that already works. The Role What you own. You will own Lumai's day-to-day IT end to end: the device fleet and how each machine is built and secured, the identity and accounts people sign in with, the software and licences we run, and the Oxford office's network, printers and meeting-room kit. You are the person the team comes to when something does not work, and the person who has a new joiner ready before their first morning. What is genuinely hard about it. You are the only person doing this, so nothing arrives with a process around it. The estate is small enough that every fix is one you make yourself, and busy enough that the same fix should never be needed twice. Your users are engineers who can often solve their own problem and should not have to, and the security and access rules have to hold without slowing any of them down. The hardest part is not the technology: it is that the answer you give at four o'clock on a Friday, with nobody to check it, has to be right. By month six , you will have an asset record that matches what is actually on the desks, an onboarding and offboarding routine that runs the same way every time, a standard machine build and software catalogue rather than a shelf of one-offs, and networking and meeting rooms reliable enough that nobody mentions them. What You'll Do Own the device fleet end to end: order, build, secure, hand over and recover laptops and desktops, and keep the asset record accurate from order to return. Set and run the standard machine build, so two machines of the same kind are set up the same way. Run identity and accounts: create, change, close and audit accounts and groups, and keep access right for leavers as well as joiners. Be the escalation point for day-to-day IT: proactively identify, diagnose and resolve hardware, operating system, application and connectivity problems across the team. Look after the Oxford office's networking and meeting-room kit - Wi-Fi, wired ports, printers, screens and video calls - so a room works the first time. Manage the software and licence estate: what is installed, who holds a licence, what renews when, and what it costs. Run the IT side of onboarding and offboarding with Talent and the Office Manager, so kit and access are ready before day one and closed off when someone leaves. Partner across the company to champion AI adoption and drive automation, eliminating manual toil. You will build scalable workflows using custom agents, scripts, and API integrations. Cover desk IT only: laptops, desktops, peripherals, accounts, software, office connectivity and meeting-room kit, with lab, test-bench and specialist engineering equipment owned outside this role. What We're Looking For Must-have Hands-on IT support in a fast-moving company, where you owned the estate rather than working a queue inside someone else's process. Experience managing and scaling SaaS and core collaboration tools across the business, as it scales. Confident across end-user machines - building them, securing them, fixing them - on our platforms macOS and Windows. Practical experience with identity and device management: an identity provider, an MDM, or both. Office networking and AV that hold up in practice: Wi-Fi, wired ports, printers and meeting-room video. Clear communication - you will spend as much time explaining a fix to someone who is not technical as you will making it. Strong preference for Experience in a deep-tech, hardware environment, where some of the machines are attached to equipment rather than a desk. Experience supporting engineers' own machines and development environments, without owning the engineering platform itself. Having set up a device fleet, an identity platform or an MDM from scratch rather than only maintaining one. Proficiency in scripting languages to eliminate repetitive setup, patching, and reporting workflows. About Lumai Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics. In April 2026 we launched Iris Nova, the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time, using up to 90% less energy than conventional GPU-based systems. Iris Nova, the first server in the family, is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions. Aura and Tetra will follow. Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford. Why Lumai You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume. Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run. You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description. The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry. You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work. Equal Opportunity Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, let us know and we will do our best to support you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director of First Line Operations - AML, PTM, CB, Fraud
description: <h2><span style="color: rgb(35, 111, 161);">Why Verifone</span></h2> <p>For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.</p> <p>Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.</p> <p>Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. Currently, we do allow a hybrid work schedule but we regularly revisit our attendance policy.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(35, 111, 161);">What's Exciting About The Role</span></h2> <p>This is a rare opportunity to step into a senior leadership position at the heart of Verifone’s global payments ecosystem. You will shape operational risk management across four regulated payment entities, influence the future of our payments & financial services strategy, and drive automation and continuous improvement at scale. For an experienced operational risk leader, this role offers the chance to modernise first‑line operations, strengthen controls, and contribute directly to how a renowned, established company continues to grow its presence in the UK/EU market.</p> <p><em>Whilst our preferred office location for you to be close to is Munich, we are open to considering candidates located near to our Bad Hersfeld, Helsinki, and Bucharest office too.</em></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities </strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage all first line activities across the four Verifone payment entities, covering the description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions(internally called EventBus) and future streaming platform technologies. These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.</p> <p>Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:</p> <ul> <li> teams across US and EU regions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Help shape the long-term architecture and evolution of Deliveroo’s event streaming platform.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Need to Thrive</strong></h2> <p>Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Strong hands-on experience building or operating distributed systems in production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming systems, either as a platform, infrastructure service or critical production dependency.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable production systems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience operating scalable production infrastructure, including debugging, troubleshooting and improving reliability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, observability, capacity management and operational excellence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Good fundamentals in Linux, networking and JVM-based systems, or curiosity to deepen expertise in these areas.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across platform, infrastructure and product engineering teams.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to have</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p>Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with JVM tuning, broker tuning, partition management or Cruise Control.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with tiered storage, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></h2> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.</p> <p>We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:</p> <p>🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale<br>Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.</p> <p>🌱 See your impact, fast<br>Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.</p> <p>🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership<br>Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.</p> <p>🌎 A culture built for builders<br>High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.</p> <p>💰 Share in the success you help create<br>Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.</p> <p>➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our <a href="https://deliveroo.engineering/">Tech Blog</a>.</p> <p>We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine, our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. <a href="https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/interview-guide-for-engineers/">Explore our Engineering Interview Guide</a> to help you feel confident at each stage.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. title: Director, International Privacy Lead and Data Protection Officer
description: <p><strong>Director, International Privacy Lead & Data Protection Officer</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Alnylam is seeking an experienced privacy and data protection leader to serve as Director, International Privacy Lead & Data Protection Officer. Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Privacy, AI Governance, Training & Communications within Ethics & Compliance, this role will lead Alnylam’s international privacy program, with primary responsibility for Europe (EU/EEA, United Kingdom, and Switzerland) and support for broader international markets.</p> <p>As Alnylam’s formally appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO) under applicable European and Swiss privacy laws, the Director will provide independent privacy oversight, advise the business on data protection obligations, and maintain direct access and escalation channels to senior leadership for material privacy risks.</p> <p>This individual contributor will be expected to serve as a proactive partner to the our international business, anticipating privacy and data protection obligations driven by regulatory change and business growth, and translating those requirements into actionable guidance for policies, operations and ways of working.</p> <p>The successful candidate will partner closely with Legal, Information Security, IT, HR, Commercial, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Pharmacovigilance, Procurement, Ethics & Compliance, and other business stakeholders to enable responsible use of personal data while strengthening privacy governance, risk management, and business adoption across international markets.</p> <p>Hybrid role preferably based in Zug, Switzerland. Also open to candidates based in Madrid, Spain or Maidenhead, UK.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and mature Alnylam’s international privacy program, with primary focus on Europe and support for broader international markets, by setting program priorities, strengthening governance frameworks, and ensuring privacy requirements are embedded into business planning, policies, controls, and day-to-day operations.</li> <li>Serve as Alnylam’s appointed DPO under EU GDPR, UK GDPR, and applicable Swiss data protection requirements, providing independent advice, monitoring compliance, maintaining required independence, and acting as the primary point of contact for supervisory authorities and data subjects.</li> <li>Oversee privacy risk identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring, and escalation processes, including privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default requirements, DPIAs, TIAs, Records of Processing Activities (ROPA), cross-border transfer assessments, and related governance documentation.</li> <li>Advise business and functional leaders on privacy requirements related to clinical research, pharmacovigilance, commercial operations, medical affairs, human resources, patient support programs, real-world evidence, AI, and other data-driven initiatives.</li> <li>Partner with Information Security, Legal, Procurement, and business stakeholders on privacy incident response, breach assessment, third-party privacy risk management, data protection terms, data sharing arrangements, remediation, and regulatory notification decisions.</li> <li>Proactively monitor the European and international privacy, AI, digital, cyber and data governance legislative landscape, anticipating compliance impacts from business growth and regulatory change, and rapidly translating new or changing requirements into practical updates to policies, controls, business processes, training, and operational Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches. Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor. Technical experience: Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects. title: Customer Success Associate - Renewable Energy
description: Customer Success Associate – Renewable Energy Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Unsere Mission für dich Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen und werde Teil unseres wachsenden Customer-Success-Teams. trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie auf. Unsere Mission ist es, Industrieunternehmen mit nachhaltigen Energielösungen zu versorgen. Mit unserem integrierten Ansatz aus Energieversorgung, moderner Energiemanagementsoftware und intelligenter Optimierung des Energieverbrauchs helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, wettbewerbsfähig zu bleiben und den Weg in eine klimafreundliche Energiezukunft zu ebnen. Als Customer Success Associate unterstützt du unsere Kund:innen dabei, den vollen Mehrwert aus unserem nachhaltigen Produktportfolio zu ziehen. Du sorgst für eine reibungslose Betreuung, koordinierst wichtige Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich mit trawa arbeiten. Das Team Unser Customer Success Team begleitet Kund:innen von der ersten Anfrage bis zur langfristigen Partnerschaft – mit dem Ziel, echten Mehrwert zu liefern, Wachstum im Bestand zu treiben und exzellenten Service zu skalieren. Wir stehen unseren Kund:innen nicht nur operativ zur Seite, sondern beraten sie auch aktiv zu Fragen rund um den Energiemarkt – damit sie in einem komplexen, volatilen Umfeld die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen können. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Product und Operations zusammen und bist mittendrin, wenn es darum geht, wie trawa seine Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich macht. Deine Aufgaben Kundenbetreuung: Du betreust unsere Kund:innen persönlich und sorgst dafür, dass sie langfristig zufrieden und erfolgreich mit unseren Produkten arbeiten. Onboarding begleiten: Du unterstützt neue Kund:innen bei ihrem Einstieg in das trawa-Universum, koordinierst den Onboarding-Prozess und begleitest die Einführung unserer Softwarelösungen. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass alle benötigten Informationen vorliegen und die richtigen Ansprechpartner:innen eingebunden sind. Teamübergreifend arbeiten: Gemeinsam mit unseren Kolleg:innen aus Product und Sales gestaltest du eine Customer Experience, die unsere Kund:innen begeistert. Kundenanfragen bearbeiten: Du bearbeitest und priorisierst eingehende Kundenanfragen, löst Probleme zeitnah und eigenständig oder leitest sie strukturiert an die zuständige Customer Success Managerin weiter. Datenqualität sicherstellen: Du pflegst Kundendaten in unseren Systemen, zum Beispiel im CRM, und stellst durch sorgfältige Arbeit eine hohe Datenqualität sicher. Reports und QBRs vorbereiten: Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung, Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung interner Meetings, Kunden-QBRs und relevanter Reportings. Nach wem wir suchen Dein Hintergrund Du hast ein Studium in einem relevanten Fachbereich oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit guten Leistungen abgeschlossen. Erste Erfahrungen in der Betreuung von B2B-Kund:innen, in analytischen Tätigkeiten oder in koordinativen Rollen sind von Vorteil. Deine Fähigkeiten Du bist ein Organisationstalent, arbeitest strukturiert, behältst den Überblick und kannst Aufgaben effizient priorisieren. Du verfügst über exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten und gehst professionell sowie serviceorientiert auf Kund:innen zu – schriftlich und mündlich. Du denkst analytisch, fühlst dich im Umgang mit Zahlen wohl und kannst datenbasierte Erkenntnisse sicher und verständlich kommunizieren. Dein technisches Verständnis Du bist technologieaffin. CRM-Systeme und digitale Tools sind für dich keine Hürde, sondern eine spannende Herausforderung. Erste Erfahrungen in der Energiebranche sind ein Plus. Idealerweise interessierst du dich für erneuerbare Energien und möchtest dich in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln. Deine Sprachkenntnisse Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau. Du verfügst über fließende Englischkenntnisse. Weitere europäische Sprachen sind von Vorteil. Deine ersten 90 Tage: Monat 1: Einarbeitung und Orientierung Du lernst trawas Produkte, Prozesse und den Energiemarkt kennen. Du verstehst, wie Kundenbeziehungen bei trawa funktionieren – vom Onboarding bis zum QBR. Du baust erste Beziehungen zu Kund:innen und internen Stakeholdern auf. Du wirst von erfahrenen Customer Success Manager:innen begleitet und übernimmst erste eigene Aufgaben in der Kundenbetreuung. Monat 2: Erste Verantwortung übernehmen Du übernimmst eigenständig erste Kundenaccounts und wirst zur verlässlichen Ansprechperson für operative Stakeholder. Du arbeitest mit bestehenden Playbooks, QBR-Vorlagen und Tools und wirst zunehmend sicherer in der selbstständigen Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen und -themen. Monat 3 und danach: Eigenständige Kundenbetreuung Du verantwortest ein eigenes Portfolio an Bestandskund:innen end to end. Du erkennst Upselling- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir unsere Kund:innen noch besser betreuen und ihre Erfahrungen mit trawa weiter verbessern können. Warum wir? Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt haben. Dein Impact: Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unserem dynamischen Team und gestaltest aktiv innovative Produkte und Kundenerlebnisse, die die Energiewende vorantreiben und zur Dekarbonisierung des Mittelstands beitragen. Dein Beitrag hat direkten Einfluss, und du kannst stolz auf deine Ergebnisse sein. Flexibles Arbeiten: In unserem schönen Büro fördern wir eine lebendige Unternehmenskultur, in der wir gerne gemeinsam arbeiten. Homeoffice ist ebenfalls möglich. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Urlaubstagen und bis zu zehn Workation-Tagen unterstützen wir deine Work-Life-Balance. Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, eine Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft, reichlich kostenlose Snacks und ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget. Persönliche Entwicklung: Du wirst Teil eines tollen Teams, in dem Coaching und Mentoring großgeschrieben werden. Außerdem arbeitest du mit modernen Technologien und lernst von erfahrenen Expert:innen aus der Branche. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen. Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein, der Vielfalt wertschätzt, und ermutigen Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft sowie körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung. Wenn du strategisch denkst, operativ stark bist und gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bewirb dich jetzt! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst: Wir sind offen für Persönlichkeiten mit Potenzial und Leidenschaft. Über uns Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wie machen wir das? Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen. Wir professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Chief Technology Officer (all identities)
description: What to Expect Caspar Health is entering its next growth phase. Our digital care is becoming increasingly critical to clinic and hospital operations. At the same time, we are progressing towards medical-device obligations and expanding AI-enabled ways of working. As CTO, you will own Technology and Engineering at C-level. You will report to the CEO, lead Engineering with full functional and disciplinary responsibility and work as a peer to the CPO. Your job is not to become the bottleneck or Caspar's most important individual technologist. You will build a strong leadership layer and an Engineering system that moves quickly with security, resilience and evidence. You will stay close enough to technology to judge important decisions, risks and AI-enabled development through current practice. This position is based in Germany and must be performed, living in Germany. Due to our current payroll and social security arrangements, we cannot offer permanent employment from abroad. Applicants must therefore be able to perform their duties from Germany starting on their first day of work and must already have the necessary authorization to work in Germany. Your Challenges Translate company and product strategy into a technology strategy with clear capabilities, investments, risks and measurable 18-month proof points. Lead all Engineering teams and Engineering leads, including Platform, Infrastructure, DevOps/SRE, developer experience and Engineering-owned quality automation. Build a strong leadership layer , clear domain ownership, distributed knowledge and resilient internal and external capacity without single-person dependencies. Own architecture, technology choices, reliability, security implementation, technical evidence and reporting, and regulated development for critical clinic and hospital workflows. Keep Caspar ready for deep technical scrutiny with current architecture and ownership evidence, demonstrable Caspar IP ownership, auditable security and compliance evidence, a credible AI story and no critical single-person dependencies. Own the incident system and lead major or trust-critical escalations. You are not the standing first-line on-call engineer. Ensure postmortem actions are completed and verified. Plan the Engineering budget and capacity . Decide within the approved envelope on technology, vendors and build, buy or outsource options, including lifecycle cost and continuity. Shape AI-enabled Engineering through current personal practice. Create measurable leverage without weakening security, maintainability, review quality, traceability or regulated assurance. Make credible commitments with Product . Product owns outcomes and scope intent. You own technical feasibility, capacity and release readiness, and stop unsupported or unsafe commitments. Involve Medical, Quality, Information Security, Privacy and Legal early . Engineering turns requirements into reusable controls, tests and evidence. Independent functions retain review, stop and risk-acceptance rights. Establish clear data contracts with Data . Technology owns production and operational data systems. Data owns semantics, certified analytical datasets, metric governance, analytical quality, experimentation and decision science. Represent Caspar in high-stakes technical discussions with clinics, hospital IT, integration partners, auditors, investors and the board. What success looks like In your first year, you will: Build a strong Engineering leadership layer and accountable ownership for critical systems Connect technology choices and investment to company strategy and reviewable proof points, then complete a deep external technical review at customer, auditor or investor standard with no unresolved material findings Improve delivery predictability, release quality, resilience and regulated evidence Make cooperation between Engineering, Infrastructure and independent Security durable and effective Create measurable impact through AI-enabled Engineering without weakening security or quality Your Profile You have managed multiple Engineering leaders and led a multi-team organization through a meaningful scale or rigor transition. description: Your Role As Senior Product Manager - Growth (m/f/x), you own the critical moment a visitor lands on finn.com and decides whether to choose a FINN car subscription. Your strategic vision and execution are core drivers in scaling our platform to over 100,000 active subscribers on the road. Your Mission Run a high-velocity experimentation engine: Embed conversion-rate optimization and A/B testing into the team's core operating rhythm, testing bold hypotheses fast and adapting product choices based on clean empirical data. Architect a personalized discovery journey: Scale our digital shopping experience by building intelligent search, dynamic vehicle filtering, relevance ranking, and segment-aware user flows that deliver the right car to the right user. Diagnose user friction points: Synthesize quantitative funnel signals from product analytics tools with qualitative depth from direct user interviews to build a prioritized roadmap targeting highest-leverage growth drops. Define the top-of-funnel vision: Own the product strategy and execution for our onboarding ecosystem, aligning your team's tactical goals directly with FINN's overarching revenue and customer acquisition targets. Foster high-performing cross-functional alignment: Champion transparent, precise communication to create seamless collaboration across engineering, design, data, marketing, brand, and pricing stakeholders. Optimize for true commercial outcomes: Relentlessly focus on driving conversion lift, revenue expansion, and early-stage retention metrics over purely tracking completed features or engineering outputs. Your Profile Must have: Extensive growth product track record: Deep, proven experience in product management with a track record of owning scalable, customer-facing growth, e-commerce, or marketplace products. Mastery of experimentation methodologies: Exceptional, demonstrable skill in designing, launching, and analyzing high-velocity A/B tests as a primary mechanism for validating product value and optimizing conversion funnels. Advanced data self-service capabilities: Highly analytical mindset with professional comfort in data exploration platforms (e.g., Amplitude, Looker, or similar tools) to independently pull data, build hypotheses, and challenge performance metrics. Outcome-driven stakeholder management: Outstanding communication and alignment skills in English, backed by an entrepreneurial mindset that takes total end-to-end ownership of business outcomes. Dynamic digital subscription background: Direct experience navigating localized customer acquisition dynamics within rapidly scaling international subscription or high-consideration digital platforms. title: Commercial Support Associate
description: Location: Berlin , hybrid (2-3 days per week in our office) Hi, we're AMBOSS and we're searching for a Commercial Support Associate to support how we manage tenders, vendor registrations, and customer assurance requests for our institutional customers. About AMBOSS AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town. Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique. Why can this position be exciting for you? In this role, you'll coordinate the tenders, vendor registrations, and documentation requests that let institutional and business customers say yes to AMBOSS. You'll sit at the center of the company, working closely with Sales and pulling in expertise from IT, Legal, Finance, Product, Security, and Engineering to get every request answered accurately and on time. Every tender we win and every questionnaire we complete well helps bring AMBOSS into more hospitals, health systems, and medical schools: directly supporting our mission of empowering medical professionals to provide the best possible care. You'll start with structured, recurring processes and grow into someone institutional customers and internal teams alike rely on to get things done. You will: Support tender and procurement processes, coordinating the company information, documentation, and internal contributions they require. Complete and maintain customer vendor registrations and onboarding requirements in procurement and vendor-management systems. Coordinate documentation and information requests from Sales and from prospective or existing customers. Maintain commonly requested company documents and keep current, approved versions easily accessible. Track requests, deadlines, dependencies, and outstanding contributions from internal stakeholders. Identify and coordinate with the right subject-matter experts across IT, Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, Security, and other teams. Support completion of customer questionnaires covering company information, technology, privacy, AI, security, and compliance topics. Help document and improve internal processes so recurring commercial and customer-assurance requests can be handled more efficiently. You bring: First professional experience in operations, administration, sales support, customer support, project coordination, or another structured cross-functional role; relevant internship or working-student experience also welcome. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Experience managing multiple requests, stakeholders, and deadlines at the same time. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (C1) and German (C1). Ability to work independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate. Comfort reaching out to colleagues across departments and following up on outstanding information. Nice to have: previous exposure to tenders, procurement portals, vendor onboarding, customer questionnaires, or documentation management. You enjoy: Structured, detail-oriented work and keeping track of many moving pieces at once. Coordinating with people across different teams to get to an answer. Learning unfamiliar terminology and processes quickly. Gradually taking ownership of recurring workflows and making them run more smoothly. Benefits: AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony. 🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more) 🥙 Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town) 🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club – M plan, Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…) Check out the full list of benefits below: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That's why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺 Even if you don't meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We'd love to hear from you! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Risk Management Specialist (f/m/x)
description: About lemon.markets 🍋 We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers. lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months. As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market. Your Mission As Senior Risk Management Specialist, you will help scale and further develop lemon.markets’ Risk Management Framework in a period of growing regulatory expectations, business complexity, and organisational maturity. Sitting within the Risk team and working closely with the Head of Risk, you will take over meaningful responsibilities across multiple risk domains and help ensure our controls, assessments, and governance evolve with the company. Over the next 6 to 12 months, your focus will be on strengthening risk processes across operational and non-financial risk topics, contributing to financial risk topics such as ICAAP and ILAAP, and improving the structure, transparency, and efficiency of our risk tooling and reporting. This role matters because strong, pragmatic risk management is a core enabler of scalable growth in a regulated Brokerage-as-a-Service business. You will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and other stakeholders to turn regulatory and risk requirements into practical, tech-enabled solutions that reduce manual work and improve decision-making. It is a strong opportunity for someone who combines broad risk knowledge with a hands-on mindset and wants to help build a mature framework in a fast-moving environment. In this role you will: Own the identification, assessment, and documentation of risks across key domains together with the Risk team, business stakeholders, and control owners, so lemon.markets can make informed decisions and maintain a resilient risk profile as the business grows. Drive risk assessments, control testing, and issue remediation tracking with teams across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance, so we can detect weaknesses early, strengthen controls, and follow through on corrective actions. Maintain and improve our internal control framework, risk register, and operational risk procedures in close collaboration with the Head of Risk and cross-functional stakeholders, so our framework remains effective, usable, and aligned with business and regulatory needs. Contribute to risk topics across operational and non-financial risk, financial risk, ICAAP, ILAAP, third-party risk, and security-related assessments, so we can build a broader and more integrated view of risk across the organisation. Draft clear business and technical requirements for process improvements, tooling enhancements, and automation initiatives with Product, Engineering, and Operations, so we can increase risk transparency, improve reporting quality, and reduce manual work. Collaborate with auditors, supervisory stakeholders, and internal teams on evidence gathering, incident analysis, root-cause identification, and follow-up actions, so lemon.markets stays audit-ready and continues to improve the effectiveness of its risk management practices. You’ll be successful in this role if you: You bring strong hands-on experience in Risk Management within FinTech, banking, audit, consulting, or a similarly regulated environment, with broad exposure across multiple risk domains. You have solid knowledge of operational and non-financial risk, internal controls, risk governance, and risk assessments, plus a good understanding of financial risk topics such as credit, market, liquidity, ICAAP, and ILAAP. You are familiar with the relevant regulatory foundations, including MaRisk, DORA, CRR, IFR, and applicable EBA and ESMA guidelines; knowledge of MiFID, MaComp, and WpHG is a strong plus. You are confident working with risk management tools, structured documentation, reporting, testing, and validation, and you are comfortable translating requirements into pragmatic process or tooling improvements. You communicate clearly in English, and bring professional working proficiency in German to navigate regulatory documents and stakeholder communication in a German market context. You are hands-on, analytical, and collaborative: you enjoy building, improving, and following through, work well across functions, and stay effective in fast-moving or sometimes ambiguous environments. How we take care of you 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets. 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration. 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more and leadership lemoneers work 7 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites, or over team dinners. 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations, as well as an annual learning budget. 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate. 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing. 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total. As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply. If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply. You have any questions? title: Head of Financial Systems Transformation
description: Our story: Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence. Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016. The opportunity: Taxfix is going AI-first with full speed - and Finance at Taxfix is leading by example: We are looking for an expert professional who will be leading both the transformation of financial processes and implementation of AI in the Taxfix financial systems infrastructure. The focus is on improving our core operational finance processes further through automation and best-in-class practices - and to keep evolving them as AI reshapes what's possible both inside and outside our company and its AI-native platform. This role demands subject matter expertise in finance, technology, and leadership across dialogues with senior leaders, product and technology experts, as well as incumbent finance team to ensure both planning and implementing of the financial systems infrastructure roadmap over time while ensuring resilience, compliance, cost effectiveness, and scalability. Your impact will be visible across the firm including the most senior stakeholders. You'll define and own the roadmap end-to-end, from architecture decisions and change, to hands-on ERP configurations and design decisions, on to bespoke additions and refinements to all financial systems, while further embedding automation and AI into how financial systems and the Finance team operate at Taxfix. As part of this transformation you will lead a dedicated and highly motivated team. When a delivery note doesn't map to the right project, a 3-way match fails, or data stops flowing from a customer's SAP, you own the problem end to end. You dig into logs, APIs, and data flows to find the root cause, prepare and ship smaller pull requests yourself, and work closely with engineering on more complex fixes. When you're not deep in a technical problem, you're on calls with customers, making sure the teams that went live keep using comstruct in their daily work. You're the person the customer calls when something breaks and the one who makes sure it doesn't break again. Inside comstruct you're the voice of the customer: you spot the feature gaps that surface in real use and prioritize with the Product Engineering team which ones get built. The deeper you get into how the product works and where it falls short, the more the door opens to move into a Forward Deployed Engineer or Product Engineering role and ship those fixes and features yourself. You'll work out which parts of the flow an agent can handle and where the human touch still wins. Ship the fix when it's yours to ship: Small PRs, config and mapping changes, data repair scripts, clearer error handling. Reviewed by engineering, shipped by you. Kill recurring issues: Every ticket is a data point. You spot the patterns, bring them to Product Engineering with evidence, and push for the change that makes that ticket class disappear. Build the support foundation: Playbook, macros, help center, internal runbooks. You won't inherit a finished system. As you learn how customers use the product and where it breaks, you can grow into a Forward Deployed Engineer or Product Engineering role and build the fixes and features yourself.
