title: Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
description: Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries. Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams. Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR). Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks. Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors. Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions. Actively contributing to internal discussions. Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables. As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. As Project Manager , the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication. We are looking for A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar As Project Officer : Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems. As Project Manager : At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors. Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus. Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus. Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers. A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact. Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents. Full command of the English language in reading and writing, knowledge of other languages is a plus. Willingness to travel outside Europe. We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why you are the right person for the job. What we offer An opportunity to work in a mission-driven, highly motivated, and professional international team. Opportunities for professional growth and advancement; including access to a mental well-being platform. Flexible working hours and a hybrid work environment, with access to an attractive office space in central Berlin and a good setup to work from home. Weekly breakfast, team events and other get-togethers with colleagues from around the globe. One option from our benefit basket (e.g. job ticket, shopping vouchers, Urban Sports, etc.). Opportunities for professional and personal development and advancement. Entitlement of 29 paid leave days per year (5-days working week); 24th & 31st December off-work. A cooperative working atmosphere with flat communication and decision-making hierarchies. Assistance with visa and work permits for international candidates if required. A structured onboarding programme and regular team and organisation-wide retreats to bring us all together; and A full or part-time role, initially limited to two years. How to apply We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why you are the right person for the job. We look forward to receiving your application by 30th of September 2026 via our website. For reasons of objectivity, we ask that you refrain from submitting an application photo. We want an energy transition for everyone from everyone. Therefore, we are particularly pleased to receive applications from people from groups that have been underrepresented in energy and industrial policy. We welcome applications regardless of gender and gender identity, nationality, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability and age, and sexual orientation. Our offices are not completely barrier-free, but we are open to find individual solutions. As part of this, we are soliciting anonymous information on a voluntary basis regarding our applicant’s background. This information will be used only to inform future recruitment strategies and will not impact hiring decisions in any form. Your input will not be forwarded to third parties and will not be used in connection with your application. title: Senior Software Engineer - Paris
description: About H: When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai . For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these. H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API , and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows. What this team owns The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up. What you'd be doing Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time. Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it. Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue. Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold. Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments. Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models. The first few months By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations. Who you'd work with Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers. What we think it takes Likely a good fit if you Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop. Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right. Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most. Have built and shipped systems end to end, including APIs (REST or GraphQL) and integrations with outside services. Know relational and non-relational databases, and message queues such as SQS, RabbitMQ or Kafka. Instrument what you build, with metrics, tracing and monitoring from the start. Stronger still if you have Measured LLM quality before, or built agents yourself. Packaged and run workloads in Docker and on virtual machines. Used Temporal, Dask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Grafana or Datadog. Automated web or desktop software with Playwright, Selenium or a browser extension you wrote. Set standards other engineers follow, through code review, design review or mentoring. You do not need a background in machine learning. We'll work that out with you. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway. title: Automation Lead
description: About us, and our mission At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI. Position overview Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams. Key responsibilities Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities. Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership. In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project. Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds. Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests. Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists. Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step. Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly. Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs. Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management. In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer. Key qualifications Must-have Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience. Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes. Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects. Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting. You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes. Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided. Fluency in English is required. Nice-to-have You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience. Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work. A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace. Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software. Experience hiring and leading an automation team. What we offer You will be Orakl's first automation hire. You will have a unique degree of ownership and scope with a strong mandate to deliver. Short decision lines and fast execution. An interdisciplinary environment with a results-driven culture. Cross-functional interviews with the technicians who run the culture, Platform Operations, the Senior Laboratory Engineers and the Data team — 60 minutes Reference calls: a former manager, a vendor or integrator you negotiated with, and an operator who ran a line you delivered Founder conversation — 45 minutes Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Solutions Architect, Defence, DACH

Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? In this role as a Solutions Architect (SA) for Cohere in the DACH region, you will play an instrumental part in growing Cohere’s defence business across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the wider European region, with Germany as the main focus. You will partner with account executives, our partner ecosystem and executive leadership to help the region's defence and security organisations adopt AI securely and at scale, building on Cohere's success with organisations in defence and the public sector. These customers need AI that runs on their own infrastructure, often air-gapped or at the tactical edge, and that can handle classified information. SAs at Cohere sit at the cross-section of Forward Deployed Engineering and AI transformation. Our SAs embody the following traits: Technical experts in the field Trusted advisors to customers and colleagues Product evangelists of Cohere technology Thought leaders in pushing the frontiers of applied AI Responsibilities include developing a deep understanding of customer problems, mapping them to Cohere solutions, and working closely with our partners as the trusted technical advisor who owns the technical relationship with our stakeholders. By leveraging your expertise, you will help to increase the adoption of Cohere products, both internally and externally, and will gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape the future of our products. In this dynamic and demanding role, you will need to be both a strategic thinker and a builder. You will personally lead the design and deployment of customer pilots that showcase the impact of our technology to strategic enterprise and government customers. You will own the customer's technical narrative end to end, from discovery and architecture to pilot results and business case, and bring structured customer feedback back to our Product and Engineering teams. A typical day at Cohere might include: Leading the technical talk track on customer calls. Designing enterprise architectures for North deployments, including on-prem, air-gapped and sovereign cloud setups that meet German and EU requirements such as GDPR, BSI C5 and the EU AI Act. Designing for classified and disconnected environments (VS-NfD and above, air-gapped, DDIL and tactical edge), together with the customer's IT security and accreditation teams. Deep dives on customer queries and Cohere technology. Working with customer executives to prioritise use cases, define success metrics and build the business case for AI adoption. Translating defence and operational requirements into AI use cases, from logistics, maintenance and training to intelligence analysis and staff work. Facilitating customer evaluations and pilots inside their stack Owning the technical response of RFPs and public tenders, including defence procurement, from security questionnaires to mapping the customer's requirements specification (Lastenheft) to our solution. Developing and documenting processes to enable the solutions architect team and adjacent teams to scale effectively within Cohere. Collaborating with the Product and Engineering teams to ensure our offering matches the customers’ needs. Working closely with our partners (system integrators, defence companies and sovereign cloud providers), who lead many of the larger deals in Germany, to develop a strategy for enabling and accelerating their customers. This might be for you if you have some of the following: 3+ years in customer-facing technical roles where you both built and advised, such as consulting data scientist, forward deployed engineer, deployment strategist, or solutions architect, taking AI or data solutions from executive problem framing to production. A passion for Agentic AI, and a practical understanding of where LLMs deliver value in production, and where they don't. Solid grounding in ML fundamentals (training, evaluation, retrieval etc.) and the ability to design evaluation frameworks for customer pilots. Excellent communication skills - you can toggle seamlessly between presenting to CEOs, and getting in the weeds with technical audiences. You thrive in ambiguity and can put high-impact structure and processes in place where none exist. Comfortable working with Python and Assistive Coding tools Experience in or with the defence sector, e.g. in the Bundeswehr (including reserve service), at a defence company, in federal IT or at NATO, and a deep understanding of how defence organisations buy and run IT. Eligible and willing to undergo a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung under the SÜG, Ü2 or higher). An existing clearance is a strong plus. Preferred : experience in the German defence market, e.g. at a system integrator or consultancy, or working on RFPs and public tenders. Must have: Professional fluency in English and German (C1 or higher, verhandlungssicher) Please note: for this role we are open to a range of experience levels, from Associate to Staff-level Individual Contributors (ICs). Experience level stated is a bare minimum. We also welcome and support employees who actively serve in the Bundeswehr reserve. Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How and Where We Work: Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mirakl:</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.<br><br>Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).<br><br>With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.</p> <p>For more information: <a href="http://www.mirakl.com">www.mirakl.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Mirakl in Numbers:</strong></p> <ul> <li>🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40</li> <li>👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo</li> <li>🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France</li> <li>⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values:</strong></p> <p>Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.</p> <p>Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:</p> <ul> <li>💡<strong> Work Hard Together:</strong> Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success</li> <li>🏆 <strong>Get Things Done: </strong> We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results</li> <li>🚀 <strong>Go Above & Beyond:</strong>  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence</li> <li>🎓 <strong>Succeed Through Expertise:</strong> Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture</li> <li>🤝 <strong>Satisfy & Empower Clients:</strong> We're committed to our clients' success</li> </ul></div><h2><strong>The Team You'll Join</strong></h2> <p>You'll join the Product team of Mirakl Connect, the platform that helps brands and sellers grow their sales across marketplaces and other sales channels. You'll work closely with the VP Product Connect, the Channel Integration PM and the whole Channel Integration squad.</p> <p>This is a 6-month internship starting in January 2027. You'll participate in team rituals, gain autonomy progressively, and have the opportunity to present your work regularly to management, offering strong visibility within the organization.</p> <h2><strong><br>Your Impact</strong></h2> <p>Choosing and building the right channels is one of our biggest growth levers. As a Product Manager Intern, your mission will be to help the team prepare and assess new channel opportunities, reduce uncertainty before development starts and contribute to successful integrations.</p> <p>Your work will help the squad bring together the key information, questions, risks and opportunities before development begins.<br><br>Concretely, you will:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Help pre-qualify channels:</strong> Map the marketplace landscape by country and vertical, and contribute to a first-level assessment of each channel: technical integration effort, functional coverage with Mirakl Connect, and business potential (seller demand).</li> <li><strong>Explore channel requirements: </strong>Review channel API specifications and requirements across catalog, offers, orders and logistics, and test them hands-on (e.g. with Postman). With support from the team, identify key questions, dependencies, risks and areas that require further investigation.</li> <li><strong>Prepare build-ready inputs:</strong> Turn your analyses into useful inputs for the squad, such as data mappings, process diagrams, edge cases, open questions for channel partners and first drafts of user stories."</li> <li><strong>Talk to the field:</strong> Interview sellers, Sales and Customer Success teams, and channel partner teams to turn scattered feedback into clear insights and product recommendations.</li> <li><strong>Contribute to channel builds: </strong>Alongside the Channel Integration PM and the squad, help refine specifications and user stories, contribute to backlog discussions, answer functional questions and participate in QA and go-live preparation.</li> <li><strong>Build AI-powered tools to scale channel work:</strong> Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis and prototyping. For example, you may help create an agent that analyzes channel documentation, a Q&A assistant for Sales and Customer Success or AI-assisted prototypes to explore mappings and integration flows.<br><br></li> </ul> <h2><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h2> <ul> <li>After 3 months: A broad set of channels pre-analyzed at a high level, with a first assessment of technical integration effort and functional coverage, contributing to channel pre-qualification</li> <li>After 6 months: Several channels analyzed in depth and handed over to the squad as build-ready, an active contribution to channel builds, and at least one AI tool in daily use by the team</li> </ul> <h2><strong><br>What You'll Bring to the Role</strong></h2> <p><strong>Profile & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Currently pursuing a gap year internship or end-of-studies internship (engineering school, business school or university)</li> <li>Strong interest in e-commerce, marketplaces and retail</li> <li>A structured mindset, with the ability to turn a broad or ambiguous question into a clear and actionable analysis</li> <li>A genuine curiosity for understanding how products, processes and systems work</li> <li>Previous experience in a start-up or scale up, in e-commerce, consulting, business analysis or project work is a plus, but not required</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>Technical Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Hands-on with APIs:</strong> You understand what an API is and how systems exchange data, and you can read API documentation and make simple API calls (e.g. with Postman). Familiarity with data formats (JSON, XML) or integration concepts is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Data and spreadsheet skills:</strong> You are comfortable using spreadsheets to analyze, compare and synthesize information. Experience with dashboards or SQL would be a plus.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on with AI tools:</strong> You use AI tools daily and critically to improve research, analysis and product work. Experience creating prompts, automations or agents is a plus.<strong><br><br></strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Curious, proactive and rigorous: </strong>You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions and dig until the key unknowns are clarified.</li> <li><strong>Strong communication and collaboration skills:</strong> You communicate clearly with different stakeholders, collaborate effectively in cross-functional environments and can summarize complex information into clear, actionable conclusions for different audiences.</li> <li><strong>Fast learner with adaptability:</strong> You pick up new domains quickly and are comfortable learning unfamiliar concepts.</li> <li><strong>Critical thinker:</strong> You can challenge assumptions, assess the quality of information and distinguish facts from hypotheses.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>Languages</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fluent English is mandatory, both written and spoken, as it is our working language with the team and channel partners.</li> <li>Another European language is a plus.<br><br></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Compensation</strong></h2> <p>Monthly stipend range: €1,200 - €1,400</p> <h2><strong><br></strong><strong>Our Hiring Process</strong></h2> <p>We warmly encourage you to apply to this role, even if you think you're not an exact match.</p> <p>Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.</p> <ol> <li>Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter and then an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl’s AI Talent Ambassador to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application</li> <li>TA interview (30-45 minutes) to discuss your experience and answer your questions about Mirakl</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview (45 minutes) with one of the Product Managers to dive deeper into the role and assess technical fit</li> <li>STAR interview (45 minutes) to evaluate alignment with our values and team culture</li> <li>Offer</li> </ol><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.</em></p> <p><em>As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in English and <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/fr-FR/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in French. </em></p> <p><em>We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our </em><a href="https://info.mirakl.com/ai-guidelines-for-candidates-and-interviews" target="_blank"><em>AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews</em></a><em>.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Commercial Director - Bern (m/f/d)
description: Intro Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 530 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet. Dich begeistert ein Mix aus strategischem Gestaltungsspielraum und operativ-kommerzieller Optimierung und Du willst Deine wirtschaftliche Expertise bei einem dynamisch wachsenden Player der Augenheilkunde unter Beweis stellen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. In dieser Rolle wirst Du zur Führung und Optimierung der kaufmännischen Aktivitäten mehrerer Augenzentren in Bern die kaufmännische Geschäftsführung übernehmen. Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die strategische Überwachung, das Leistungsmanagement, die Teamführung und die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams. Dein Engagement für hervorragende Leistungen wird dazu beitragen, die Geschäftsziele zu erreichen, die Patientenzufriedenheit zu erhöhen und das Wachstum der Präsenz von Sanoptis in der Region zu fördern. In dieser Rolle wirst Du Unsere Augenzentren kaufmännisch leiten: Du wirst den Betrieb mehrerer Zentren wirtschaftlich leiten und dabei die Einhaltung der Sanoptis-Standards in den Einrichtungen sicherstellen. Betriebsergebnisse und Geschäftsziele verantworten: Die betrieblichen Leistungskennzahlen zu Patientenzufriedenheit, Finanzindikatoren, Einnahmen, Ausgaben und Rentabilität wirst Du überwachen. Ferner wirst Du mit den Finanz- und Buchhaltungsteams bei der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Budgets, Finanzprognosen und Kostenkontrollmaßnahmen zusammenarbeiten. Leistungsziele definieren: Du wirst Leistungsbewertungen durchführen und Ziele definieren. Es ist Dir ein wesentliches Anliegen, für Deine Mitarbeiter und Teams ein positives Arbeitsumfeld zu gewährleisten, das Leistung durch effektive Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit fördert. Die regionale Strategie planen: Die Formulierung regionaler, strategischer Pläne im Einklang mit unseren übergeordneten Geschäftszielen erarbeitest Du. Hierfür wirst Du eng mit dem Head of Operations sowie Ärzten und Fachkräften vor Ort arbeiten und netzwerken. Wachstum durch Standortentwicklung vorantreiben: Du siehst Wachstumschancen in Deiner Region und erkennst sie frühzeitig, um sie gewinnbringend zu nutzen. Du wirst durch effektive Marketing- und Werbestrategien zur Steigerung des Patientenaufkommens in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketingteam beitragen. Dein Ziel ist es, einen Ausbau des Marktanteils zu erreichen. Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit Einem starken Operationsteam, bestehend aus vielen Ex-Beratern (Bain, BCG, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman). Leitenden Angestellten und Führungskräften bei Sanoptis, darunter der Head of Operations und das Führungsteam, das für klinische Innovation und hervorragende Dienstleistungen verantwortlich ist. Renommierten Spezialisten und führenden Experten auf dem Gebiet der Augenheilkunde. Einem engagierten und qualifizierten Team von medizinischen Fachkräften und Assistenzärzten. Interdisziplinären Teams in unserem gesamten Netzwerk, einschließlich Technologieexperten, die an den neuesten Fortschritten in der augenmedizinischen Behandlung und digitalen Gesundheitslösungen arbeiten. Dein Profil überzeugt durch Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld, z. B. in der Strategieberatung (McKinsey, Bain, BCG o.Ä.) oder in ähnlich schnelllebigen Unternehmen. Die nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Geschäfts- und Finanzanalysen auf Führungsebene zu erstellen und zu kommunizieren. Du erstellst Analysen akribisch und detailorientiert. Unternehmerisches Denken mit der Fähigkeit, große Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Problemlösungen unabhängig voranzutreiben. Eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit wenig Anleitung ist essenziell. Nachgewiesene Erfolge im Umgang mit Interessensgruppen, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, ohne formale Autorität Einfluss zu nehmen und Dir eine wichtige Rolle bei der Entscheidungsfindung zu sichern. Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, auch in schwierigen Situationen Konflikte konstruktiv zu lösen und Durchsetzungsstärke zu behalten. Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Bereich Organisation und Prozessmanagement. Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau), Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil sowie Englischkenntnisse. Die Bereitschaft, Ergebnisse zu erzielen und Dich in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit hoher Verantwortung zu entfalten. Sanoptis bietet Dir Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung: Ein äußerst attraktives Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen, leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Leistungsziele gebunden ist. Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, Dich zu beweisen, indem Du selbstständig arbeitest und eigene, innovative Ideen umfassend einbringst als Führungspersönlichkeit. Berufliche Entwicklung: Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliches Wachstum und Karrierechancen bei guter Leistung, unterstützt durch Schulungen, Online-Akademien, Workshops und Branchenkonferenzen. Inklusive Kultur: Arbeiten in einem ambitionierten Team mit regelmäßigem Austausch und Teamveranstaltungen. Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits. Körperliches Wohlbefinden: Eine subventionierte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellpass, die Deine körperliche Gesundheit unterstützt. Gleiche Chancen Bei Sanoptis schätzen wir Talent, Leidenschaft und Einstellung über spezifische Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle. Kontakt Wenn Du bereit bist, die digitale Zukunft der Augenheilkunde mitzugestalten, möchten wir von Dir hören! Bewirb Dich jetzt, um unserem dynamischen Team beizutreten und einen bedeutenden Einfluss auf das Leben der Menschen zu haben. Gerne erreichst Du uns unter Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. 🏡 Where you'll fit in: Kraken is the operating system of the future for Utilities. When a utility signs up to use Kraken, they have some big ambitions. They want to; improve customer experience, reduce cost to serve or accelerate growth and innovation. To make this possible at pace, clients need the incredible tech stack that Kraken offers, the ability to improve how they operate and to have a culture that enables them to thrive. Clients are increasingly interested in understanding how they can improve not only their customer operations but the business functions, and business units that sit horizontally and vertically to customer operations in retail. To enable this Kraken now structures itself across 3 key delivery practice groups. Human Design, Org Design and Tech. This role sits within the Human Design Team. Purpose of the Human Design Lead The main purpose of the Human Design Lead is to be the single point of accountability for the successful enablement and implementation of culture / ways of working transformation in our clients. portfolios of major program transformations across different geographies Track record of trust-based partnerships with C-suite and executives Excellent communication skills at storytelling level technology in the context of tech-enabled transformations Experience of working within the Energy, Utilities and Telco industries is highly desirable In depth knowledge of leadership and organisation description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills. You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio. When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt. Key Responsibilities: what you'll do Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement: Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme. Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation. Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions. Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation. Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations. Project Management: Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised. Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track. Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs. Mentorship & Coaching: Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation. Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct. Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes. Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations. Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration. Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality. Driving Organisational Change: Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach. Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success. Skills: what you'll have Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions. Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies. Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions. Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience. Fluent English & French is a prerequisite Experience Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level. Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively. Change management using agile methodologies. Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. title: Technical Program Lead (F/H/X)
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone. It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future. 🏠 Where you'll fit in: We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. This role will lead the technical orchestration of a major client program, partnering with an international energy retailer in their operational transformation. You will oversee the migration’s technical pillar and manage the ongoing technical relationship, supporting the client’s adoption of our Kraken platform as part of their broader business transformation. We work incredibly dynamically, and this role is one that will take different shapes throughout the week. We are looking for well rounded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity, are self-starters and willing to roll their sleeves up to get to the nitty gritty of a problem. You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing senior stakeholders through a journey of change. You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you. 🚀 What you'll own: Building trusted relationships with client executives and technology stakeholders, including partnering with our product and engineering teams to align on priorities. Serving as the escalation point for client concerns and ensuring both technical challenges and product requirements are effectively managed Defining success criteria and governance for delivering the technical pillar of the program. Owning the Kraken platform localisation plan to meet client expectations while matching Kraken roadmap Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines, etc internally as structured input for the successful and timely execution of any required technology platform localisation and development. Directing internal Kraken software developers contributing to the client program, as well as potential external Partners, on tech platform deliverables to ensure an overall successful and timely technology migration. Supporting the client meets their business needs via the delivery of tech. Understanding the Kraken infrastructure, aligning client direction with the overall goal for the Kraken platform & business. Setting up training programs to upskill the technical arm of the client. Being an advocate for the Kraken way of delivering tech and supporting the client in shifting their mindset around tech delivery 🧠 What you'll bring to the party: Communication: You need to be confident in calling out approaches that aren't best for the client and always striving for simplicity. You need to be able to communicate the context behind decisions relating to the platform & client priorities. You must be able to build strong relationships and credibility amongst senior stakeholders, balancing the needs of the client with Kraken’s business needs and platform potential and constraints. Program management: Confident in managing a long term, fast paced program. Can be both high level and dive into detail when required. Ability to directly manage a team and manage processes that can drive the right outcomes for clients. Strong technical aptitude : We are looking for a logical thinker who has strong problem solving skills within an agile working framework. Must quickly be able to grasp the technical capabilities and constraints of the Kraken platform. Is an advocate for the continuous deployment approach we take at Kraken and champions building tech iteratively. Business acumen : Able to understand business goals of both client and Kraken, putting all technology decisions into context to ensure measurable success can be achieved and celebrated. You are based in Paris, France and willing to travel internationally Experience / Qualifications needed: Technical mindset, experience in engineering-led industries Sector-relevant experience in managing complex technology implementation or migration programs Proven experience in software adaptation, deployment and integration Exceptional interpersonal skills Fluent English & French is a prerequisite As we are an international organization, we kindly ask you to send us your CV in English . title: Lead Software Engineer - Paris
description: <p><strong>Présentation du poste :</strong></p> <p>Au sein de l’équipe technique d’Artefact, vous rejoignez une communauté de Software Engineers en tant que Manager et référent technique auprès de nos grands comptes clients. Dans un environnement à forte accélération sur la Data et l’IA Générative, vous intervenez pour piloter des projets d'ingénierie complexes, encadrer les équipes et porter l'excellence opérationnelle et technique.</p> <p><strong>Ce qu’on attend de vous :</strong></p> <p>En tant que Manager, vous supervisez la conception et le déploiement d'architectures critiques (Data Platforms, Agentic Platforms) tout en assurant l'encadrement, le mentorat et le développement de carrières des membres de l'équipe. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la relation client, le cadrage technique des affaires et le rayonnement de la communauté tech Artefact.</p> <p><strong>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Piloter et encadrer la réalisation de projets Data & IA complexes (ex. solutions multi-agents LangGraph sur Kubernetes, architectures Médaillon).</li> <li>Superviser le cadrage et la construction de Data Platforms robustes sur GCP, AWS, Azure ou Snowflake en garantissant l'alignement avec les meilleures pratiques d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et d'ingénierie logicielle.</li> <li>Définir la vision technique des projets GenAI / LLM (orchestration, évaluation, contrôle) et promouvoir l'usage quotidien des coding agents au sein des équipes.</li> <li>Assurer la gestion de carrière, le suivi de performance et le mentoring continu des Software Engineers sous votre responsabilité.</li> <li>Mener les cadrages techniques auprès des clients grands comptes et défendre avec pédagogie les choix stratégiques et d'architecture.</li> <li>Veiller au respect des standards de qualité de code, de sécurité et de livrables sur l'ensemble de vos périmètres applicatifs.</li> <li>Contribuer activement à l'animation de la communauté technique (Talks Tech, Guildes, REX) et participer au processus de recrutement et de montée en compétences de la pratique.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profil recherché :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Expérience & Leadership :</strong> Expérience confirmée en tant que Lead / Engineering Manager ou Senior Architect ayant déjà encadré des équipes techniques et piloté des projets stratégiques.</li> <li><strong>Résolution de problèmes :</strong> Solides intuitions techniques et capacité à traduire des enjeux business complexes en architectures techniques pérennes.</li> <li><strong>Management & Transmission :</strong> Posture bienveillante, pédagogique et exemplaire, à l'aise pour faire grandir les talents, donner du feedback constructif et animer une équipe.</li> <li><strong>Spécialisations (au moins 1) :</strong> Expertise avérée en Analytics Engineering, Software Development, SRE, Cloud Architecture ou AI Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Stack technique :</strong> Maîtrise avancée de l'écosystème tech (Python, FastAPI, dbt, LangGraph, Docker, Terraform, GCP, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Kubernetes).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process de recrutement :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>HR Interview (30-45 min) :</strong> Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.</li> <li><strong>Technical Deep Dive (60 min) :</strong> Session de live coding et d'architecture system design avec un Senior Engineering Lead basé en France.</li> <li><strong>US / Manager Interview (60 min) :</strong> Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Rémunération :</strong> Package :  75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.</p> <p><strong>Présentation de l’entreprise</strong></p> <p>Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.</p> <p>A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.</p> <p>Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : <a href="https://www.artefact.com/">https://www.artefact.com</a></p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> <p><br><br><br></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel
description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. Role Summary We are looking for an Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance Legal Counsel to play a central role in the building, development and operation of Mistral AI's corporate compliance framework, with a particular focus on anti-corruption, economic sanctions and export controls . Reporting to the Lead Anti-Corruption & Trade Compliance, the position offers genuine build-from-scratch ownership of core policies, processes and tools. It combines programme development, day-to-day compliance operations and cross-functional advisory work. The role involves close collaboration with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Sales, Security, and Product and Engineering to translate legal requirements into clear, proportionate and auditable processes. Key responsibilities Anti-corruption/Sapin II Coordinate Sapin II Action Plan deployment of relevant policies, controls, training and third-party procedure. Lead the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of risk-based due diligence from integrity screening through enhanced diligence and periodic review; Support the implementation and periodic review of the code of conduct, related policies, whistleblowing framework and training programme, Administer the gifts, hospitality and conflicts-of-interest processes, including reviewing requests and declarations, maintaining the relevant records and registers, and providing practical guidance to business teams. Work with Finance and Internal Control to define and monitor risk-based anti-corruption accounting controls. Contribute to the monitoring and periodic assessment of the anti-corruption programme, including programme records, metrics and reporting; monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; and support anti-corruption incidents, internal reviews and investigations. Economic sanctions and export controls Manage screening for new and existing counterparties as part of third-party due diligence and transaction-review processes. Support the Lead Anti-Corruption and Trade Compliance in export control classification of AI models, software, technology, compute infrastructure and hardware. Work with Procurement, Operations, Product and Engineering to embed screening and access-control requirements into onboarding, contracting and deployment processes, and maintain clear, auditable records and internal guidance. Develop and maintain standard sanctions and export-control contractual positions and clauses, and support their review and negotiation in customer, supplier, partner and reseller agreements. Monitor relevant regulatory and enforcement developments; coordinate external counsel and advisers; contribute to programme reporting for Legal leadership. Qualifications and skills Legal Master degree (Master’s in Business Law, Corporate Law, Compliance, or equivalent). Compliance certifications are also an asset. A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a company, law firm, consulting firm or regulatory authority. Substantive exposure to at least two of the following areas: anti-corruption and Sapin II, economic sanctions, and export controls. Experience in the technology or AI sector is a plus (understanding of data, semiconductors, or dual-use goods), as well as knowledge and understanding of artificial intelligence. Analytical and problem solving skills : Candidates should be able to analyze complex topics and have strong problem-solving skills, and be able to dig into internal systems. Pedagogy: Excellent written and verbal communication; strong ability to communicate legal advice to clients and colleagues, and presenting complex legal concepts in a clear and understandable manner. International mindset : International experience is a plus. Adaptability: Given the rapidly evolving nature of AI technologies and compute topics, and the legal landscape surrounding them, candidates should be adaptable and willing to continuously learn and update their skills and knowledge. Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment. Ethical Awareness: Ability to promote an ethical and responsible culture. What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page . Privacy Policy Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy . Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: MAÎTRE DE CONFÉRENCES dans le domaine du Génie Civil et de la microstructure des matériaux de construction H/F - CDI - IMT Mines Alès
description: Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr . Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre des Matériaux des Mines Alès (C2MA) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'équipe de recherche : UMR LMGC "Laboratoire de Mécanique et Génie Civil". En tant que Maître de Conférences de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, vous réalisez des tâches d’enseignement, de recherche et de transfert technologique. Activités d'enseignement Participer aux activités d’enseignements de l’école du département Génie Civil et Bâtiment Durable (GCBD), dans les filières Infrastructures et Grands Ouvrages (IGO), Bâtiment et Energie (BE), et Bâtiment (BAT), sous forme de cours magistraux, travaux dirigés, travaux pratiques, encadrement de projets et tutorat d'étudiants ; Assurer des enseignements dans les domaines du génie civil, des matériaux et du calcul des structures ; Dispenser des enseignements en anglais ou développer des méthodes de pédagogie active ; Participer aux jurys de recrutement des élèves et aux actions de promotion de la formation d’ingénieurs ; Piloter une spécialisation en dernière année d’études et proposer des missions de recherche et développement ; Assurer un volume minimal de 150 heures d'enseignement par an. Activités de recherche Mener des activités de recherche au sein de l'axe « Milieux divisés » du LMGC ; Renforcer la thématique sur les matrices cimentaires bas carbone, en lien avec les propriétés macroscopiques et la durabilité de ces matériaux, et fédérer d’autres chercheurs en faisant le lien avec les aspects modélisation et mécaniques développées au LMGC ; S’intéresser aux méthodes de caractérisation expérimentale des propriétés des matériaux cimentaires de l’état frais et à l’état durci en particulier de la microstructure nécessitant des connaissances en physico-chimie des matrices cimentaires et sur l’adjuvantation ; Contribuer à la gestion collective de la plateforme Génie-Civil. Activités de valorisation et de transfert technologique Rechercher et monter des contrats de recherche avec des partenaires industriels et académiques ainsi que rédiger des dossiers de demande de financements auprès d’organismes publics ou de programmes internationaux ; Assurer l'interface avec le partenaire contractuel, prendre en charge les objectifs scientifiques définis dans le projet, animer une équipe projet et assurer le suivi de son déroulement, ainsi que la communication afférente ; Développer une compréhension du processus d’exploitation commerciale de résultats de recherche afin de contribuer à la coopération entre la recherche académique, la recherche industrielle et les secteurs de production. Réaliser, dans son champ de compétences scientifiques et techniques, des actions destinées à accompagner des entreprises ou l’incubateur de l’école afin de favoriser la création de spin off et le développement d’entreprises technologiques. Vous trouvez plus d’information sur le descriptif du poste ici : https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/Zqr5eBT6ijzic9y Le poste requiert une expérience confirmée en enseignement du génie civil et des matériaux de construction, ainsi qu’une aptitude à concevoir et mettre en œuvre des pédagogies innovantes adaptées aux compétences visées. Vous devrez disposer d’une expérience solide en recherche, démontrer votre capacité à développer des collaborations scientifiques, à publier vos travaux et à valoriser les résultats de recherche auprès de partenaires académiques et industriels. La maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique est requise ; une expérience internationale et une capacité à vous intégrer aux projets du LMGC et du C2MA constitueront des atouts. Les critères d'évaluation sont : Diplôme requis : diplôme d’ingénieur ou master en génie civil ou en bâtiment durable, ainsi qu’un doctorat en génie civil ou en sciences des matériaux. Critères de sélection prévalant pour l’activité d’enseignement : Niveau des enseignements dispensés Importance accordée à l’innovation pédagogique Action et notoriété dans la communauté du domaine Critères de sélection prévalant pour l’activité de recherche Reconnaissance nationale et internationale des résultats de recherche obtenus Responsabilités exercées dans le domaine d’expertise Relations avec les mondes académique et industriel L’exercice de responsabilités, les activités d’organisation et la participation à des instances de concertation et de décision entrent également en compte dans les critères examinés. Modalités de candidature Le dossier de candidature est à télécharger sur ce lien : https://partage.imt.fr/index.php/s/DT9ZZPFPNpHm5HD Il est à compléter en français uniquement si vous remplissez les conditions indiquées ci-dessus. Il est accompagné, notamment, d’un curriculum vitae, d’une lettre de motivation, d’éventuelles lettres de recommandation ainsi que d’une copie de votre carte d’identité, de vos diplômes et de toute attestation de formation ou de stage. Planning du recrutement Date limite de clôture des candidatures : 02/11/2026 Date indicative du comité de pré-sélection (pas de présence des candidats) : 23/11/2026 . Les candidats admissibles seront informés dans les meilleurs délais après cette date. Date indicative du comité de recrutement (audition des candidats admissibles en présentiel à l’IMT Mines Alès) : 09/12/2026 Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 01/02/2027 Personnes à contacter Sur les aspects enseignement/recherche : Jean-Claude SOUCHE, Responsable du département GCBD Gwenn LE SAOUT, Référent auprès de l’unité mixte LMGC Anne BERGERET , Professeur, directrice du C2MA Sur les aspects administratifs : Géraldine BRUNEL , Directrice des relations humaines Informations complémentaires : Le recrutement est ouvert dans la discipline "Génie Civil". Le poste proposé par l’IMT Mines Alès est un contrat à durée indéterminée, à temps plein, contrat de droit public relevant des dispositions du cadre de gestion de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, métier C, Maître de conférences, catégorie II. Ce poste est ouvert à toutes et tous. L’IMT Mines Alès s’engage à mettre en place les aménagements nécessaires pour les personnes en situation de handicap, afin de garantir un environnement de travail inclusif et accessible. Rejoignez nous et profitez de ces nombreux avantages : Possibilité de télétravail Nombreux congés Restauration sur place Fais de transports en commun pris en charge à hauteur de 75% Forfait mobilité durable pour le covoiturage ou les trajets en vélo Large gamme de prestations sociales Écosystème d'innovation stimulant (startups, étudiants, recherche, entreprises ...)
