description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Dubai, UAE<br></strong></h3> <hr> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Regional Focus:</strong> <strong>Saudi Arabia</strong></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. title: Senior Customer Engineer, Sub-Saharan Africa
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Dubai, UAE<br></strong></h3> <hr> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Regional Focus: Sub-Saharan Africa</strong></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fluency in English (written and spoken). French is a plus.</li> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion.</p> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. We design and operate large-scale data systems, own the company’s data lake, ingestion infrastructure, and platform tooling, and develop end-to-end applications that transform complex datasets into fast, reliable, business-critical products used daily by go-to-market, product, and engineering teams. Our work sits at the intersection of data platforms, distributed systems, and product development, giving engineers the opportunity to own meaningful problems across the stack and build systems that truly run the business.</p> <p>You will focus on building scalable, reliable AI/ML models, services and GenAI powered application backends, partnering closely with data and full-stack engineers to deliver new features and operate the pipelines and platforms behind our products. Our stack spans multiple languages and technologies, including Python, React, and TypeScript, and continues to evolve. Many of our applications also incorporate strong AI components, giving you opportunities to work with modern AI infrastructure and tools such as vector databases, MCP-based services, and Workers AI.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Partner and align with business leaders, stakeholders, product managers and internal teams to understand the business and product challenges and goals and engineering team to improve the data collection and quality.</li> <li>Understand business/product strategy and high-level roadmap and align analysis efforts to enable them with data insights and help achieve their strategic goals.</li> <li>Strong audience focused presentation and storytelling skills focused on key takeaways in a crisp and concise manner.</li> <li>Define, implement, and train statistical, machine learning, deep learning and generative AI models.</li> <li>Use software engineering best practices to publish model scores/insights/learnings at scale within the company.</li> <li>Ability to define and spot macro and micro levels trends with statistical significance on a regular basis and understand key drivers driving those trends.</li> <li>Active role in hiring, growing, and mentoring the data scientist team in Austin.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>M.S or Ph.D in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or other fast-growing SaaS business based company is preferred.</li> <li>Strong experience in scientific computing using Python.</li> <li>Experience with Spark, SQL, Tableau, Google Analytics, BigQuery (or any other Big data/Cloud equivalent) etc.</li> <li>Experience working with and processing structured, unstructured, and semi-structured data.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional collaboration experience with initiatives are aligned with business needs.</li> <li>Experience in hiring data scientists and establishing team best practices is preferred.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is These systems are also foundational building blocks for teams across Cloudflare, which use the proxy, caching, routing, and purge capabilities to power their own products. The team carries these capabilities through shared internal interfaces, distributed control planes, and customer-facing products including Cache Rules, Tiered Cache, Cache Reserve, Workers Cache API, and Always Online. Features ship end to end: you will help design, implement, test, roll out, and operate the systems you build.</p> <p>This is a good fit if you enjoy problems where latency, correctness, and reliability are hard requirements; where changes must be introduced safely across a global fleet; and where improvements can benefit a significant portion of Internet traffic.</p> <h2>Role to Pingora and the production services built on it, improving asynchronous I/O, connection handling, memory and disk efficiency, and tail latency</li> <li>Improve cache correctness and performance description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>チームについて</strong></h3> <p>私たちのBDR（Business Development Representative）組織のミッションは非常にシンプルです。 それは、「営業チームに高品質かつ大規模なパイプラインを供給し、Cloudflareの持続的な収益成長を牽引すること」です。</p> <p>そのために私たちは「人材・プロセス・ツール」のすべてにおいて最高水準を追求しています。とりわけ人材の育成とキャリア開発には強いこだわりを持っており、チームワークを尊重し、お互いの成功を称え合うカルチャーを大切にしています。強固なBDR組織の構築こそが、Cloudflareの市場における圧倒的な競合優位性を生み出す源泉であると信じています。</p> <h3><strong>ポジションの概要</strong></h3> <p>本ポジションでは、「ピープルマネジメント（育成・牽引）」「組織ビルディング」「戦略的思考」を兼ね備えたリーダーを募集しています。営業、インサイドセールス、またはBDR/SDR組織におけるチームマネジメントの豊富なご経験をお持ちの方を求めています。</p> <p>BDRチームの運営基盤（Sales Motion）の強化、四半期目標の安定達成、組織拡大に向けた戦略立案、そして協調的なチームカルチャーの醸成を主導していただきます。Cloudflare Japanは今後12ヶ月でさらなる変革と成長を予定しており、次代を担う優秀なリーダー・メンバーの育成と支援も非常に重要なミッションとなります。</p> <h3><strong>主な業務内容</strong></h3> <ul> <li>他地域のBDR組織と連携し、グローバルで成功している最新のBD戦略やノウハウを積極的に日本市場へ導入・共有</li> </ul> <li><strong>メンバーのマネジメントと組織拡大</strong></li> <ul> <li>5名以上（今後さらに拡大予定）のBDRメンバーのピープルマネジメント</li> reporting, process improvements</li> </ul> <li>Stay up to date and infuse industry best practices on effective Business Development strategies into the organization.  Collaborate internally with other regions to learn/share on what's working.  </li> <li>Managing a group of 5+ (expected to grow) Business Development professionals.  </li> <li>Recruit, interview, and hire BDRs at scale</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>At least 10 years’ experience leading a sales team of BDRs or Account Executives, of which at least 5 years’ experience in scaling a team of reps</li> <li>More than 5 years’ professional experience working in a rapidly growing technology company</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree required</li> <li>Proven track record of closing sales and exceeding quota</li> <li>Experience building career development programs for high performing individual contributors</li> <li>Experience with funnel management across multiple channels (inbound, upsell, outbound, marketing)</li> <li>Knowledge of using Salesforce and related systems (data tools, Lean Data, Sales Acceleration tools, etc.)</li> <li>Excellent project management skills</li> <li>Self-motivated and possess entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Comfortable working in a fast paced and dynamic environment</li> <li>Strong interpersonal communication skills (both verbal & written)</li> <li>Aptitude in learning technical concepts & terms</li> <li>Demonstrate excellent communication skills</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. You will build multi-year account plans, orchestrate virtual deal teams across Solution Engineers, Deal Desk, Legal, and Product, and position Cloudflare as a critical long-term platform partner for some of Switzerland's most strategic enterprises. You will engage at board and executive level, lead complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and consistently exceed new logo and expansion targets. Build a robust pipeline of high-value prospects through targeted executive outreach, ecosystem engagement, partner channels, and referrals. Demonstrate a nuanced understanding of enterprise buying behaviour and apply it to drive net-new deals forward with precision and appropriate urgency.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding</strong>: Develop a thorough understanding of each prospect's and customer's technology environment — including cloud strategy, security posture, compliance requirements, and AI and ML infrastructure. Map Cloudflare's platform capabilities to these environments through relevant Reference Architectures, driving comprehensive platform adoption in place of point-solution sales.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Virtual Deal Team Leadership</strong>: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of Customer Engineers, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to manage and close complex, high-value opportunities. Proactively navigate blockers, maintain deal momentum, and ensure a consistently high-quality customer and prospect experience throughout.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>AI-Powered Sales Execution</strong>: Leverage AI tools as a deliberate and consistent part of how you sell — applying them to prospect research, personalised executive outreach, account planning, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation, pipeline analysis, and follow-up. Demonstrate the same AI-native mindset Cloudflare brings to its products in how you manage your own territory and time.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Digital Transformation & AI Positioning</strong>: Serve as a knowledgeable and credible partner to customers navigating digital and AI-driven transformation. Maintain rigorous pipeline management across long and complex enterprise sales cycles, providing clear and honest visibility into deal status, risks, and required actions at all times.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure</strong>: Lead complex contract negotiations with confidence and expertise, constructing compelling outcome-linked value propositions directly tied to each customer's strategic objectives. Often the Enterprise Account Executive will have to make strategic decisions on engagement, terms, and support. If execution presents risk, Seek the advice of leaders when and where you need it.</li> <li>Teammate - We are all individually accountable to our goals, but we operate as a team. Be the person who actively seeks to assist the team, shares knowledge, and extends your personal network. title: Senior Software Engineer, Deploy at Scale
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location: </strong>Austin, TX (US), London (UK)</p> <p>Cloudflare’s Infrastructure Team builds and runs the systems and software that support our solutions that handle trillions of requests per month. We ensure that all of the new and existing features and functionality that Cloudflare offers can be managed at scale and meet the needs of our massively growing, global customer base.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer in the Deploy@Scale team, you will provide technical leadership for the platform that powers safe, reliable, and automated deployments across Cloudflare. This is a senior IC role: you will set technical direction across multiple work streams, not just execute within one. </p> <p>You'll be expected to operate with significant autonomy - identifying the right problems to solve, driving architecture decisions that will hold up over multiple years, and influencing how dozens of engineering teams across Cloudflare think about safe change. You will partner directly with your EM and leadership to shape the multi-quarter roadmap, and you'll be a primary technical voice in cross-team design reviews, RFCs, and incident retrospectives that touch deployment safety.</p> <p>You'll spend meaningful time unblocking and elevating the rest of the team: reviewing designs before they become code, pairing on the hardest problems, and raising the technical bar through mentorship - without needing to be a people manager to do it. You'll be defining what the platform is, deciding what not to build, and making the tradeoffs which ensure the system is safe, fast, and scalable five years from now.</p> <p><strong>Where we're heading</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>From human-in-the-loop to machine-in-the-loop:</strong> fully automated, health-mediated deployments as the default, at hundreds of thousands of releases a day.</li> <li><strong>Consolidating a fragmented landscape: </strong>unifying release orchestration, health mediation, feature flagging, and configuration rollback into one coherent platform.</li> <li><strong>AI as a first-class part of the platform</strong>: you'll help define where and how AI assists both the platform and the humans operating it.</li> </ul> <p>This is a unique opportunity to work on complex, globally distributed systems that underpin every Cloudflare product. You will play a key role in advancing the infrastructure that enables fast, safe delivery of changes to production, directly impacting the reliability and velocity of Cloudflare's global network. You will collaborate with the team to understand business needs and develop technical solutions, working closely with internal customers to turn their workflows into platform capabilities. You will thrive in a fast-paced iterative engineering environment with short release cycles.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including a track record of owning the architecture of complex, distributed, production-critical systems end to end.</li> <li>Demonstrated technical leadership beyond your own code: driving RFCs and design reviews that other senior engineers and teams rely on, and being sought out as a technical escalation point.</li> <li>Judgment for ambiguity — comfortable defining the problem and the roadmap, not just the solution, in an environment where requirements are not fully specified upfront.</li> <li>Deep experience with safety, observability, and automation in production systems: designing rollback paths, health signals, and guardrails that other systems and teams build on top of.</li> <li>Experience influencing technical direction across team boundaries — through architecture, mentorship, or platform APIs/contracts — without direct authority.</li> <li>Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with AI as a working tool: fluent use of AI-assisted development, critical evaluation of its output, and a point of view on where it should and shouldn't be trusted in a safety-critical system.</li> <li>Experience with workflow orchestration, long-running/durable execution, or large-scale distributed systems is a strong plus.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication — this role requires writing docs and RFCs that persuade and align, not just describe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience owning a deployment, progressive delivery, or change-management platform at scale.</li> <li>Experience leading a technical migration across many independent teams (e.g., a platform sunset/replacement).</li> </ul> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for title: Senior Software Engineer, PKI & Cryptographic Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations: Austin, London, or Lisbon (Hybrid)</h3> <h3 id="JD—SeniorSoftwareEngineer,PKI&CryptographicSystems(MergedDraft)-Abouttherole">About the role</h3> <p>TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Every day our network handles tens of millions of certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel — and the WebPKI ecosystem underneath all of it is undergoing its largest structural change in a generation: shorter certificate lifetimes, a shift toward post-quantum-safe signature algorithms, and new automation and trust-establishment mechanisms on the horizon.</p> <p>We are investing in the next generation of Cloudflare’s PKI and cryptographic infrastructure to keep up with, and stay ahead of, that shift. As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that manage certificate lifecycles, protect and use private keys at scale, integrate with hardware security modules, automate issuance and renewal, and take Cloudflare’s cryptographic stack into the post-quantum era. You will work at the intersection of applied cryptography, distributed systems, and security engineering — on infrastructure that a large fraction of the Internet quietly depends on.</p> <p>This is an early-days role on a growing team. The design decisions you make in the first year will shape how Cloudflare’s certificate and key infrastructure operates for years to come.</p> <h3 id="JD—SeniorSoftwareEngineer,PKI&CryptographicSystems(MergedDraft)-Responsibilities">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Design and build core PKI systems</strong> — certificate lifecycle management, X.509 issuance and validation logic, key parameter enforcement, and policy engines aligned with industry standards including CA/Browser Forum guidance and browser root program policies.</li> <li><strong>Own the cryptographic core.</strong> Integrate with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 (and, where required, Level 4) HSMs via PKCS#11 and vendor-native SDKs; build key ceremony and key-lifecycle tooling; enforce strict key-usage boundaries in code.</li> <li><strong>Automate at scale.</strong> Build and evolve ACME-based issuance and renewal pipelines, short-lived certificate rotation, and revocation mechanisms that serve at Cloudflare’s global scale.</li> <li><strong>Instrument transparency and audit trails.</strong> Integrate with Certificate Transparency, build append-only tamper-evident logging, and design evidence pipelines that hold up to rigorous third-party audit.</li> <li><strong>Maintain accreditation and respond to a changing compliance landscape.</strong> PKI operations must maintain compliance under CA/B Forum, WebTrust, and root store program frameworks. You will be aware of, and adapt to, changes in relevant policies, participate in public incident disclosure and discourse, and participate in regular third-party audits.</li> <li><strong>Represent Cloudflare in the WebPKI community.</strong> Write public CA incident reports and serve as a primary contact with the WebPKI community; clear technical writing is core to this role.</li> <li><strong>Ship the post-quantum future.</strong> Contribute to Cloudflare’s ongoing post-quantum migration — including work on post-quantum encryption and authentication — so that Cloudflare’s cryptographic infrastructure stays ahead of the transition.</li> <li><strong>Own code end-to-end</strong> from design through production incident response. Cryptographic infrastructure cannot silently fail; you will build the observability, runbooks, and on-call posture that keep the service inside SLO.</li> <li><strong>Partner across the org</strong> — with the SSL/TLS product teams, the HSM and data-centre infrastructure teams, the Cloudflare Research applied cryptography group, and adjacent product teams that consume PKI as a platform.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar.</strong> Mentor other engineers joining an early-stage team, run design reviews, and establish the engineering standards, threat models, and secure-development practices this team will operate under for years.</li> </ul> <h3 id="JD—SeniorSoftwareEngineer,PKI&CryptographicSystems(MergedDraft)-DesirableSkills,Knowledge&Experience">Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of production systems software experience,</strong> with a strong operational track record — you have carried a pager for something people depend on.</li> <li><strong>Deep working knowledge of applied cryptography and PKI.</strong> X.509, ASN.1/DER, RFC 5280, CRL distribution, Certificate Transparency, ACME, and the CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements. You do not need to be a cryptographer, but you need to reason precisely about certificate profiles, key parameters, and issuance policy.</li> <li><strong>Familiarity with HSMs.</strong> PKCS#11 integration, key ceremonies, key-attestation flows, and understanding of what FIPS 140-2/3 validation actually means in production.</li> <li><strong>Strong systems programming background</strong> in at least one of Go, Rust, or C/C++.</li> <li><strong>Distributed systems fluency</strong> — you have built or operated globally replicated, availability-critical services with strict correctness guarantees.</li> <li><strong>Experience designing and operating database schemas for high-integrity systems</strong> (Postgres or equivalent).</li> <li><strong>Security-hardened system design instincts</strong> — threat modelling, defence in depth, least privilege, and secure key handling.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with high-consequence work.</strong> A mis-issued or mis-revoked certificate is a public, industry-visible event. You need the temperament to move quickly and the discipline to be careful.</li> </ul> <h3 id="JD—SeniorSoftwareEngineer,PKI&CryptographicSystems(MergedDraft)-BonusPoints">Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience working on or with a publicly-trusted or private CA, or a large-scale internal PKI (Let’s Encrypt / Boulder, Google Trust Services, DigiCert, Sectigo, ISRG, Entrust, Microsoft PKI, HashiCorp Vault PKI, step-ca, CFSSL, or an internal CA at scale).</li> <li>Experience with <code>crypto/x509</code>, BoringSSL, OpenSSL/AWS-LC, CFSSL, or an equivalent PKI codebase.</li> <li>Experience with WebTrust for CAs / WebTrust BR / WebTrust Network Security audit engagements.</li> <li>Familiarity with post-quantum cryptography — ML-DSA, ML-KEM, hybrid signature schemes, and the current state of PQ signature standardisation.</li> <li>Familiarity with emerging browser trust-establishment proposals (e.g. Merkle Tree Certificates).</li> <li>Prior participation in the CA/Browser Forum, IETF LAMPS / TLS / PLANTS / PQUIP working groups, the transparency.dev community, or a browser root program review.</li> <li>Experience running or automating offline key ceremonies.</li> <li>Experience operating Certificate Transparency log infrastructure or CT monitoring at scale.</li> <li>Familiarity with formal methods, differential fuzzing, or property-based testing for cryptographic protocol code.</li> <li>Kubernetes experience.</li> </ul> <h4 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h4> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - €83,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h4 data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re

Cloudflare.</li> <li>Published reusable reference architectures and field guidance that elevate the entire team.</li> <li>Improved the field organization’s ability to position, architect, and deliver Cloudflare’s developer and AI solutions.</li> <li>Cultivated the technical leadership of your colleagues through active mentorship and enablement.</li> <li>Provided product teams with consistent, evidence-based insights into regional customer requirements and adoption barriers.</li> <li>Become recognized as a supportive, authoritative Developer Platform leader across APJC.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Meaningful Experience:</strong> A strong background in solutions architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role. A significant portion of your portfolio will consist of clients based in India.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Collaboration:</strong> A track record of owning complex technical strategies involving developers, infrastructure teams, security stakeholders, and senior executives.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> Deep working knowledge of distributed application architecture (compute, storage, networking, security, reliability, and observability).</li> <li><strong>Hands-On Capability:</strong> Software-development experience, including the ability to build or review production-quality applications and proofs of concept (preferably in JavaScript or TypeScript).</li> <li><strong>Ecosystem Knowledge:</strong> A strong understanding of modern web technologies, serverless/cloud-native architectures, modern software-delivery practices, and at least one major public cloud platform.</li> <li><strong>Influential Leadership:</strong> A proven ability to influence without direct authority, thoughtfully mentor colleagues, and turn individual solutions into shared organizational capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Excellent written, presentation, and facilitation skills tailored for developer, architectural, and executive audiences.</li> <li><strong>Travel:</strong> Ability to travel up to 30%, primarily within APJC, including India (supported by flexible planning).</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience building and operating production applications on Cloudflare’s Developer degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, OR equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Important Note: </strong><em>At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates executive audiences, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to risk reduction, operational improvement, and business outcomes.</li> <li>Ability to collaborate across Sales, Product, capabilities such as Access, Gateway, Cloudflare One Client, Browser Isolation, CASB, DLP, Email Security, Cloudflare Tunnel, or Cloudflare WAN.</li> <li>Experience displacing, integrating, or Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> model</strong>, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li><strong>Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies</strong>, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).</li> We own the systems and processes that enable our global network to scale across 337+ cities in 125+ countries while maintaining industry-leading performance and reliability. We design the architectural standards, capacity methodologies, and hardware evolution strategies that keep Cloudflare's network ahead of exponential growth. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we leverage our edge and network to solve infrastructure problems at massive scale and efficiency—something nearly impossible for any other organization.</p> <h4>What you'll do</h4> <p>We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our team and lead the design, evolution, and operational excellence of our global network infrastructure. You will own the foundational decisions about how our network grows: from capacity planning methodologies and hardware evolution strategies to architectural standards that inform infrastructure teams across the organization. You will work with a team of passionate, talented engineers and architects that are building the systems powering the internet's most critical infrastructure. You will play an active part in shaping the network architecture, strategies, and long-term roadmaps that will keep Cloudflare ahead of unprecedented scale. You will make sure our company hits our ambitious infrastructure and operational goals. You will change what's possible for internet infrastructure.</p> <p>If you've designed backbone and edge networks from the ground up, automated BGP policy and traffic engineering at hyperscale, driven network planning and sourcing to balance performance, redundancy, and cost, and led teams through major architectural shifts - this is the role for you. You bring a deep understanding of modern routing protocols (BGP, ISIS, RSVP-TE), software-defined forwarding, and the tradeoffs between automation, standardization, and operational flexibility. You excel at building extensible frameworks that allow teams to solve tomorrow's problems without rewiring today's foundation. You have a track record of taking on greenfield problems and turning them into repeatable systems and processes. Most importantly, you have the respect of infrastructure teams because you combine technical depth with strategic thinking and the ability to influence without authority.</p> <h4>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</h4> <p>Note: it is not required that you have all of these! The Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Zero Trust market represents one of the most transformative growth opportunities in enterprise technology, reshaping how businesses connect, protect, and empower their global workforce.</p> <p>To lead this next chapter, Cloudflare has created the Cloudflare One (CF1) Speedboat - a dedicated, cross-functional organization designed to operate with the focus, agility, and autonomy of a startup, backed by the global scale and infrastructure of Cloudflare.</p> <p>We are seeking a visionary, entrepreneurial executive to serve as the Vice President, CF1 GTM. In this role, you will own and scale a high-growth global business, define the GTM strategy, and build a multi-billion-dollar business in one of the most dynamic markets of the decade. This is an extraordinary opportunity to lead a “company within a company,” shaping the future of how enterprises secure and connect to the Internet.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own and Scale the Business:</strong> Act as the general manager of Cloudflare One business unit, with full accountability for global GTM strategy, execution, and P&L performance.</li> <li><strong>Define the Market Strategy:</strong> Craft and execute a bold, differentiated strategy to establish Cloudflare as the world’s leading SASE and Zero Trust platform. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ogilvy  </strong></p> <p>Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="7f087527-f491-4cb6-a79d-3b4a67d1ec89">WPP.com</a></u>.</p> <p> </p></div><p>Ogilvy Health DACH ist eine grenzenlos agierende Kreativagentur, die durch nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Disziplinen und Märkte hinweg Projekte realisiert – von lokalen Initiativen bis hin zu globalen Kampagnen. Unser Team arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von <strong>Healthcare, Social Media, Strategie, Experience und Influence</strong>.</p> <p>Von Zürich aus betreuen wir das Healthcare-Portfolio von Ogilvy für die DACH-Region sowie ausgewählte internationale Kund:innen aus den Bereichen Pharma, Biotech und Medizintechnik. Unser interdisziplinäres Health-Team vereint Account Management, Medical Writing, PR, Digital, Strategie und Kreation.</p> <p>Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir eine:n<strong> Designer/ Art Director Health (m/w/d) </strong>in Berlin, Hamburg, Frankfurt/ Main, Düsseldorf oder Zürich. </p> <p> Das bieten wir:</p> <ul> <li>Möglichkeit zur Arbeit im Mobile Office (bis zu 100%) </li> <li>Nutzung unseres WPP Weiterbildungsnetzwerkes, inkl. LinkedIn Learning </li> <li>Unterstützung bei der privaten Altersvorsorge und die Gewährung von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen </li> <li>Jubiläumsprämien in Form von zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen </li> <li>Möglichkeit zur Nutzung eines Job Bikes </li> <li>Erweiterte Betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit einem zusätzlichen Budget von bis zu 300€ im Jahr </li> <li>Zugriff auf unser Employee Assistance Programm TELUS Health </li> <li>Kostenlose Nutzung der Headspace-App </li> <li>Subventionierte Gympass-Mitgliedschaft </li> </ul> <p>Deine Aufgaben: </p> <p>Als Art Director Health entwickelst und gestaltest du Kommunikationslösungen für renommierte Kund:innen aus dem Healthcare- und Pharmabereich. Dein Aufgabenspektrum reicht – je nach Projekt – von konkreten Kommunikationsmitteln wie Flyern, Broschüren, Präsentationen und Sales-Materialien bis hin zu visuellen Identitäten, digitalen Inhalten und integrierten Kampagnen.<br>Du entwickelst starke visuelle Konzepte, übersetzt medizinische und wissenschaftliche Inhalte in klare, relevante Kommunikation und begleitest Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Medical Writing, Client Services, Strategie, Creative Direction, Digital, PR, Production und externen Partner:innen zusammen.<br>Die Rolle erfordert kreative Exzellenz und ein gutes Verständnis für die besonderen Anforderungen der Healthcare-Kommunikation – insbesondere für Rx-Produkte, regulatorische Vorgaben und Review-Prozesse.</p> <ul> <li>Konzeption und Gestaltung von Kommunikationsmitteln für Print, Digital, Social Media und Bewegtbild – von Flyern, Broschüren und Präsentationen bis zu digitalen Assets und Kampagnenformaten</li> <li>Entwicklung visueller Identitäten, Corporate Designs, Branding-Lösungen, Kampagnenwelten und visueller Narrative für Pharma-, Biotech- und Medtech-Kund:innen</li> <li>Übersetzung medizinischer und wissenschaftlicher Inhalte in klare, zielgruppengerechte und visuell überzeugende Lösungen, insbesondere für Rx-, Disease-Awareness- und Patient-Engagement-Projekte</li> <li>Präsentation und überzeugende Vermittlung von Ideen gegenüber Kund:innen sowie Begleitung der Umsetzung und Sicherstellung der gestalterischen Qualität über alle Kanäle und Formate hinweg</li> <li>Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen und externen Partner:innen wie Fotograf:innen, Filmproduktionen, Freelancer:innen und Partneragenturen sowie Unterstützung bei Pitches, Neugeschäftsprojekten und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kund:innenbeziehungen</li> </ul> <p>Was du mitbringst: </p> <ul> <li>Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Grafiker:in EFZ, Studium in Visueller Kommunikation, Grafikdesign oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Art Director in einer Healthcare-, Pharma- oder Kommunikationsagentur</li> <li>Fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen aus Pharma, Biotech und/oder Medtech sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung mit Kommunikationsmassnahmen für Rx-Produkte</li> <li>Gutes Verständnis für medizinische Inhalte, regulatorische Anforderungen und Review-Prozesse in der Healthcare-Kommunikation</li> <li>Ausgeprägte konzeptionelle und gestalterische Fähigkeiten, ein überzeugendes Portfolio sowie sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud und gängigen Design- und Präsentationstools</li> <li>Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, ein sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kund:innen sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift</li> <li>Erfahrung mit Patient Engagement, PR- und Awareness-Kampagnen sowie Kenntnisse in Motion Design und Social/Digital Content Creation sind ein Plus.</li> <li>Du verbindest kreative Exzellenz mit strategischem Denken und kannst komplexe Inhalte schnell erfassen und in relevante visuelle Ideen übersetzen.</li> <li>Du arbeitest proaktiv, selbständig, lösungsorientiert und zuverlässig – sowohl an grösseren Projekten als auch an konkreten Kommunikationsmitteln im Tagesgeschäft.</li> <li>Du kommunizierst klar, präsentierst sicher und kannst Kund:innen für deine Ideen begeistern. Die Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams macht dir Freude.</li> <li>Du bringst Resilienz und Flexibilität für einen dynamischen und phasenweise intensiven Agenturalltag mit. Nicht alles ist planbar, Prioritäten und Timings können sich kurzfristig ändern.</li> <li>Auch bei hohem Tempo und mehreren parallelen Projekten bewahrst du den Überblick, hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch und übernimmst Verantwortung. In intensiven Phasen bist du bereit, gemeinsam mit dem Team die Extrameile zu gehen.</li> </ul> <p>Wir glauben an die Kraft von Diversität und Kollaboration. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.<br><strong>Travel:</strong> <strong><br>Job ID:</strong> 1892 </p> <p>ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.</p> <p><strong>The Role: <br></strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Principal Engineer to own the classical cryptography architecture of our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration products, targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. Real-world quantum-safe systems are hybrid systems: classical and post-quantum algorithms operating side by side, with careful key management, crypto agility and migration paths. You will be the senior authority for this classical and hybrid layer, working alongside our PQC architecture leadership. The role demands fluency on both sides of the transition: deep classical mastery combined with a solid working command of the post-quantum algorithms and standards the products are built around.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p>You will own the architecture and implementation strategy of the classical cryptographic functions of the product line: symmetric ciphers and modes (AES/GCM and beyond), hash functions (SHA-2/SHA-3, HMAC/KDF constructions), RSA/ECC offload, and true random number generation and entropy architecture (SP 800-90A/B/C). You will define the hybrid classical/post-quantum schemes (key establishment, dual signatures, composite certificates) and the crypto-agility mechanisms that allow customers to migrate safely, track the standardisation of hybrid and composite approaches (NIST guidance, IETF work on hybrid key establishment in TLS 1.3 and IKEv2, composite certificates) together with our PQC architects, guide RTL and software engineers implementing classical cores, technically evaluate third-party IP, and support FIPS 140-3 and CAVP certification of the classical algorithm suite. You will also own key-management and key-hierarchy architecture across the product, ensuring interoperability with deployed HSM, TLS and IPsec ecosystems.</p> <ul> <li>Own the classical and hybrid cryptography architecture of the product line: symmetric, hash, RSA/ECC, entropy and key management, and classical/PQC hybrid schemes</li> <li>Define crypto-agility and migration mechanisms that let customers move to quantum-safe deployments without breaking existing infrastructure</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s or PhD in Cryptography, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field and at least twelve years of experience implementing and architecting classical cryptography in real products, in hardware, software or both. You have deep command of symmetric and asymmetric primitives, modes of operation, key management and entropy generation, and you have taken cryptographic subsystems through FIPS 140-3 or Common Criteria evaluation. You also bring a solid working knowledge of the NIST post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) and their deployment constraints: you do not need to be a lattice specialist, but you must be able to architect hybrid schemes with one.</p> <p>You understand the practical constraints of deployed security infrastructure (HSMs, PKI, TLS and IPsec ecosystems) and how hybrid classical/post-quantum schemes are standardised and deployed in practice. You write precise specifications, guide implementers effectively, and make sound architecture decisions under real-world interoperability constraints. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.</p> <ul> <li>Proven architect of classical cryptographic subsystems with certification experience (FIPS 140-3, CAVP, Common Criteria)</li> <li>Practical knowledge of hybrid classical/PQC schemes, crypto agility and key-management architecture, with working command of the NIST PQC standards</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:<br></strong></p> <p>You believe that quantum-safe security is only as strong as the classical foundations it stands on. You enjoy being the guardian of correctness and interoperability in a programme pushing new technology, and you take pride in migrations that customers barely notice because they simply work.</p> <p></p> <p><strong>What We Offer:<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world</li> <li>A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence</li> <li>Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career</li> <li>Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track</li> <li>A career development plan within the IonQ group’s companies</li> <li>A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts</li> <li>A performance-driven culture built on trust, teamwork, and shared ambition</li> </ul> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. Familiarity with data formats (JSON, XML) or integration concepts is a plus. Data and spreadsheet skills: You are comfortable using spreadsheets to analyze, compare and synthesize information. Experience with dashboards or SQL would be a plus. Hands-on with AI tools: You use AI tools daily and critically to improve research, analysis and product work. Experience creating prompts, automations or agents is a plus. Soft Skills Curious, proactive and rigorous: You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions and dig until the key unknowns are clarified. Strong communication and collaboration skills: You communicate clearly with different stakeholders, collaborate effectively in cross-functional environments and can summarize complex information into clear, actionable conclusions for different audiences. Fast learner with adaptability: You pick up new domains quickly and are comfortable learning unfamiliar concepts. Critical thinker: You can challenge assumptions, assess the quality of information and distinguish facts from hypotheses. title: Mechanical Engineer - Design for Cost & Product Improvement
description: As Mechanical Engineer, within Distalmotion’s Instruments – Product Improvement team, you will be responsible for driving product optimization initiatives with a strong emphasis on cost reduction, manufacturing efficiency, and continuous product improvement for the Instruments of the surgical system. The Mechanical Engineer brings solid experience in component and tooling design with associated impact analysis (impact on design verification, risk assessment, quality and manufacturing costs) and root cause investigation of clinical complaints and/or non-conformities. Tasks : Design & Cost Optimization • Specify design, prototype, and implement mechanical components and custom tooling/fixtures with a strong focus on Design for Manufacturing, Assembly and Cost (DFM/DFA/DFC). • Identify, justify and execute cost reduction opportunities on existing instruments without compromising performance, quality or safety. • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders from manufacturing of prototypes to testing and industrialization of the products. Impact analysis • Perform comprehensive impact analysis of the proposed design changes, evaluating effects on manufacturing processes, unit costs, risk management and design verification. • Evaluate financial impact of proposed design changes, including tooling/fixture investments, scrap reduction and cycle time improvement. • Define technical requirements and test protocols and ensure traceability with the design in test reports. Supervise and participate to design verification. • Collaborate with internal teams (Ops, QA, RA). • The compliance with the applicable laws and standards and the design control practices is a must (e.g. ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR 820, MDR). Continuous Improvement • Investigate clinical complaints and production non-conformity. • Lead root cause analysis and manage Corrective and Preventive Actions to drive continuous product quality and reliability improvements. Requirements Education & Experience • Mechanical, microtechnology engineering degree or equivalent (BSc or MSc) • At least 5 years of experience in the medical device industry or highly regulated environment (eg. Aerospace, automotive) Technical competency • Proficiency in CAD (SOLIDWORKS preferred) • Design For Manufacturing experience (plastic and metal injection, stamping, …), for medium to high volume manufacturing • Relevant experience in Design Control (Design input/output/transfer, Risk Analysis, Failure mode analysis) • Knowledge of change management workflows Soft Skills • Strong analytical, problem-solving, pragmatic and creative skills • Good communication skills with proactive attitude and strong accountability under limited supervision • Language: French, English Benefits What we offer : A dynamic, innovative environment with cutting-edge medical technology that is shaping the future of robotic surgery. title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
description: Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. What We Want to Achieve Together In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. Why us? Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else. A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI. Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites. Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation. Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority. Process 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations. Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live. Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset. Meet the team in the office. Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team! How to Apply Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence?
